    .avatar-preview {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .avatar-preview img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .avatar-preview .avatar-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      background: var(--surface2);
    }
    .avatar-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .btn-upload {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .btn-upload:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .btn-remove-avatar {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-remove-avatar:hover {
      border-color: var(--red);
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .upload-progress {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .upload-progress .spinner-small {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      border-top-color: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.6s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    .info-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: .65rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .info-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .info-label {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 500;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .info-value {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text);
      text-align: right;
      word-break: break-all;
    }
    .info-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .3rem;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 2px 9px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.1);
      color: var(--green);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PASSWORD
       ============================================================ */
    .pw-field {
      position: relative;
      margin-bottom: .85rem;
    }
    .pw-field label {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: .4rem;
    }
    .pw-field input {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: .65rem 2.5rem .65rem .9rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      outline: none;
    }
    .pw-field input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .pw-toggle {
      position: absolute;
      right: 10px;
      bottom: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: none;
      border: none;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .pw-toggle:hover { color: var(--accent); }

    .pw-strength {
      display: flex;
      gap: 3px;
      margin-top: .35rem;
      height: 3px;
    }
    .pw-strength-bar {
      flex: 1;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: var(--border);
    }
    .pw-strength-bar.weak { background: var(--red); }
    .pw-strength-bar.medium { background: #facc15; }
    .pw-strength-bar.strong { background: var(--green); }
    .pw-strength-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: .25rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       THEME / LANGUAGE / CURRENCY
       ============================================================ */
    .theme-toggle-card {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .theme-toggle-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .theme-toggle-info {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .theme-toggle-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    .theme-toggle-text h4 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin: 0 0 2px;
    }
    .theme-toggle-text p {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .toggle-switch {
      position: relative;
      width: 50px;
      height: 26px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .toggle-switch input {
      opacity: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 0;
      position: absolute;
    }
    .toggle-slider {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 99px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.3s;
    }
    .toggle-slider::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      left: 3px;
      top: 3px;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      transition: transform 0.3s;
    }
    .toggle-switch input:checked + .toggle-slider {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
    }
    .toggle-switch input:checked + .toggle-slider::before {
      transform: translateX(24px);
    }

    .lang-selector-compact {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.25rem;
    }
    .lang-compact-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .lang-compact-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .lang-compact-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
    }

    .currency-selector-compact {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .currency-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .currency-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .currency-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       MESSAGES
       ============================================================ */
    .msg-error, .msg-success {
      display: none;
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: .5rem;
      padding: .5rem .75rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
    }
    .msg-error {
      color: var(--red);
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
    }
    .msg-success {
      color: var(--green);
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       DANGER
       ============================================================ */
    .s-card.danger-card { border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.25); }
    .s-card.danger-card .s-card-header {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.04);
      border-bottom-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.15);
    }
    .s-card.danger-card h2 { color: var(--red); }
    .danger-action-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: .5rem 0;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .danger-action-desc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; flex: 1; min-width: 180px; }
    .btn-outline-danger {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--red);
      color: var(--red);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: .5rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-outline-danger:hover {
      background: var(--red);
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PAGE HEADER
       ============================================================ */
    .settings-page-header {
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .settings-page-header-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .4rem;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent2);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.18);
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      margin-bottom: .5rem;
    }
    .settings-page-header h1 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 3vw, 1.8rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0 0 .25rem;
    }
    .settings-page-header p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }

    .settings-tabs-mobile {
      display: none;
      gap: .4rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .settings-tab-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .35rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: .45rem .85rem;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .settings-tab-btn.active {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1);
      border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      color: var(--accent2);
    }
    .settings-tab-btn.danger.active {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08);
      border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
      color: var(--red);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PLAN CARD
       ============================================================ */
    .plan-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.75rem;
      transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .plan-card.premium {
      border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4);
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.06), rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.01));
      box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.05), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1);
    }
    .plan-card.premium::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2), var(--accent3), var(--accent2), var(--accent));
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: premiumGradient 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes premiumGradient {
      0% { background-position: 0% 0%; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 0%; }
      100% { background-position: 0% 0%; }
    }
    .plan-card.premium::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -50%;
      left: -50%;
      width: 200%;
      height: 200%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.03), transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
      animation: premiumPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes premiumPulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }
    }
    .plan-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.5);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 0 30px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-name {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-name .premium-badge {
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 0.7rem 1.6rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 140px;
      text-align: center;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: -100%;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), transparent);
      transition: left 0.6s ease;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium:hover::before {
      left: 100%;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium:active {
      transform: scale(0.96);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium.secondary {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border2);
      color: var(--text);
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium.secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent2);
      color: var(--accent2);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.1);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium-outline {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      padding: 0.7rem 1.6rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 140px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-actions .btn-premium-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--red);
      color: var(--red);
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-status.active {
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12);
      color: var(--green);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-status.inactive {
      background: rgba(107, 107, 128, 0.08);
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-status .dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
      animation: dotPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .plan-card .plan-status .dot.green {
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4);
    }
    .plan-card .plan-status .dot.gray {
      background: var(--muted);
      animation: none;
    }
    .plan-payment-note {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px dashed var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .plan-payment-note .payment-icon {
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    /* ⭐ PLAN PERKS */
    .plan-perks-box {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    .plan-perks-box:hover {
      border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.06);
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perks-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perks-title .perks-icon {
      font-size: 18px;
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perks-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perk-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perk-item:hover {
      border-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25);
      background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.03);
      transform: translateX(3px);
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perk-item .perk-icon {
      font-size: 16px;
      width: 28px;
      text-align: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .plan-perks-box .perk-item .perk-text {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }

    /* ⭐ ABONELİK SÜRESİ */
    .subscription-timer {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .subscription-timer .timer-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .subscription-timer .timer-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .subscription-timer .timer-value {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }
    .subscription-timer .timer-progress-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      height: 4px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 99px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .subscription-timer .timer-progress-wrap .timer-progress {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 99px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      transition: width 0.5s ease;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CONFIRM MODAL
       ============================================================ */
    .confirm-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 1000;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .confirm-modal-overlay.active {
      display: flex;
    }
    .confirm-modal-box {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 420px;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
      animation: modalSlideIn 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
    }
    @keyframes modalSlideIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.92) translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }
    .confirm-modal-header {
      padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .confirm-modal-header .icon-wrap {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .confirm-modal-header .icon-wrap svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      stroke: var(--red);
      stroke-width: 2;
    }
    .confirm-modal-header h3 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body {
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body p {
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body .warning-text {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--red);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body .warning-text svg {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      stroke: currentColor;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer {
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.25rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-cancel {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 0.45rem 1.4rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-cancel:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.05);
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 40px;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.45rem 1.6rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger:active {
      transform: scale(0.96);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       AVATAR POPUP
       ============================================================ */
    .avatar-popup-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      z-index: 2000;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .avatar-popup-overlay.active {
      display: flex;
    }
    .avatar-popup {
      background: transparent;
      max-width: 500px;
      width: 100%;
      position: relative;
      animation: modalIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
    }
    @keyframes modalIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.94) translateY(16px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }
    .avatar-popup-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: -16px;
      right: -16px;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 16px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    }
    .avatar-popup-close:hover {
      background: var(--red);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: var(--red);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }
    .avatar-popup-body {
      text-align: center;
    }
    .avatar-popup-body .big-avatar {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 460px;
      aspect-ratio: 1/1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border: 3px solid var(--border2);
      background: var(--surface2);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    }
    .avatar-popup-body .big-avatar img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .avatar-popup-body .big-avatar .big-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      background: var(--surface2);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RESPONSIVE
       ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .settings-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .settings-sidebar { display: none; }
      .settings-tabs-mobile { display: flex; }
      .avatar-popup-body .big-avatar {
        max-width: 300px;
      }
      .avatar-popup-close {
        top: -10px;
        right: -10px;
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
      .confirm-modal-box {
        margin: 0 0.5rem;
      }
      .plan-card .plan-features {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 767px) {
      .nav-links { display: none !important; }
      .nav-right { margin-left: auto; }
      .theme-toggle-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .lang-selector-compact { margin-top: 0.5rem; }
      .currency-selector-compact { margin-top: 0.5rem; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .info-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .25rem; }
      .info-value { text-align: left; }
      .danger-action-row { flex-direction: column; }
      .panel-glow { height: 180px; }
      .avatar-upload-container { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .avatar-popup-body .big-avatar {
        max-width: 240px;
      }
      .confirm-modal-footer {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-cancel,
      .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger {
        flex: 1;
        text-align: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

      <h2>WaweDev</h2>
      <p><strong>WaweDev</strong>, Bir teknoloji meraklısı tarafından kuruldu. </p>

      <h2>Misyonumuz</h2>
      <p>Trader'ların işlemlerini daha bilinçli bir şekilde takip etmelerini sağlamak, karar alma süreçlerini veriyle desteklemek ve finansal okuryazarlığı artırmak.</p>

      <h2>Vizyonumuz</h2>
      <p>Dünyanın en güvenilir ve kullanışlı trading journal platformu olmak, trader'ların gelişimine katkıda bulunmak.</p>

      <h2>Değerlerimiz</h2>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Güvenlik:</strong> Kullanıcı verilerinin gizliliği ve güvenliği en öncelikli konumuzdur.</li>
        <li><strong>Şeffaflık:</strong> Verilerinizin nasıl kullanıldığını her zaman açıkça belirtiriz.</li>
        <li><strong>Sadeli̇k:</strong> Karmaşık özellikler yerine işe yarayan, sade arayüzler tasarlarız.</li>
        <li><strong>Yenilikçilik:</strong> Teknolojinin en güncel araçlarını kullanarak sürekli gelişiriz.</li>
      </ul>

      <h2>Ekibimiz</h2>
      <p>Samimi olmak gerekirse bir ekibim yok tek kişi kurdum bu projeyi daha önce bir çok büyüklü küçüklü proje kurdum kendi çapımda bazıları başlamadan başarısız oldu bazıları ise bütçe / maliyet sıkıntıları yüzünden tozlu raflara kaldırıldı. Belki bu projede böyle sonuçlanacak ama asla denemekten sıkılmam. </p>

      <h2>Neden "Wawe"?</h2>
      <p>"Wawe", İngilizce "wave" (dalga) kelimesinin özel bir yazımıdır. Piyasalardaki dalgalanmaları, trader'ların iniş çıkışlarını ve sürekli hareket halindeki finans dünyasını temsil eder. Her dalga yeni bir fırsattır.</p>
