    // ============================================================
    // USERS TABLE - Premium süresi gösterimi düzeltildi
    // ============================================================
    async function renderUsersTable() {
      var container = document.getElementById('users-table-container');
      if (!container) return;

      var term = '';
      var searchInput = document.getElementById('user-search');
      if (searchInput) term = searchInput.value || '';

      var filtered = filterUsers(term);
      var countEl = document.getElementById('user-count');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = filtered.length;

      try {
        var { data: trades } = await sb.from('trades').select('user_id');
        var tradeCounts = {};
        (trades || []).forEach(function(t) {
          tradeCounts[t.user_id] = (tradeCounts[t.user_id] || 0) + 1;
        });
      } catch(e) {
        var tradeCounts = {};
      }

      var now = new Date();
      var AW = 10 * 60 * 1000;

      var rows = filtered.map(function(u) {
        var online = u.last_active && (now - new Date(u.last_active)) < AW;
        var role = (u.user_metadata && u.user_metadata.role) || 'user';
        var tc = tradeCounts[u.id] || 0;
        var isPremium = u.plan === 'premium';
        var expiresAt = u.plan_expires_at ? new Date(u.plan_expires_at) : null;
        var isExpired = isPremium && expiresAt && new Date() > expiresAt;

        var expiryText = '—';
        var expiryClass = '';
        if (isPremium && expiresAt) {
          if (isExpired) {
            expiryText = '⏳ Süresi Doldu';
            expiryClass = 'expired';
          } else {
            var daysLeft = Math.ceil((expiresAt - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            expiryText = daysLeft + ' gün';
            if (daysLeft < 3) expiryClass = 'soon';
          }
        }

        var avatarHtml = u.avatar_url
          ? '<img src="' + u.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar" style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">'
          : '<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;">' + getInitials(u.username) + '</span>';

        return '<tr>\n          <td><span class="id-chip">' + (u.id || '').slice(0, 8) + '…</span></td>\n          <td>\n            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">\n              <div style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;">\n                ' + avatarHtml + '\n              </div>\n              <span style="font-weight:500;">' + escapeHtml(u.username || '—') + '</span>\n            </div>\n          </td>\n          <td style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;">' + escapeHtml(u.email || '—') + '</td>\n          <td>\n            <span class="plan-badge-user ' + (isPremium && !isExpired ? 'premium' : 'free') + '">\n              <span class="dot"></span>\n              ' + (isPremium && !isExpired ? 'Premium' : 'Free') + '\n            </span>\n          </td>\n          <td style="font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">\n            ' + (isPremium && !isExpired
              ? '<span class="expiry-text ' + expiryClass + '">' + expiryText + '</span>'
              : '<span class="expiry-text">' + expiryText + '</span>') + '\n          </td>\n          <td style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);">\n            ' + (isPremium && expiresAt && !isExpired ? formatDate(expiresAt) : '—') + '\n          </td>\n          <td style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);">' + formatDate(u.created_at) + '</td>\n          <td>' + (online ? '<span class="status-online">Aktif</span>' : '<span class="status-offline">Çevrimdışı</span>') + '</td>\n          <td><span class="role-badge role-' + role + '">' + (role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'User') + '</span></td>\n        </tr>';
      }).join('');

      container.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="table-wrap" style="background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;">\n          <div style="overflow-x:auto;">\n            <table class="ww-table">\n              <thead>\n                <tr><th>ID</th><th>Kullanıcı</th><th>E-posta</th><th>Plan</th><th>Kalan Süre</th><th>Bitiş Tarihi</th><th>Kayıt</th><th>Durum</th><th>Rol</th></tr>\n              </thead>\n              <tbody>\n                ' + (rows || '<tr><td colspan="9"><div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;">Kullanıcı bulunamadı.</div></td></tr>') + '\n              </tbody>\n            </table>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REFERENCES TABLE
    // ============================================================
    function renderReferencesTable() {
      var container = document.getElementById('references-table-container');
      if (!container) return;

      var countEl = document.getElementById('ref-count');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = references.length;

      var rows = references.map(function(r) {
        return '<tr>\n          <td>\n            <div style="width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid var(--border2);background:var(--surface2);">\n              <img src="' + (r.image_url || 'https://placehold.co/40x40?text=?') + '" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">\n            </div>\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            <div style="font-weight:600;color:var(--text);">' + escapeHtml(r.name) + '</div>\n            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;">' + escapeHtml(r.title || '—') + '</div>\n          </td>\n          <td class="ref-social-icons">\n            ' + (r.instagram ? '<span title="Instagram">📷</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (r.twitter ? '<span title="Twitter">🐦</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (r.youtube ? '<span title="YouTube">▶️</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (r.linkedin ? '<span title="LinkedIn">🔗</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (!r.instagram && !r.twitter && !r.youtube && !r.linkedin ? '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;">—</span>' : '') + '\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            ' + (r.is_active
              ? '<span style="background:rgba(34,197,94,0.1);color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;">Aktif</span>'
              : '<span style="background:rgba(107,107,128,0.1);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;">Pasif</span>') + '\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;">\n              <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="editReference(\'' + r.id + '\')">\n                <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg>\n                Düzenle\n              </button>\n              <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteReference(\'' + r.id + '\')">\n                <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6"/></svg>\n                Sil\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </td>\n        </tr>';
      }).join('');

      container.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="table-wrap" style="background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;">\n          <div style="overflow-x:auto;">\n            <table class="ww-table">\n              <thead><tr><th>Fotoğraf</th><th>Kişi / Kurum</th><th>Sosyal</th><th>Durum</th><th>İşlem</th></tr></thead>\n              <tbody>\n                ' + (rows || '<tr><td colspan="5"><div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;">Henüz referans eklenmemiş.</div></td></tr>') + '\n              </tbody>\n            </table>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // PRICES CONTENT
    // ============================================================
    function renderPricesContent() {
      var container = document.getElementById('prices-container');
      if (!container) return;

      var monthly = 9;
      var yearly = 79;
      var methods = ['BTC', 'LTC'];
      var discount = 27;

      try {
        if (window.getMonthlyPrice) monthly = window.getMonthlyPrice();
        if (window.getYearlyPrice) yearly = window.getYearlyPrice();
        if (window.getPaymentMethods) methods = window.getPaymentMethods();
        if (window.getYearlyDiscount) discount = window.getYearlyDiscount();
      } catch(e) {}

      container.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">💰 Aylık Plan Fiyatı</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Premium aylık abonelik fiyatını belirleyin.</div>\n          <div class="price-input-group">\n            <label>Aylık Fiyat</label>\n            <input type="number" id="price-monthly-input" value="' + monthly + '" min="0.5" step="0.5" />\n            <span class="currency-label">USD</span>\n            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:0.5rem;">Mevcut: $' + monthly.toFixed(2) + '</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">📅 Yıllık Plan Fiyatı</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Premium yıllık abonelik fiyatını belirleyin.</div>\n          <div class="price-input-group">\n            <label>Yıllık Fiyat</label>\n            <input type="number" id="price-yearly-input" value="' + yearly + '" min="0.5" step="0.5" />\n            <span class="currency-label">USD</span>\n            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:0.5rem;">Mevcut: $' + yearly.toFixed(2) + '</span>\n          </div>\n          <div style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);">\n            💡 Mevcut indirim: <span id="discount-display">' + discount + '%</span>\n            ' + (discount > 0 ? '<span style="color:var(--green);margin-left:0.5rem;">✅ Aktif</span>' : '') + '\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">💳 Ödeme Seçenekleri</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Kullanıcıların ödeme yapabileceği kripto para birimlerini seçin.</div>\n          <div class="payment-methods-grid" id="payment-methods-container">\n            ' + methods.map(function(m) {
              return '<span class="payment-method-chip">\n                ' + m + '\n                <button class="remove-method" onclick="removePaymentMethod(\'' + m + '\')">✕</button>\n              </span>';
            }).join('') + '\n          </div>\n          <div class="add-method-input" style="margin-top:0.75rem;">\n            <input type="text" id="new-method-input" placeholder="ETH" maxlength="10" />\n            <button onclick="addPaymentMethod()">Ekle</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">🎯 İndirim Oranı</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Yıllık plan için indirim oranını belirleyin (yüzde).</div>\n          <div class="price-input-group">\n            <label>İndirim %</label>\n            <input type="number" id="discount-input" value="' + discount + '" min="0" max="90" step="1" />\n            <span class="currency-label">%</span>\n            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:0.5rem;">Öneri: %27-40</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-actions">\n          <button class="btn btn-primary" id="save-prices-btn">💾 Fiyatları Kaydet</button>\n          <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="reset-prices-btn">↺ Varsayılana Dön</button>\n        </div>\n\n        <div style="margin-top:1rem;padding:1rem;background:rgba(139,92,246,0.04);border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid var(--border);">\n          <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;">\n            <strong>📌 Not:</strong> Fiyat değişiklikleri tüm kullanıcılar için geçerli olacaktır. \n            Yeni fiyatlar otomatik olarak ana sayfa, ayarlar sayfası ve NowPayment entegrasyonuna yansıyacaktır.\n          </p>\n        </div>\n      ';

      // ⭐ setYearlyDiscount kontrolü ile kaydetme
      var saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-prices-btn');
      if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var monthlyInput = document.getElementById('price-monthly-input');
          var yearlyInput = document.getElementById('price-yearly-input');
          var discountInput = document.getElementById('discount-input');

          var monthlyVal = parseFloat(monthlyInput ? monthlyInput.value : 0);
          var yearlyVal = parseFloat(yearlyInput ? yearlyInput.value : 0);
          var discountVal = parseFloat(discountInput ? discountInput.value : 0);

          if (!monthlyVal || monthlyVal < 0 || !yearlyVal || yearlyVal < 0 || discountVal < 0 || discountVal > 90) {
            showToast('Geçerli değerler giriniz!', 'error');
            return;
          }

          if (window.setMonthlyPrice) window.setMonthlyPrice(monthlyVal);
          if (window.setYearlyPrice) window.setYearlyPrice(yearlyVal);

          if (window.setYearlyDiscount) {
            window.setYearlyDiscount(discountVal);
          } else {
            try {
              localStorage.setItem('ww_yearly_discount', String(discountVal));
            } catch (e) {}
          }

          var methods = [];
          var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-chip');
          chips.forEach(function(chip) {
            var text = chip.textContent.trim().replace('✕', '').trim();
            if (text) methods.push(text);
          });
          if (methods.length > 0 && window.setPaymentMethods) window.setPaymentMethods(methods);

          showToast('✅ Fiyatlar başarıyla kaydedildi!', 'success');
          var discountDisplay = document.getElementById('discount-display');
          if (discountDisplay) discountDisplay.textContent = discountVal + '%';
          if (window.updateHomePrices) window.updateHomePrices();
        });
      }

      var resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset-prices-btn');
      if (resetBtn) {
        resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (confirm('Varsayılan fiyatlara dönmek istediğinizden emin misiniz?')) {
            if (window.resetPrices) window.resetPrices();
            showToast('↺ Varsayılan fiyatlara dönüldü.', 'success');
            renderPricesContent();
          }
        });
      }
    }

    function addPaymentMethod() {
      var input = document.getElementById('new-method-input');
      if (!input) return;
      var method = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!method) {
        showToast('Lütfen bir kripto para birimi girin (örn: ETH)', 'error');
        return;
      }

      var methods = [];
      var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-chip');
      chips.forEach(function(chip) {
        var text = chip.textContent.trim().replace('✕', '').trim();
        if (text) methods.push(text);
      });

      if (methods.indexOf(method) !== -1) {
        showToast('Bu ödeme metodu zaten ekli!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      methods.push(method);
      if (window.setPaymentMethods) window.setPaymentMethods(methods);
      renderPricesContent();
      showToast('✅ ' + method + ' eklendi!', 'success');
    }

    function removePaymentMethod(method) {
      var methods = [];
      var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-chip');
      chips.forEach(function(chip) {
        var text = chip.textContent.trim().replace('✕', '').trim();
        if (text && text !== method) methods.push(text);
      });

      if (methods.length === 0) {
        showToast('En az bir ödeme metodu olmalıdır!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      if (window.setPaymentMethods) window.setPaymentMethods(methods);
      renderPricesContent();
      showToast('🗑️ ' + method + ' kaldırıldı.', 'success');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // ANALYTICS DATA - Premium gelir hesaplaması düzeltildi
    // ============================================================
    async function loadAnalyticsData() {
      try {
        var today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        var last7 = [];
        for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
          var d = new Date();
          d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
          last7.push(d.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
        }

        var { data: profiles } = await sb.from('user_profiles').select('*');
        var { data: trades } = await sb.from('trades').select('id, created_at');

        var profileList = profiles || [];
        var tradeList = trades || [];

        // ⭐ Premium kullanıcılar - süresi dolmamış olanlar
        var premiumUsers = profileList.filter(function(p) {
          return p.plan === 'premium' && p.plan_expires_at && new Date(p.plan_expires_at) > new Date();
        });
        var totalPremium = premiumUsers.length;

        // ⭐ Toplam premium gelir - DOĞRU HESAPLAMA
        var totalRevenue = 0;
        var revenue7Days = 0;
        var revenueByDay = {};
        var recentPremiumUsers = [];

        profileList.forEach(function(p) {
          if (p.plan === 'premium' && p.plan_expires_at) {
            var expiresAt = new Date(p.plan_expires_at);
            var startDate = new Date(expiresAt);
            startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 30);

            var diffDays = Math.ceil((expiresAt - startDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            var isYearly = diffDays > 31;
            var price = isYearly ? 79 : 9;

            totalRevenue += price;

            var dayKey = startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            if (!revenueByDay[dayKey]) revenueByDay[dayKey] = 0;
            revenueByDay[dayKey] += price;

            var sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
            sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);
            if (startDate >= sevenDaysAgo) {
              revenue7Days += price;
              recentPremiumUsers.push({
                username: p.username || p.email || 'İsimsiz',
                email: p.email || '—',
                plan: isYearly ? 'Yıllık' : 'Aylık',
                amount: price,
                date: startDate,
                avatar_url: p.avatar_url || null
              });
            }
          }
        });

        var revenueData = last7.map(function(d) { return revenueByDay[d] || 0; });
        var uCounts = last7.map(function(d) {
          return profileList.filter(function(p) { return p.created_at && p.created_at.split('T')[0] === d; }).length;
        });
        var premium7Days = recentPremiumUsers.length;

        // ⭐ İstatistikleri güncelle
        var statsEls = {
          'stat-total-users': profileList.length,
          'stat-total-premium': totalPremium,
          'stat-premium-revenue': '$' + totalRevenue.toFixed(2),
          'stat-premium-7days': premium7Days
        };
        Object.keys(statsEls).forEach(function(id) {
          var el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.textContent = statsEls[id];
        });

        var recentContainer = document.getElementById('recent-premium-list');
        if (recentContainer) {
          if (recentPremiumUsers.length === 0) {
            recentContainer.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;">Henüz premium satışı yok.</div>';
          } else {
            recentContainer.innerHTML = recentPremiumUsers.sort(function(a, b) { return b.date - a.date; }).slice(0, 10).map(function(u) {
              var avatarHtml = u.avatar_url
                ? '<img src="' + u.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">'
                : '<span style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">' + getInitials(u.username) + '</span>';

              return '\n              <div class="recent-premium-card">\n                <div class="avatar-small">' + avatarHtml + '</div>\n                <div class="info">\n                  <div class="name">' + escapeHtml(u.username) + '</div>\n                  <div class="email">' + escapeHtml(u.email) + '</div>\n                  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;margin-top:2px;">\n                    <span class="plan-type">' + u.plan + '</span>\n                    <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + formatDateFull(u.date) + '</span>\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n                <div class="amount">+$' + u.amount.toFixed(2) + '</div>\n              </div>\n            ';
            }).join('');
          }
        }

        var labels = last7.map(function(d) { return d.slice(5).replace('-', '/'); });
        var chartDefaults = {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(17,17,24,0.95)',
              borderColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.3)',
              borderWidth: 1,
              padding: 10,
              titleFont: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 },
              bodyFont: { family: 'DM Sans', size: 13 }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }, ticks: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 } } },
            y: { grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }, ticks: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 } }, beginAtZero: true }
          }
        };

        if (userChart) { try { userChart.destroy(); } catch(e) {} userChart = null; }
        if (premiumChart) { try { premiumChart.destroy(); } catch(e) {} premiumChart = null; }

        var usersCtx = document.getElementById('usersChart');
        if (usersCtx) {
          userChart = new Chart(usersCtx, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ label: 'Kullanıcı', data: uCounts, backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.2)', borderColor: '#34d399', borderWidth: 2, borderRadius: 6 }] },
            options: chartDefaults
          });
        }

        var premiumCtx = document.getElementById('premiumChart');
        if (premiumCtx) {
          premiumChart = new Chart(premiumCtx, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ label: 'Premium Gelir ($)', data: revenueData, backgroundColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.25)', borderColor: '#7c6dfa', borderWidth: 2, borderRadius: 6 }] },
            options: {
              plugins: {
                legend: { display: true, labels: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 10 } } },
                tooltip: chartDefaults.plugins.tooltip
              },
              scales: {
                x: chartDefaults.scales.x,
                y: { grid: chartDefaults.scales.y.grid, ticks: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 }, callback: function(value) { return '$' + value; } }, beginAtZero: true }
              },
              responsive: true,
              maintainAspectRatio: false
            }
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REFERENCE MODAL FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================
    var currentImageFile = null;

    var uploadBtn = document.getElementById('upload-image-btn');
    if (uploadBtn) {
      uploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var fileInput = document.getElementById('ref-image-file');
        if (fileInput) fileInput.click();
      });
    }

    var fileInput = document.getElementById('ref-image-file');
    if (fileInput) {
      fileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        var f = e.target.files[0];
        if (!f) return;
        if (!f.type.startsWith('image/')) {
          showToast('Geçerli bir resim seçin!', 'error');
          return;
        }
        if (f.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
          showToast('Resim 2MB\'dan küçük olmalı!', 'error');
          return;
        }
        var r = new FileReader();
        r.onload = function(ev) {
          var preview = document.getElementById('ref-image-preview-img');
          if (preview) preview.src = ev.target.result;
        };
        r.readAsDataURL(f);
        currentImageFile = f;
      });
    }

    var removeImageBtn = document.getElementById('remove-image-btn');
    if (removeImageBtn) {
      removeImageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var preview = document.getElementById('ref-image-preview-img');
        if (preview) preview.src = 'https://placehold.co/64x64?text=Photo';
        var refImage = document.getElementById('ref-image');
        if (refImage) refImage.value = '';
        currentImageFile = null;
      });
    }

    async function uploadImage(file) {
      if (!file) return null;
      try {
        var ext = file.name.split('.').pop();
        var path = 'references/' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(7) + '.' + ext;
        var { error } = await sb.storage.from('references-images').upload(path, file);
        if (error) return null;
        var publicUrl = sb.storage.from('references-images').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
        return publicUrl;
      } catch(e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function openReferenceModal(ref) {
      ref = ref || null;
      var m = document.getElementById('ref-modal');
      if (!m) return;

      var idEl = document.getElementById('ref-id');
      var nameEl = document.getElementById('ref-name');
      var titleEl = document.getElementById('ref-title');
      var descEl = document.getElementById('ref-desc');
      var orderEl = document.getElementById('ref-order');
      var activeEl = document.getElementById('ref-active');
      var instaEl = document.getElementById('ref-insta');
      var twitterEl = document.getElementById('ref-twitter');
      var youtubeEl = document.getElementById('ref-youtube');
      var linkedinEl = document.getElementById('ref-linkedin');
      var previewEl = document.getElementById('ref-image-preview-img');
      var imageEl = document.getElementById('ref-image');
      var titleModalEl = document.getElementById('ref-modal-title');

      if (idEl) idEl.value = ref && ref.id ? ref.id : '';
      if (nameEl) nameEl.value = ref && ref.name ? ref.name : '';
      if (titleEl) titleEl.value = ref && ref.title ? ref.title : '';
      if (descEl) descEl.value = ref && ref.description ? ref.description : '';
      if (orderEl) orderEl.value = ref && ref.display_order !== undefined ? ref.display_order : 0;
      if (activeEl) activeEl.value = ref && ref.is_active !== undefined ? ref.is_active : true;
      if (instaEl) instaEl.value = ref && ref.instagram ? ref.instagram : '';
      if (twitterEl) twitterEl.value = ref && ref.twitter ? ref.twitter : '';
      if (youtubeEl) youtubeEl.value = ref && ref.youtube ? ref.youtube : '';
      if (linkedinEl) linkedinEl.value = ref && ref.linkedin ? ref.linkedin : '';
      if (previewEl) previewEl.src = ref && ref.image_url ? ref.image_url : 'https://placehold.co/64x64?text=Photo';
      if (imageEl) imageEl.value = ref && ref.image_url ? ref.image_url : '';
      if (titleModalEl) titleModalEl.textContent = ref ? 'Referans Düzenle' : 'Yeni Referans Ekle';
      m.classList.add('open');
      currentImageFile = null;
    }

    function closeReferenceModal() {
      var m = document.getElementById('ref-modal');
      if (m) m.classList.remove('open');
      currentImageFile = null;
    }

    async function saveReference() {
      var idEl = document.getElementById('ref-id');
      var id = idEl ? idEl.value : '';
      var imageEl = document.getElementById('ref-image');
      var imageUrl = imageEl ? imageEl.value : '';

      if (currentImageFile) {
        var url = await uploadImage(currentImageFile);
        if (url) imageUrl = url;
      }

      var nameEl = document.getElementById('ref-name');
      var titleEl = document.getElementById('ref-title');
      var descEl = document.getElementById('ref-desc');
      var orderEl = document.getElementById('ref-order');
      var activeEl = document.getElementById('ref-active');
      var instaEl = document.getElementById('ref-insta');
      var twitterEl = document.getElementById('ref-twitter');
      var youtubeEl = document.getElementById('ref-youtube');
      var linkedinEl = document.getElementById('ref-linkedin');

      var payload = {
        name: nameEl ? nameEl.value.trim() : '',
        title: titleEl ? titleEl.value.trim() : '',
        description: descEl ? descEl.value.trim() : '',
        image_url: imageUrl,
        display_order: parseInt(orderEl ? orderEl.value : 0) || 0,
        is_active: activeEl ? activeEl.value === 'true' : true,
        instagram: instaEl ? instaEl.value.trim() : '',
        twitter: twitterEl ? twitterEl.value.trim() : '',
        youtube: youtubeEl ? youtubeEl.value.trim() : '',
        linkedin: linkedinEl ? linkedinEl.value.trim() : ''
      };

      if (!payload.name) {
        showToast('İsim alanı zorunludur!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      var result;
      if (id) {
        result = await sb.from('references').update(payload).eq('id', id);
      } else {
        result = await sb.from('references').insert([payload]);
      }

      if (result && result.error) {
        showToast('Kayıt hatası: ' + result.error.message, 'error');
        return;
      }

      showToast(id ? 'Referans güncellendi!' : 'Referans eklendi!');
      closeReferenceModal();
      await loadReferences();
      renderReferencesTable();
    }

    async function editReference(id) {
      var ref = references.find(function(r) { return r.id === id; });
      if (ref) openReferenceModal(ref);
    }

    async function deleteReference(id) {
      if (!confirm('Bu referansı silmek istediğinizden emin misiniz?')) return;
      var { error } = await sb.from('references').delete().eq('id', id);
      if (error) {
        showToast('Silme hatası: ' + error.message, 'error');
        return;
      }
      showToast('Referans silindi!');
      await loadReferences();
      renderReferencesTable();
    }

    var cancelRefBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-ref-btn');
    if (cancelRefBtn) cancelRefBtn.addEventListener('click', closeReferenceModal);

    var saveRefBtn = document.getElementById('save-ref-btn');
    if (saveRefBtn) saveRefBtn.addEventListener('click', saveReference);

    var closeRefModal = document.getElementById('close-ref-modal');
    if (closeRefModal) closeRefModal.addEventListener('click', closeReferenceModal);

    var refModal = document.getElementById('ref-modal');
    if (refModal) {
      refModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target.id === 'ref-modal') closeReferenceModal();
      });
    }

    // Global functions
    window.switchPanel = switchPanel;
    window.addPaymentMethod = addPaymentMethod;
    window.removePaymentMethod = removePaymentMethod;
    window.editReference = editReference;
    window.deleteReference = deleteReference;
    window.openReferenceModal = openReferenceModal;
    window.renderUsersTable = renderUsersTable;
    window.loadUsers = loadUsers;
    window.renderPricesContent = renderPricesContent;
    window.loadAnalyticsData = loadAnalyticsData;
    window.renderReferencesTable = renderReferencesTable;

    // ⭐ INIT - Admin paneli yükle
    (async function() {
      try {
        var user = await requireAdmin();
        if (!user) return;

        await loadReferences();
        await loadUsers();
        renderAdminPanel();
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      WW_CONFIG.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Supabase başlatılamadı', e);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     2) VERİ ÇEKME
     - Kripto: Binance public API, key gerekmiyor.
     - Forex / Hisse / Index: Twelve Data, Supabase Edge Function
       üzerinden ('get-candles') — API key'i Edge Function'da.
     ============================================================ */
  const BINANCE_INTERVAL_MAP = { '15m': '15m', '1h': '1h', '4h': '4h', '1d': '1d' };

  async function fetchBinance(symbol, interval) {
    const iv = BINANCE_INTERVAL_MAP[interval] || '1d';
    const url = `https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=${symbol}&interval=${iv}&limit=300`;
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Binance isteği başarısız (' + res.status + ')');
    const raw = await res.json();
    return raw.map(function (k) {
      return {
        time: Math.floor(k[0] / 1000),
        open: parseFloat(k[1]),
        high: parseFloat(k[2]),
        low: parseFloat(k[3]),
        close: parseFloat(k[4])
      };
    });
  }

  async function fetchTwelveData(symbol, interval) {
    if (!supabaseClient) {
      throw new Error('Forex/hisse/index verisi için Supabase Edge Function bağlantısı gerekiyor.');
    }
    // ⭐ Edge Function üzerinden veri çek - API key server-side'da
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.functions.invoke('get-candles', {
      body: { symbol: symbol, interval: interval }
    });
    if (error) throw error;
    if (!data || !data.values || data.values.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Veri bulunamadı: ' + symbol);
    }
    return data.values.reverse().map(function (v) {
      return {
        time: Math.floor(new Date(v.datetime).getTime() / 1000),
        open: parseFloat(v.open),
        high: parseFloat(v.high),
        low: parseFloat(v.low),
        close: parseFloat(v.close)
      };
    });
  }

  async function fetchCandles(assetClass, symbol, interval) {
    if (assetClass === 'crypto') return fetchBinance(symbol, interval);
    return fetchTwelveData(symbol, interval);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     3) GRAFİK
     ============================================================ */
  const btChartContainer = document.getElementById('bt-chart');
  const btChart = LightweightCharts.createChart(btChartContainer, {
    width: btChartContainer.clientWidth,
    height: 380,
    layout: { background: { color: 'transparent' }, textColor: '#8b8b9e' },
    grid: { vertLines: { color: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.06)' }, horzLines: { color: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.06)' } },
    rightPriceScale: { borderColor: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.12)' },
    timeScale: { borderColor: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.12)' },
    crosshair: { mode: 0 }
  });
  const btSeries = btChart.addCandlestickSeries({
    upColor: '#22c55e', downColor: '#ef4444',
    borderUpColor: '#22c55e', borderDownColor: '#ef4444',
    wickUpColor: '#22c55e', wickDownColor: '#ef4444'
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    btChart.applyOptions({ width: btChartContainer.clientWidth });
  });

  /* ============================================================
     4) REPLAY + POZİSYON MOTORU
     ============================================================ */
  let btFullData = [];
  let btVisibleCount = 0;
  let btPosition = null;
  let btTrades = [];
  let btPlayTimer = null;

  const el = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  const posStatusEl = el('btPosStatus');
  const openPnlEl = el('btOpenPnl');
  const totalPnlEl = el('btTotalPnl');
  const winRateEl = el('btWinRate');
  const tradeCountEl = el('btTradeCount');
  const tradeLogBody = el('btTradeLogBody');
  const emptyState = el('btEmptyState');
  const buyBtn = el('btBuyBtn');
  const sellBtn = el('btSellBtn');
  const closeBtn = el('btCloseBtn');
  const playBtn = el('btPlayBtn');
  const statusBanner = el('btStatusBanner');
  const dataBadge = el('btDataBadge');

  function showStatus(msg, isError) {
    statusBanner.textContent = msg;
    statusBanner.className = 'bt-status-banner show' + (isError ? ' error' : '');
  }
  function hideStatus() { statusBanner.className = 'bt-status-banner'; }

  function currentBar() { return btFullData[btVisibleCount - 1]; }

  function openPosition(side) {
    if (btPosition || btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length) return;
    const entry = currentBar().close;
    const tpPct = parseFloat(el('btTpPct').value) || 2;
    const slPct = parseFloat(el('btSlPct').value) || 1;
    let tp, sl;
    if (side === 'long') {
      tp = entry * (1 + tpPct / 100);
      sl = entry * (1 - slPct / 100);
    } else {
      tp = entry * (1 - tpPct / 100);
      sl = entry * (1 + slPct / 100);
    }
    btPosition = { side: side, entry: entry, tp: tp, sl: sl, entryIndex: btVisibleCount - 1 };
    render();
  }

  function pnlPct(exitPrice) {
    if (!btPosition) return 0;
    const raw = btPosition.side === 'long'
      ? (exitPrice - btPosition.entry) / btPosition.entry
      : (btPosition.entry - exitPrice) / btPosition.entry;
    return raw * 100;
  }

  async function closePosition(exitPrice, reason) {
    if (!btPosition) return;
    const pnl = pnlPct(exitPrice);
    const trade = {
      side: btPosition.side,
      entry: btPosition.entry,
      exit: exitPrice,
      entryTime: btFullData[btPosition.entryIndex].time,
      exitTime: currentBar().time,
      pnl: pnl,
      reason: reason
    };
    btTrades.push(trade);
    btPosition = null;
    render();
    await saveTradeToSupabase(trade);
  }

  async function saveTradeToSupabase(trade) {
    if (!supabaseClient) return;
    try {
      const { data: userData } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();
      const userId = userData && userData.user ? userData.user.id : null;
      if (!userId) return;
      await supabaseClient.from('backtest_trades').insert({
        user_id: userId,
        symbol: el('btSymbol').value,
        side: trade.side,
        entry_price: trade.entry,
        exit_price: trade.exit,
        entry_time: new Date(trade.entryTime * 1000).toISOString(),
        exit_time: new Date(trade.exitTime * 1000).toISOString(),
        pnl_pct: trade.pnl,
        exit_reason: trade.reason
      });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('Trade Supabase\'e kaydedilemedi', e); }
  }

  function checkAutoExit(bar) {
    if (!btPosition) return;
    if (btPosition.side === 'long') {
      if (bar.low <= btPosition.sl) { closePosition(btPosition.sl, 'SL'); return; }
      if (bar.high >= btPosition.tp) { closePosition(btPosition.tp, 'TP'); return; }
    } else {
      if (bar.high >= btPosition.sl) { closePosition(btPosition.sl, 'SL'); return; }
      if (bar.low <= btPosition.tp) { closePosition(btPosition.tp, 'TP'); return; }
    }
  }

  function step() {
    if (btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length) { pause(); return; }
    const bar = btFullData[btVisibleCount];
    btSeries.update(bar);
    btVisibleCount++;
    checkAutoExit(bar);
    render();
  }

  function play() {
    if (btPlayTimer || btFullData.length === 0) return;
    playBtn.textContent = '⏸ Duraklat';
    const speed = parseInt(el('btSpeed').value, 10);
    btPlayTimer = setInterval(step, speed);
  }
  function pause() {
    clearInterval(btPlayTimer);
    btPlayTimer = null;
    playBtn.textContent = '▶ Oynat';
  }

  function fmtPct(v) { return (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(2) + '%'; }

  function render() {
    if (btFullData.length === 0) {
      posStatusEl.textContent = 'Yok';
      buyBtn.disabled = true; sellBtn.disabled = true; closeBtn.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    const bar = currentBar();
    if (btPosition) {
      const live = pnlPct(bar.close);
      posStatusEl.textContent = (btPosition.side === 'long' ? 'Long' : 'Short') + ' @ ' + btPosition.entry.toFixed(2);
      openPnlEl.textContent = fmtPct(live);
      openPnlEl.className = 'stat-value ' + (live >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
      buyBtn.disabled = true; sellBtn.disabled = true; closeBtn.disabled = false;
    } else {
      posStatusEl.textContent = 'Yok';
      openPnlEl.textContent = '–';
      openPnlEl.className = 'stat-value';
      buyBtn.disabled = btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length;
      sellBtn.disabled = btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length;
      closeBtn.disabled = true;
    }

    const totalPnl = btTrades.reduce(function (sum, t) { return sum + t.pnl; }, 0);
    totalPnlEl.textContent = fmtPct(totalPnl);
    totalPnlEl.className = 'stat-value ' + (totalPnl > 0 ? 'positive' : (totalPnl < 0 ? 'negative' : ''));

    tradeCountEl.textContent = btTrades.length;

    if (btTrades.length > 0) {
      const wins = btTrades.filter(function (t) { return t.pnl > 0; }).length;
      winRateEl.textContent = Math.round((wins / btTrades.length) * 100) + '%';
    } else {
      winRateEl.textContent = '–';
    }

    if (btTrades.length === 0) {
      tradeLogBody.innerHTML = '';
      emptyState.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      emptyState.style.display = 'none';
      tradeLogBody.innerHTML = btTrades.slice().reverse().map(function (t) {
        const pnlClass = t.pnl >= 0 ? 'trade-pnl positive' : 'trade-pnl negative';
        const badgeClass = t.side === 'long' ? 'badge badge-long' : 'badge badge-short';
        const sideLabel = t.side === 'long' ? 'LONG' : 'SHORT';
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td><span class="' + badgeClass + '">' + sideLabel + '</span></td>' +
          '<td>' + t.entry.toFixed(2) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + t.exit.toFixed(2) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + t.reason + '</td>' +
          '<td class="' + pnlClass + '">' + fmtPct(t.pnl) + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     5) EVENT BAĞLANTILARI
     ============================================================ */
  el('btLoadBtn').addEventListener('click', async function () {
    pause();
    hideStatus();
    const assetClass = el('btAssetClass').value;
    const symbol = el('btSymbol').value.trim();
    const interval = el('btInterval').value;
    if (!symbol) { showStatus('Bir sembol gir.', true); return; }

    this.disabled = true;
    this.textContent = 'Yükleniyor…';
    try {
      const data = await fetchCandles(assetClass, symbol, interval);
      if (!data || data.length < 30) throw new Error('Yeterli veri gelmedi.');
      btFullData = data;
      btVisibleCount = Math.min(60, btFullData.length - 1);
      btPosition = null;
      btTrades = [];
      btSeries.setData(btFullData.slice(0, btVisibleCount));
      render();
      dataBadge.textContent = symbol + ' · ' + btFullData.length + ' bar';
      showStatus(symbol + ' için ' + btFullData.length + ' bar yüklendi. Oynat veya adım adım ilerlet.');
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message || 'Veri çekilemedi.', true);
    } finally {
      this.disabled = false;
      this.textContent = 'Veriyi yükle';
    }
  });

  el('btStepBtn').addEventListener('click', step);
  el('btResetBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    pause();
    if (btFullData.length === 0) return;
    btVisibleCount = Math.min(60, btFullData.length - 1);
    btPosition = null;
    btTrades = [];
    btSeries.setData(btFullData.slice(0, btVisibleCount));
    render();
  });
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (btPlayTimer) pause(); else play(); });
  el('btSpeed').addEventListener('input', function () { if (btPlayTimer) { pause(); play(); } });
  buyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { openPosition('long'); });
  sellBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { openPosition('short'); });
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (btPosition) closePosition(currentBar().close, 'Manuel'); });

  render();
  </script>

</body>
</html>
```
