      min-height: 80px;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cal-day:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      transform: scale(1.02);
      z-index: 2;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
    }
    .cal-day:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .cal-day.weekend-cell {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface2) 92%, var(--accent2) 8%);
    }
    .cal-day .day-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      border-radius: 10px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .cal-day .day-bg.show {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .cal-day .day-bg.glow {
      filter: blur(2px);
    }

    .cal-day .day-number {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 500;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .cal-day .day-trade-count {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* PnL Bar */
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 10%;
      right: 10%;
      height: 2.5px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
      transform: scaleX(0.3);
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar.positive {
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green-glow);
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar.negative {
      background: var(--red);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--red-glow);
    }

    /* Bugün - basit ve sağlam border */
    .cal-day.today {
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.2), inset 0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.03);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
    }
    .cal-day.today .day-number {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* Renk skalası */
    .cal-day.color-0 .day-bg { background: transparent; }
    .cal-day.color-1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.08), rgba(34,197,94,0.02)); }
    .cal-day.color-2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.16), rgba(34,197,94,0.04)); }
    .cal-day.color-3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.28), rgba(34,197,94,0.06)); }
    .cal-day.color-4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.45), rgba(34,197,94,0.1)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.08), rgba(239,68,68,0.02)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.16), rgba(239,68,68,0.04)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.28), rgba(239,68,68,0.06)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.45), rgba(239,68,68,0.1)); }

    /* Boş günler */
    .cal-day.empty {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: default;
      min-height: 60px;
    }
    .cal-day.empty:hover {
      transform: none;
      border-color: transparent;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .cal-day.empty .day-texture {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 8px 8px;
      opacity: 0.1;
      pointer-events: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    /* Renk skalası lejantı */
    .cal-legend {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .cal-legend .legend-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3px;
    }
    .cal-legend .legend-swatch {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .cal-legend .legend-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-left: 2px;
    }

    /* Özet Kartları - Gerçek */
    .calendar-summary-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    /* Özet Kartları - Skeleton */
    .calendar-summary-skeleton {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      min-height: 52px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line {
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 99px;
      opacity: 0.3;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line:last-child {
      width: 60%;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .summary-mini-card {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.trades {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.12);
      color: var(--accent2);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.pnl {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.1);
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.winrate {
      background: rgba(251,191,36,0.1);
      color: var(--yellow);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.best {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.08);
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.worst {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08);
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      line-height: 1.2;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.1;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-subvalue {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    /* Popup */
    .calendar-day-popup {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      min-width: 280px;
      max-width: 380px;
      z-index: 500;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup.active {
      display: block;
      animation: popupIn 0.25s ease;
    }
    @keyframes popupIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-header h4 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-close {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-close:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-body {
      max-height: 300px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 3px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border2);
      border-radius: 99px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter button {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter button:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter button.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      border-color: transparent;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 6px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-badge {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-badge.long {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
      color: var(--green);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-badge.short {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15);
      color: var(--red);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-symbol {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-pnl {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-pnl.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-pnl.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-empty {
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 1.5rem 0;
    }
    .calendar-popup-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 499;
    }
    .calendar-popup-overlay.active {
      display: block;
    }

    /* Açık tema uyumluluğu */
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.06), rgba(16,185,129,0.02)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.14), rgba(16,185,129,0.04)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.24), rgba(16,185,129,0.06)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.4), rgba(16,185,129,0.1)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.06), rgba(239,68,68,0.02)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.14), rgba(239,68,68,0.04)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.24), rgba(239,68,68,0.06)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.4), rgba(239,68,68,0.1)); }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .calendar-page-main {
        padding: 1rem;
      }
      .cal-day {
        min-height: 60px;
        padding: 4px 6px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-number {
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-pnl {
        font-size: 8px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-trade-count {
        font-size: 7px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .cal-header .cal-title {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
      }
      .cal-header .cal-title .cal-icon-wrap {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
      }
      .cal-header .cal-title .cal-icon-wrap svg {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
      }
      .cal-nav-btn.today-btn {
        font-size: 9px;
        padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
      }
      .calendar-day-popup {
        min-width: 220px;
        max-width: 280px;
        padding: 1rem;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .cal-day {
        min-height: 48px;
        padding: 3px 4px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-number {
        font-size: 10px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-pnl {
        font-size: 7px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-trade-count {
        font-size: 6px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .summary-mini-card {
        padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
      }
      .summary-mini-card .s-icon {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
      }
      .summary-mini-card .s-icon svg {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
      }
      .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }
      .cal-day.today {
        border-width: 1.5px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat {
        padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
        min-height: 42px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line {
        height: 6px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>




  <div id="navbar-container"></div>




  <main class="calendar-page-main">


    <div class="calendar-page-header">
      <div>
        <h1 data-i18n="calendar.title">Takvim</h1>
        <p class="subtitle" data-i18n="calendar.subtitle">Tüm işlemlerini ay bazında görüntüle</p>
      </div>
      <a href="dashboard.html" class="back-link" data-i18n="calendar.back_to_dashboard">← Dashboard'a Dön</a>
    </div>

    <div class="calendar-main-card">

      <div class="cal-header">
        <div class="cal-title" style="position:relative;">
          <span class="cal-icon-wrap">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"/>
              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/>
              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/>
              <line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/>
            </svg>
          </span>
          <button type="button" class="cal-title-btn" id="cal-title-btn" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">
            <span id="calendar-month-label">Ocak 2026</span>
            <span class="cal-title-caret">▼</span>
          </button>
          <div class="cal-jump-popover" id="cal-jump-popover">
            <div class="jump-year-row">
              <button type="button" id="jump-year-prev" aria-label="Önceki yıl">‹</button>
              <span class="jump-year-label" id="jump-year-label">2026</span>
              <button type="button" id="jump-year-next" aria-label="Sonraki yıl">›</button>
            </div>
            <div class="jump-months-grid" id="jump-months-grid"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="cal-nav-group">
          <button class="cal-nav-btn" id="cal-prev" aria-label="Önceki ay">‹</button>
          <button class="cal-nav-btn today-btn" id="cal-today" data-i18n="calendar.today">Bugün</button>
          <button class="cal-nav-btn" id="cal-next" aria-label="Sonraki ay">›</button>
        </div>
      </div>


      <div class="cal-day-names" id="cal-day-names">

      </div>


      <div class="cal-grid-skeleton" id="cal-grid-skeleton">
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
      </div>


      <div class="cal-grid" id="cal-grid" style="display:none;">

      </div>


      <div class="cal-legend" id="cal-legend" style="display:none;">
        <div class="legend-group">
          <span class="legend-swatch" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.45);"></span>
          <span class="legend-swatch" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.16);"></span>
          <span class="legend-swatch" style="background:var(--surface2); border:1px solid var(--border);"></span>
          <span class="legend-swatch" style="background:rgba(34,197,94,0.16);"></span>
          <span class="legend-swatch" style="background:rgba(34,197,94,0.45);"></span>
        </div>
        <span class="legend-label">Zarar ← · $0 · → Kâr (eşikler: $100 / $500 / $1000)</span>
      </div>


      <div class="calendar-summary-skeleton" id="calendar-summary-skeleton">
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
      </div>


      <div class="calendar-summary-grid" id="calendar-summary" style="display:none;">
        <div class="summary-mini-card">
          <div class="s-icon trades">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/>
              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/>
              <line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/>
              <line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="s-info">
            <span class="s-label" data-i18n="trades.stats.trade_count">İşlem</span>
            <span class="s-value" id="cal-summary-trades">0</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-mini-card">
          <div class="s-icon pnl">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="s-info">
            <span class="s-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.total_pnl">Toplam K/Z</span>
            <span class="s-value" id="cal-summary-pnl">+$0</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-mini-card">
          <div class="s-icon winrate">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
              <polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="s-info">
            <span class="s-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.win_rate">Win Rate</span>
            <span class="s-value" id="cal-summary-winrate">0%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-mini-card">
          <div class="s-icon best">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <path d="M12 2l3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01L12 2z"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="s-info">
            <span class="s-label" data-i18n="calendar.best_day">En İyi Gün</span>
            <span class="s-value positive" id="cal-summary-best">—</span>
            <span class="s-subvalue" id="cal-summary-best-date"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="summary-mini-card">
          <div class="s-icon worst">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
              <path d="M12 2l3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01L12 2z"/>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="s-info">
            <span class="s-label" data-i18n="calendar.worst_day">En Kötü Gün</span>
            <span class="s-value negative" id="cal-summary-worst">—</span>
            <span class="s-subvalue" id="cal-summary-worst-date"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </main>




  <div class="calendar-popup-overlay" id="calendar-popup-overlay"></div>
  <div class="calendar-day-popup" id="calendar-day-popup">
    <div class="popup-header">
      <h4 id="popup-date-title">15 Ocak 2026</h4>
      <button class="popup-close" id="popup-close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="popup-filter" id="popup-filter" style="display:none;">
      <button type="button" class="active" data-filter="all">Tümü</button>
      <button type="button" data-filter="long">Long</button>
      <button type="button" data-filter="short">Short</button>
    </div>
    <div class="popup-body" id="popup-body"></div>
  </div>




  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
  <script src="config.js"></script>
  <script src="i18n.js"></script>
  <script src="script.js"></script>
  <script src="/components/navbar.js"></script>
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (typeof loadNavbar === 'function') {
        loadNavbar('navbar-container');
      }
    });
  </script>
  <script>
    (function() {
      // ============================================================
      // ENSTRÜMAN ÇARPANLARI
      // ============================================================
      var INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS = {
        forex:  100000,
        gold:   100,
        index:  10,
        crypto: 1,
        other:  1
      };

      // ============================================================
      // PnL HESAPLAMA
      // ============================================================
      function calcTradePnL(t) {
        try {
          if (!t.entry_price || !t.exit_price || !t.lot) return 0;
          var mult = t.multiplier || INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[t.instrument] || 100000;
          var dir = (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY') ? 1 : -1;
          return dir * (parseFloat(t.exit_price) - parseFloat(t.entry_price)) * parseFloat(t.lot) * mult;
        } catch(e) {
          return 0;
        }
      }

      // ============================================================
      // FORMAT FONKSİYONLARI - DÜZELTİLDİ
      // ============================================================

      // Ana para birimi formatı - tüm sayfalarda tutarlı
      function formatCurrency(value) {
        try {
          var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
          var currency = (typeof getCurrencySymbol === 'function') ? getCurrencySymbol() : '$';
          var absNum = Math.abs(num);
          var formatted = absNum.toFixed(2);
          // Binlik ayıraç ekle (nokta ile)
          var parts = formatted.split('.');
          parts[0] = parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
          formatted = parts.join(',');
          return (num >= 0 ? '+' : '-') + currency + formatted;
        } catch(e) {
          return (value >= 0 ? '+' : '') + value.toFixed(2);
        }
      }

      // Kısa PnL formatı - gün kartlarında kullanılır
      function formatShortPnL(value) {
        try {
          var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
          var absVal = Math.abs(num);
          var formatted;
          if (absVal >= 1000000) {
            formatted = (absVal / 1000000).toFixed(2) + 'M';
          } else if (absVal >= 1000) {
            formatted = (absVal / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
          } else if (absVal >= 100) {
            formatted = absVal.toFixed(0);
          } else if (absVal >= 1) {
            formatted = absVal.toFixed(1);
          } else {
            formatted = absVal.toFixed(2);
          }
          return (num > 0 ? '+' : (num < 0 ? '-' : '')) + formatted;
        } catch(e) {
          return '';
        }
      }

      // ============================================================
      // TEMA DEĞİŞİMİ
      // ============================================================
      var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
          if (mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
            if (typeof renderCalendar === 'function') renderCalendar();
          }
        });
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true });

      // ============================================================
      // SKELETON GÖSTER/GİZLE
      // ============================================================
      function showCalendarSkeleton() {
        var el1 = document.getElementById('cal-grid-skeleton');
        var el2 = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
        var el3 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary-skeleton');
        var el4 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary');
        var el5 = document.getElementById('cal-legend');

        if (el1) el1.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el2) el2.style.display = 'none';
        if (el3) el3.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el4) el4.style.display = 'none';
        if (el5) el5.style.display = 'none';
      }

      function hideCalendarSkeleton() {
        var el1 = document.getElementById('cal-grid-skeleton');
        var el2 = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
        var el3 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary-skeleton');
        var el4 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary');
        var el5 = document.getElementById('cal-legend');

        if (el1) el1.style.display = 'none';
        if (el2) el2.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el3) el3.style.display = 'none';
        if (el4) el4.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el5) el5.style.display = 'flex';
      }

      // ============================================================
      // TAKVİM FONKSİYONLARI
      // ============================================================

      var calendarTrades = [];
      var currentMonth = new Date().getMonth();
      var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      var jumpPopoverYear = currentYear;
      var lastNavDirection = null;

      function getMonthName(month, lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Ocak', 'Şubat', 'Mart', 'Nisan', 'Mayıs', 'Haziran', 'Temmuz', 'Ağustos', 'Eylül', 'Ekim', 'Kasım', 'Aralık'],
          en: ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'],
          de: ['Januar', 'Februar', 'März', 'April', 'Mai', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'August', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Dezember']
        };
        return (names[lang] || names.en)[month];
      }

      function getMonthNameShort(month, lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Oca', 'Şub', 'Mar', 'Nis', 'May', 'Haz', 'Tem', 'Ağu', 'Eyl', 'Eki', 'Kas', 'Ara'],
          en: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'],
          de: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mär', 'Apr', 'Mai', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Dez']
        };
        return (names[lang] || names.en)[month];
      }

      function getDayNames(lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Pzt', 'Sal', 'Çar', 'Per', 'Cum', 'Cmt', 'Paz'],
          en: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
          de: ['Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'So']
        };
        return names[lang] || names.en;
      }

      var calendarRenderTimeout = null;

      function renderCalendar() {
        try {
          hideCalendarSkeleton();

          var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
          var monthLabel = document.getElementById('calendar-month-label');
          var dayNamesContainer = document.getElementById('cal-day-names');
          var grid = document.getElementById('cal-grid');

          var monthName = getMonthName(currentMonth, lang);
          if (monthLabel) monthLabel.textContent = monthName + ' ' + currentYear;

          var firstDay = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, 1);

          var dayNames = getDayNames(lang);
          if (dayNamesContainer) {
            dayNamesContainer.innerHTML = dayNames.map(function(name, idx) {
              var weekendClass = (idx === 5 || idx === 6) ? ' weekend' : '';
              return '<div class="dname' + weekendClass + '">' + name + '</div>';
            }).join('');
          }

          var daysInMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
          var firstDayOfWeek = firstDay.getDay();
          var startOffset = firstDayOfWeek === 0 ? 6 : firstDayOfWeek - 1;

          var html = '';
          var totalTrades = 0;
          var totalPnl = 0;
          var wins = 0;
          var bestDay = { date: '', pnl: -Infinity };
          var worstDay = { date: '', pnl: Infinity };
          var anyTradedDay = false;
          var maxPnl = 0;

          for (var i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) {
            html += '<div class="cal-day empty"><div class="day-texture"></div></div>';
          }

          for (var d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
            var dateObj = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, d);
            var dateStr = dateObj.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            var isToday = dateStr === new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            var dow = dateObj.getDay();
            var isWeekend = (dow === 0 || dow === 6);

            var dayTrades = calendarTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.trade_date === dateStr; });
            var hasTrade = dayTrades.length > 0;

            var dayPnl = 0;
            for (var j = 0; j < dayTrades.length; j++) {
              var t = dayTrades[j];
              if (t.exit_price) {
                var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
                dayPnl += pnl;
              }
            }

            totalTrades += dayTrades.length;
            totalPnl += dayPnl;
            if (dayPnl > 0) wins++;
            if (hasTrade) {
              anyTradedDay = true;
              if (dayPnl > bestDay.pnl) bestDay = { date: dateStr, pnl: dayPnl };
              if (dayPnl < worstDay.pnl) worstDay = { date: dateStr, pnl: dayPnl };
              if (Math.abs(dayPnl) > maxPnl) maxPnl = Math.abs(dayPnl);
            }

            var colorClass = '';
            if (hasTrade && dayPnl > 0) {
              var absPnl = Math.abs(dayPnl);
              if (absPnl > 1000) colorClass = 'color-4';
              else if (absPnl > 500) colorClass = 'color-3';
              else if (absPnl > 100) colorClass = 'color-2';
              else colorClass = 'color-1';
            } else if (hasTrade && dayPnl < 0) {
              var absPnl2 = Math.abs(dayPnl);
              if (absPnl2 > 1000) colorClass = 'color-neg4';
              else if (absPnl2 > 500) colorClass = 'color-neg3';
              else if (absPnl2 > 100) colorClass = 'color-neg2';
              else colorClass = 'color-neg1';
            }

            var todayClass = isToday ? 'today' : '';
            var weekendClass2 = isWeekend ? 'weekend-cell' : '';

            // Kısa PnL gösterimi - DÜZELTİLDİ
            var pnlDisplay = '';
            if (hasTrade && dayPnl !== 0) {
              pnlDisplay = formatShortPnL(dayPnl);
            }
            var pnlClass = dayPnl > 0 ? 'positive' : (dayPnl < 0 ? 'negative' : '');
            var barClass = dayPnl > 0 ? 'positive' : (dayPnl < 0 ? 'negative' : '');

            var tradeCountText = hasTrade ? (dayTrades.length + ' ' + i18n.t('trades.stats.trade_count')) : '';
            var ariaLabel = d + ' ' + monthName + (hasTrade ? ', ' + dayTrades.length + ' işlem, ' + pnlDisplay : ', işlem yok');

            html += '\n            <div class="cal-day ' + colorClass + ' ' + todayClass + ' ' + weekendClass2 + '" data-date="' + dateStr + '" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="' + ariaLabel + '" onclick="openDayPopup(\'' + dateStr + '\')" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'||event.key===\' \'){event.preventDefault();openDayPopup(\'' + dateStr + '\');}">\n              <div class="day-bg ' + (colorClass ? 'show' : '') + '"></div>\n              <div class="day-bg glow ' + (colorClass ? 'show' : '') + '"></div>\n              <div class="day-number">' + d + '</div>\n              ' + (pnlDisplay ? '<div class="day-pnl ' + pnlClass + '">' + pnlDisplay + '</div>' : '') + '\n              ' + (tradeCountText ? '<div class="day-trade-count">' + tradeCountText + '</div>' : '') + '\n              <div class="day-pnl-bar ' + (hasTrade ? 'show' : '') + ' ' + barClass + '"></div>\n            </div>\n          ';
          }

          if (grid) {
            grid.innerHTML = html;
            grid.classList.remove('anim-left', 'anim-right');
            if (lastNavDirection === 'left' || lastNavDirection === 'right') {
              void grid.offsetWidth;
              grid.classList.add(lastNavDirection === 'left' ? 'anim-left' : 'anim-right');
            }
            lastNavDirection = null;
          }

          var winRate = totalTrades > 0 ? Math.round((wins / totalTrades) * 100) : 0;
          var tradesEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-trades');
          if (tradesEl) tradesEl.textContent = totalTrades;

          var pnlEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-pnl');
          if (pnlEl) {
            pnlEl.textContent = formatCurrency(totalPnl);
            pnlEl.className = 's-value' + (totalPnl >= 0 ? ' positive' : ' negative');
          }

          var winrateEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-winrate');
          if (winrateEl) winrateEl.textContent = winRate + '%';

          var bestEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-best');
          var bestDateEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-best-date');
          if (bestEl) bestEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatCurrency(bestDay.pnl) : '—';
          if (bestDateEl) bestDateEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatDayLabel(bestDay.date, lang) : '';

          var worstEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-worst');
          var worstDateEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-worst-date');
          if (worstEl) worstEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatCurrency(worstDay.pnl) : '—';
          if (worstDateEl) worstDateEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatDayLabel(worstDay.date, lang) : '';
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn('renderCalendar hatası:', e);
        }
      }

      function formatDayLabel(dateStr, lang) {
        try {
          var d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
          return d.getDate() + ' ' + getMonthNameShort(d.getMonth(), lang);
        } catch(e) {
          return '';
        }
      }

      var currentPopupFilter = 'all';
      var currentPopupDateTrades = [];

      function renderPopupTrades() {
        var body = document.getElementById('popup-body');
        if (!body) return;
        var filtered = currentPopupDateTrades.filter(function(t) {
          if (currentPopupFilter === 'all') return true;
          var isLong = (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY');
          return currentPopupFilter === 'long' ? isLong : !isLong;
        });
        if (filtered.length === 0) {
          body.innerHTML = '<div class="popup-empty">' + i18n.t('calendar.no_trades') + '</div>';
          return;
        }
        body.innerHTML = filtered.map(function(t) {
          var pnl = t.exit_price ? calcTradePnL(t) : null;
          var pnlText = pnl !== null ? formatCurrency(pnl) : i18n.t('trades.open');
          var pnlClass = pnl !== null ? (pnl >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative') : '';
          var isLong = t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY';
          var badgeClass = isLong ? 'long' : 'short';
          var badgeText = isLong ? 'L' : 'S';
          return '<div class="popup-trade">\n              <div class="pt-left">\n                <span class="pt-badge ' + badgeClass + '">' + badgeText + '</span>\n                <span class="pt-symbol">' + (t.symbol || '—') + '</span>\n              </div>\n              <span class="pt-pnl ' + pnlClass + '">' + pnlText + '</span>\n            </div>';
        }).join('');
      }

      function openDayPopup(dateStr) {
        try {
          var overlay = document.getElementById('calendar-popup-overlay');
          var popup = document.getElementById('calendar-day-popup');
          var title = document.getElementById('popup-date-title');
          var filterBar = document.getElementById('popup-filter');

          var date = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
          var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
          if (title) title.textContent = date.toLocaleDateString(lang, { day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });

          currentPopupDateTrades = calendarTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.trade_date === dateStr; });
          currentPopupFilter = 'all';

          if (filterBar) {
            filterBar.style.display = currentPopupDateTrades.length > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
            var btns = filterBar.querySelectorAll('button');
            btns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-filter') === 'all'); });
          }

          renderPopupTrades();

          if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');
          if (popup) popup.classList.add('active');
        } catch(e) {}
      }
      window.openDayPopup = openDayPopup;

      function closeDayPopup() {
        var overlay = document.getElementById('calendar-popup-overlay');
        var popup = document.getElementById('calendar-day-popup');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');
        if (popup) popup.classList.remove('active');
      }

      var closeBtn = document.getElementById('popup-close');
      if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDayPopup);

      var popupOverlay = document.getElementById('calendar-popup-overlay');
      if (popupOverlay) popupOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeDayPopup);

      var popupFilterBar = document.getElementById('popup-filter');
      if (popupFilterBar) {
        popupFilterBar.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          var btn = e.target.closest('button[data-filter]');
          if (!btn) return;
          currentPopupFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
          var btns = popupFilterBar.querySelectorAll('button');
          btns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn); });
          renderPopupTrades();
        });
      }

      // ============================================================
      // AY GEÇİŞİ
      // ============================================================

      function goToMonth(month, year, direction) {
        currentMonth = month;
        currentYear = year;
        lastNavDirection = direction || null;
        showCalendarSkeleton();
        if (calendarRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(calendarRenderTimeout);
        calendarRenderTimeout = setTimeout(renderCalendar, 180);
      }

      var prevBtn = document.getElementById('cal-prev');
      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var m = currentMonth, y = currentYear;
          if (m === 0) { m = 11; y--; } else { m--; }
          goToMonth(m, y, 'right');
        });
      }

      var nextBtn = document.getElementById('cal-next');
      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var m = currentMonth, y = currentYear;
          if (m === 11) { m = 0; y++; } else { m++; }
          goToMonth(m, y, 'left');
        });
      }

      var todayBtn = document.getElementById('cal-today');
      if (todayBtn) {
        todayBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var today = new Date();
          var dir = (today.getFullYear() > currentYear || (today.getFullYear() === currentYear && today.getMonth() > currentMonth)) ? 'left' : (today.getFullYear() < currentYear || (today.getFullYear() === currentYear && today.getMonth() < currentMonth)) ? 'right' : null;
          goToMonth(today.getMonth(), today.getFullYear(), dir);
        });
      }

      // Mobilde kaydırarak ay değiştirme
      (function() {
        var grid = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
        if (!grid) return;
        var touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0, touching = false;

        grid.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
          if (!e.touches || !e.touches.length) return;
          touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
          touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
          touching = true;
        }, { passive: true });

        grid.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
          if (!touching) return;
          touching = false;
          var touch = (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) || null;
          if (!touch) return;
          var dx = touch.clientX - touchStartX;
          var dy = touch.clientY - touchStartY;
          if (Math.abs(dx) < 50 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) return;
          if (dx < 0) {
            if (nextBtn) nextBtn.click();
          } else {
            if (prevBtn) prevBtn.click();
          }
        }, { passive: true });
      })();

      // Ay/Yıl hızlı seçici popover
      (function() {
        var titleBtn = document.getElementById('cal-title-btn');
        var popover = document.getElementById('cal-jump-popover');
        var yearLabel = document.getElementById('jump-year-label');
        var monthsGrid = document.getElementById('jump-months-grid');
        var yearPrev = document.getElementById('jump-year-prev');
        var yearNext = document.getElementById('jump-year-next');
        if (!titleBtn || !popover) return;

        function renderMonthsGrid() {
          if (!yearLabel || !monthsGrid) return;
          yearLabel.textContent = jumpPopoverYear;
          var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
          var html = '';
          for (var m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
            var isCurrent = (m === currentMonth && jumpPopoverYear === currentYear);
            html += '<button type="button" class="jump-month-btn' + (isCurrent ? ' current' : '') + '" data-month="' + m + '">' + getMonthNameShort(m, lang) + '</button>';
          }
          monthsGrid.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function openPopover() {
          jumpPopoverYear = currentYear;
          renderMonthsGrid();
          popover.classList.add('open');
          titleBtn.classList.add('open');
          titleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
        function closePopover() {
          popover.classList.remove('open');
          titleBtn.classList.remove('open');
          titleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }

        titleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (popover.classList.contains('open')) closePopover(); else openPopover();
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (!popover.contains(e.target) && e.target !== titleBtn) closePopover();
        });
        popover.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

        if (yearPrev) yearPrev.addEventListener('click', function() { jumpPopoverYear--; renderMonthsGrid(); });
        if (yearNext) yearNext.addEventListener('click', function() { jumpPopoverYear++; renderMonthsGrid(); });

        if (monthsGrid) {
          monthsGrid.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var btn = e.target.closest('button[data-month]');
            if (!btn) return;
            var m = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-month'), 10);
            var y = jumpPopoverYear;
            var dir = (y > currentYear || (y === currentYear && m > currentMonth)) ? 'left' : (y < currentYear || (y === currentYear && m < currentMonth)) ? 'right' : null;
            goToMonth(m, y, dir);
            closePopover();
          });
        }
      })();

      function loadCalendarTrades(trades) {
        calendarTrades = trades || [];
        showCalendarSkeleton();
        if (calendarRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(calendarRenderTimeout);
        calendarRenderTimeout = setTimeout(renderCalendar, 200);
      }

      // ============================================================
      // AUTH
      // ============================================================

      (async function() {
        try {
          showCalendarSkeleton();

          var user = await requireAuth();
          if (!user) return;

          var { data: trades, error } = await sb
            .from('trades')
            .select('*')
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .order('trade_date', { ascending: true });

          if (error) {
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast(i18n.t('toast.load_error') + error.message, 'error');
            hideCalendarSkeleton();
            return;
          }

          loadCalendarTrades(trades || []);
        } catch (e) {}
      })();

      i18n.onChange(function() {
        renderCalendar();
      });

    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (typeof loadNavbar === 'function') {
        loadNavbar('navbar-container');
        console.log('✅ Navbar yüklendi!');
      } else {
        console.warn('⚠️ loadNavbar fonksiyonu bulunamadı!');
      }

  <script>
    // ⭐ PREMIUM DROPDOWN TOGGLE
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var dropdownBtn = document.getElementById('premium-dropdown-btn');
      var dropdownMenu = document.getElementById('premium-dropdown-menu');

      if (dropdownBtn && dropdownMenu) {
        dropdownBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          this.classList.toggle('active');
          dropdownMenu.classList.toggle('open');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function() {
          dropdownBtn.classList.remove('active');
          dropdownMenu.classList.remove('open');
        });

        dropdownMenu.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
        });
      }
    });

    // 🔔 BİLDİRİM ÇANI TOGGLE
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var bellPanel = document.getElementById('bell-panel');
      var bellClose = document.getElementById('bell-panel-close');

      if (bellBtn && bellPanel) {
        bellBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          bellPanel.classList.toggle('open');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (!bellPanel.contains(e.target) && !bellBtn.contains(e.target)) {
            bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
          }
        });

        bellPanel.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
        });
      }

      if (bellClose && bellPanel) {
        bellClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
          bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
        });
      }

      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (markReadBtn) {
        markReadBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (typeof markOvertradeAsRead === 'function') markOvertradeAsRead();
        });
      }
    });

    // ⭐ PLAN BADGE GÜNCELLEME
    async function updatePlanBadge() {
      var badge = document.getElementById('plan-badge');
      var text = document.getElementById('plan-text');
      if (!badge || !text) return;

      try {
        var planData = await getUserPlan();
        var isPremium = planData.plan === 'premium';

        if (isPremium) {
          badge.classList.add('premium');
          text.textContent = 'Premium';
        } else {
          badge.classList.remove('premium');
          text.textContent = 'Ücretsiz';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      setTimeout(updatePlanBadge, 500);
    });

    i18n.onChange(function() {
      updatePlanBadge();
    });

    (function() {
      // ============================================================
      // ⭐ CHART THEME - OPTİMİZE EDİLDİ
      // ============================================================
      function setChartTheme() {
        var isLightTheme = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');
        if (isLightTheme) {
          Chart.defaults.color = '#1e293b';
          Chart.defaults.borderColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.08)';
        } else {
          Chart.defaults.color = '#e8e8f0';
          Chart.defaults.borderColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
        }
        Chart.defaults.font.family = "'DM Sans', sans-serif";
        Chart.defaults.font.size = 11;
        Chart.defaults.font.weight = '500';

        // ⭐ ANİMASYON SÜRESİNİ KISALT - Göz yormasın!
        Chart.defaults.animation = {
          duration: 300, // 800ms → 300ms
          easing: 'easeOutQuart'
        };
      }

      setChartTheme();

      var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
          if (mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
            setChartTheme();
            // Chart'ları güncelle ama animasyon olmadan
            if (typeof updateCharts === 'function') {
              updateCharts();
            }
          }
        });
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true });

      // ============================================================
      // SKELETON GÖSTER/GİZLE
      // ============================================================

      function showSkeletons() {
        var el1 = document.getElementById('stats-skeleton');
        var el2 = document.getElementById('stats-grid');
        var el3 = document.getElementById('charts-top-skeleton');
        var el4 = document.getElementById('charts-top-grid');
        var el5 = document.getElementById('charts-bottom-skeleton');
        var el6 = document.getElementById('charts-bottom-grid');
        var el7 = document.getElementById('recent-trades-skeleton');
        var el8 = document.getElementById('recent-trades-container-wrap');

        if (el1) el1.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el2) el2.style.display = 'none';
        if (el3) el3.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el4) el4.style.display = 'none';
        if (el5) el5.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el6) el6.style.display = 'none';
        if (el7) el7.style.display = 'block';
        if (el8) el8.style.display = 'none';
      }

      function hideSkeletons() {
        var el1 = document.getElementById('stats-skeleton');
        var el2 = document.getElementById('stats-grid');
        var el3 = document.getElementById('charts-top-skeleton');
        var el4 = document.getElementById('charts-top-grid');
        var el5 = document.getElementById('charts-bottom-skeleton');
        var el6 = document.getElementById('charts-bottom-grid');
        var el7 = document.getElementById('recent-trades-skeleton');
        var el8 = document.getElementById('recent-trades-container-wrap');

        if (el1) el1.style.display = 'none';
        if (el2) el2.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el3) el3.style.display = 'none';
        if (el4) el4.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el5) el5.style.display = 'none';
        if (el6) el6.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el7) el7.style.display = 'none';
        if (el8) el8.style.display = 'block';
      }

      // ============================================================
      // 🔔 OVER TRADE UYARISI
      // ============================================================

      var OVERTRADE_READ_KEY = 'ww_overtrade_read_signature';
      var currentOvertradeSignature = '';

      function bellEmptyStateHtml() {
        var emptyText = (typeof i18n !== 'undefined' && i18n.t('dashboard.bell.empty') !== 'dashboard.bell.empty') ? i18n.t('dashboard.bell.empty') : 'Yeni bildirim yok';
        return '<div class="bell-panel-empty" id="bell-panel-empty"><span class="empty-icon">🔕</span><span>' + emptyText + '</span></div>';
      }

      function showBellEmptyState() {
        var body = document.getElementById('bell-panel-body');
        var dot = document.getElementById('bell-dot');
        var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
        var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
        if (body) body.innerHTML = bellEmptyStateHtml();
        if (dot) dot.style.display = 'none';
        if (bellBtn) bellBtn.classList.remove('has-alert');
        if (markReadBtn) markReadBtn.style.display = 'none';
      }

      async function updateOvertradeBell() {
        var body = document.getElementById('bell-panel-body');
        var dot = document.getElementById('bell-dot');
        var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
        var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
        if (!body) return;

        try {
          if (typeof checkAndRenderOvertrade === 'function') {
            await checkAndRenderOvertrade('bell-panel-body');
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        var rawContent = body.innerHTML || '';
        var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
        tempDiv.innerHTML = rawContent;
        var textContent = tempDiv.textContent || tempDiv.innerText || '';
        var cleanText = textContent.replace(/\s/g, '').trim();
        var hasContent = cleanText.length > 0;

        if (!hasContent) {
          currentOvertradeSignature = '';
          showBellEmptyState();
          return;
        }

        currentOvertradeSignature = textContent.replace(/\s/g, '');
        var readSignature = '';
        try { readSignature = localStorage.getItem(OVERTRADE_READ_KEY) || ''; } catch (e) {}

        if (readSignature && readSignature === currentOvertradeSignature) {
          showBellEmptyState();
          return;
        }

        if (dot) dot.style.display = 'block';
        if (bellBtn) bellBtn.classList.add('has-alert');
        if (markReadBtn) markReadBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
      }

      function markOvertradeAsRead() {
        try {
          if (currentOvertradeSignature) {
            localStorage.setItem(OVERTRADE_READ_KEY, currentOvertradeSignature);
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        showBellEmptyState();
        var bellPanel = document.getElementById('bell-panel');
        if (bellPanel) bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Bildirim okundu olarak işaretlendi');
      }
      window.markOvertradeAsRead = markOvertradeAsRead;

      // ============================================================
      // MİNİ TAKVİM FONKSİYONLARI
      // ============================================================

      var miniCalendarTrades = [];

      function getDayNames(lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Pzt', 'Sal', 'Çar', 'Per', 'Cum', 'Cmt', 'Paz'],
          en: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
          de: ['Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'So']
        };
        return names[lang] || names.en;
      }

      function renderMiniCalendar() {
        var grid = document.getElementById('mini-cal-grid');
        if (!grid) return;

        var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
        var dayNames = getDayNames(lang);

        var today = new Date();
        var currentDay = today.getDay();
        var startOffset = currentDay === 0 ? 6 : currentDay - 1;

        var startDate = new Date(today);
        startDate.setDate(today.getDate() - startOffset);

        var weekDays = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
          var d = new Date(startDate);
          d.setDate(startDate.getDate() + i);
          weekDays.push(d);
        }

        var html = '';
        var totalTrades = 0;
        var totalPnl = 0;

        weekDays.forEach(function(date, index) {
          var dateStr = date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
          var isToday = dateStr === today.toISOString().split('T')[0];

          var dayTrades = miniCalendarTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.trade_date === dateStr; });
          var hasTrade = dayTrades.length > 0;

          var dayPnl = 0;
          dayTrades.forEach(function(t) {
            if (t.exit_price) {
              var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
              dayPnl += pnl;
            }
          });

          totalTrades += dayTrades.length;
          totalPnl += dayPnl;

          var statusClass = 'empty-day';
          var pnlText = '';
          var pnlClass = '';

          if (hasTrade && dayPnl > 0) {
            statusClass = 'win';
            pnlText = '+' + dayPnl.toFixed(0);
            pnlClass = 'positive';
          } else if (hasTrade && dayPnl < 0) {
            statusClass = 'loss';
            pnlText = dayPnl.toFixed(0);
            pnlClass = 'negative';
          }

          if (isToday) statusClass += ' today';

          html += '\n            <div class="mini-cal-day ' + statusClass + '">\n              <span class="day-name">' + dayNames[index] + '</span>\n              <span class="day-number">' + date.getDate() + '</span>\n              ' + (pnlText ? '<span class="day-pnl-small ' + pnlClass + '">' + pnlText + '</span>' : '') + '\n            </div>\n          ';
        });

        grid.innerHTML = html;

        var todayInfo = document.getElementById('mini-cal-today-info');
        var todayStr = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        var todayTrades = miniCalendarTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.trade_date === todayStr; });
        var todayPnl = 0;
        todayTrades.forEach(function(t) {
          if (t.exit_price) todayPnl += calcTradePnL(t);
        });
        var tradeCount = todayTrades.length;
        var pnlText = todayPnl !== 0 ? formatCurrency(todayPnl) : '0';
        if (todayInfo) todayInfo.textContent = i18n.t('dashboard.calendar.today', { count: tradeCount, pnl: pnlText });

        var weekSummary = document.getElementById('mini-cal-week-summary');
        if (weekSummary) weekSummary.textContent = i18n.t('dashboard.calendar.week_summary', { count: totalTrades, pnl: formatCurrency(totalPnl) });
      }

      function loadMiniCalendar(trades) {
        miniCalendarTrades = trades || [];
        renderMiniCalendar();
      }

      var TARGET_STORAGE_KEY = 'ww_monthly_target';

      var allTradesFullStats = [];
      var currentRange = 'all';
      var charts = {};
