    // ============================================================
    // EQUITY CURVE MODALI
    // ============================================================
    function openEquityModal(strategyId) {
      try {
        var s = strategiesList.find(function(x) { return x.id === strategyId; });
        if (!s) return;
        var perf = getStrategyPerformance(s.id);
        if (!perf.pnlSeries.length) return;

        var nameEl = document.getElementById('equity-strategy-name');
        var dotEl = document.getElementById('equity-color-dot');
        if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = s.name + ' — Equity Curve';
        if (dotEl) dotEl.style.background = s.color;

        var modalEl = document.getElementById('equity-curve-modal');
        if (modalEl) modalEl.style.display = 'flex';

        var canvas = document.getElementById('equity-curve-canvas');
        if (!canvas) return;
        if (equityChartInstance) { try { equityChartInstance.destroy(); } catch(e) {} }

        var def = makeChartDefaults();
        var labels = perf.tradesDetail.map(function(t, i) { return fmtDate(t.trade_date); });
        var isNeg = perf.pnlSeries[perf.pnlSeries.length - 1] < 0;
        var lineColor = isNeg ? '#ef4444' : s.color;

        var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        equityChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
          type: 'line',
          data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [{
              label: 'Kümülatif K/Z',
              data: perf.pnlSeries,
              borderColor: lineColor,
              backgroundColor: colorToRgba(lineColor, 0.12),
              borderWidth: 2,
              pointRadius: 2,
              pointHoverRadius: 5,
              tension: 0.3,
              fill: true
            }]
          },
          options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
              legend: { display: false },
              tooltip: {
                backgroundColor: def.plugins ? def.plugins.tooltip.backgroundColor : 'rgba(10,10,15,.95)',
                borderColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.25)',
                borderWidth: 1,
                callbacks: { label: function(ctx2) { return ' ' + formatCurrencySafe(ctx2.raw); } }
              }
            },
            scales: {
              x: { grid: { color: def.scales ? def.scales.x.grid.color : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }, ticks: { font: { size: 9 }, maxRotation: 0, autoSkip: true, maxTicksLimit: 8 } },
              y: { grid: { color: def.scales ? def.scales.y.grid.color : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }, ticks: { callback: function(v) { return formatCurrencySafe(v); } } }
            }
          }
        });
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    function setupDetailAndEquityModals() {
      var detailModal = document.getElementById('strategy-detail-modal');
      var equityModal = document.getElementById('equity-curve-modal');

      ['close-detail-modal', 'close-detail-modal-btn'].forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.addEventListener('click', function() { if (detailModal) detailModal.style.display = 'none'; });
      });
      ['close-equity-modal', 'close-equity-modal-btn'].forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.addEventListener('click', function() { if (equityModal) equityModal.style.display = 'none'; });
      });
      if (detailModal) {
        detailModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === detailModal) detailModal.style.display = 'none'; });
      }
      if (equityModal) {
        equityModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === equityModal) equityModal.style.display = 'none'; });
      }

      var detailCsvBtn = document.getElementById('detail-export-csv');
      if (detailCsvBtn) {
        detailCsvBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (currentDetailStrategyId) exportStrategyCSV(currentDetailStrategyId);
        });
      }
      var detailPdfBtn = document.getElementById('detail-export-pdf');
      if (detailPdfBtn) {
        detailPdfBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (currentDetailStrategyId) exportStrategyPDF(currentDetailStrategyId);
        });
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // CSV / PDF EXPORT - DÜZELTİLDİ (dil desteği)
    // ============================================================
    function downloadBlob(content, filename, mimeType) {
      try {
        var blob = new Blob([content], { type: mimeType });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = filename;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 200);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    function csvEscape(val) {
      var s = (val === null || val === undefined) ? '' : String(val);
      return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
    }

    function getCurrentLanguage() {
      try {
        if (typeof i18n !== 'undefined' && i18n.getCurrentLanguage) {
          return i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
        }
      } catch(e) {}
      return 'en';
    }

    function getLangLabel(lang) {
      var map = { 'tr': 'Türkçe', 'en': 'English', 'de': 'Deutsch' };
      return map[lang] || 'English';
    }

    function exportStrategyCSV(strategyId) {
      try {
        var s = strategiesList.find(function(x) { return x.id === strategyId; });
        var perf = getStrategyPerformance(strategyId);
        var rows = [['Tarih','Sembol','Enstrüman','Yön','Giriş','Çıkış','Lot','K/Z']];
        perf.tradesDetail.forEach(function(t) {
          rows.push([fmtDate(t.trade_date), t.symbol, t.instrument, t.direction, t.entry_price, t.exit_price, t.lot, t.pnl.toFixed(2)]);
        });
        rows.push([]);
        var pfDisplay = (perf.profitFactor === null) ? 'Sonsuz' : perf.profitFactor;
        rows.push(['Özet']);
        rows.push(['Toplam İşlem', perf.totalTradesWithOpen]);
        rows.push(['Win Rate', perf.winRate + '%']);
        rows.push(['Toplam K/Z', perf.totalPnL.toFixed(2)]);
        rows.push(['Profit Factor', pfDisplay]);
        rows.push(['Maks. Drawdown', perf.maxDrawdown.toFixed(2)]);

        var csvContent = rows.map(function(r) { return r.map(csvEscape).join(','); }).join('\r\n');
        downloadBlob('\uFEFF' + csvContent, (s ? s.name : 'strateji') + '_islemler.csv', 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;');
        showToast('CSV indirildi');
      } catch(e) { showToast('CSV oluşturulamadı', 'error'); }
    }

    function exportAllStrategiesCSV() {
      try {
        var rows = [['Strateji','Toplam İşlem','Win Rate','Toplam K/Z','Profit Factor','Ort. R:R','Maks. Drawdown','En İyi Enstrüman']];
        strategiesList.forEach(function(s) {
          var perf = getStrategyPerformance(s.id);
          var bestInst = perf.bestInstrument ? (perf.bestInstrument.instrument + ' ' + perf.bestInstrument.symbol) : '—';
          rows.push([
            s.name,
            perf.totalTradesWithOpen,
            perf.winRate + '%',
            perf.totalPnL.toFixed(2),
            perf.profitFactor === null ? 'Sonsuz' : perf.profitFactor,
            perf.avgRR === null ? 'Sonsuz' : perf.avgRR,
            perf.maxDrawdown.toFixed(2),
            bestInst
          ]);
        });
        var csvContent = rows.map(function(r) { return r.map(csvEscape).join(','); }).join('\r\n');
        downloadBlob('\uFEFF' + csvContent, 'strateji_ozeti.csv', 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;');
        showToast('CSV indirildi');
      } catch(e) { showToast('CSV oluşturulamadı', 'error'); }
    }

    function exportStrategyPDF(strategyId) {
      try {
        var lang = getCurrentLanguage();
        var s = strategiesList.find(function(x) { return x.id === strategyId; });
        var perf = getStrategyPerformance(strategyId);
        var jsPDFCtor = window.jspdf && window.jspdf.jsPDF;
        if (!jsPDFCtor) { showToast('PDF kütüphanesi yüklenemedi', 'error'); return; }
        var doc = new jsPDFCtor();

        var title = (s ? s.name : 'Strategy') + ' - Performance Report';
        var createdLabel = 'Created: ';
        var tradesLabel = 'Total Trades', winRateLabel = 'Win Rate', pnlLabel = 'Total P&L';
        var pfLabel = 'Profit Factor', rrLabel = 'Avg R:R', ddLabel = 'Max Drawdown';
        var winStreakLabel = 'Max Win Streak', lossStreakLabel = 'Max Loss Streak';
        var bestInstLabel = 'Best Instrument';
        var dateLabel = 'Date', symbolLabel = 'Symbol', instrumentLabel = 'Instrument';
        var directionLabel = 'Direction', entryLabel = 'Entry', exitLabel = 'Exit';
        var lotLabel = 'Lot', pnlShortLabel = 'P&L';

        if (lang === 'tr') {
          title = (s ? s.name : 'Strateji') + ' - Performans Raporu';
          createdLabel = 'Oluşturulma: ';
          tradesLabel = 'Toplam İşlem'; winRateLabel = 'Win Rate'; pnlLabel = 'Toplam K/Z';
          pfLabel = 'Profit Factor'; rrLabel = 'Ort. R:R'; ddLabel = 'Maks. Drawdown';
          winStreakLabel = 'Maks. Kazanma Serisi'; lossStreakLabel = 'Maks. Kaybetme Serisi';
          bestInstLabel = 'En İyi Enstrüman';
          dateLabel = 'Tarih'; symbolLabel = 'Sembol'; instrumentLabel = 'Enstrüman';
          directionLabel = 'Yön'; entryLabel = 'Giriş'; exitLabel = 'Çıkış';
          lotLabel = 'Lot'; pnlShortLabel = 'K/Z';
        } else if (lang === 'de') {
          title = (s ? s.name : 'Strategie') + ' - Leistungsbericht';
          createdLabel = 'Erstellt: ';
          tradesLabel = 'Gesamt Trades'; winRateLabel = 'Win-Rate'; pnlLabel = 'Gesamt P&L';
          pfLabel = 'Profit Faktor'; rrLabel = 'Durch. R:R'; ddLabel = 'Max. Drawdown';
          winStreakLabel = 'Max. Gewinnserie'; lossStreakLabel = 'Max. Verlustserie';
          bestInstLabel = 'Bestes Instrument';
          dateLabel = 'Datum'; symbolLabel = 'Symbol'; instrumentLabel = 'Instrument';
          directionLabel = 'Richtung'; entryLabel = 'Einstieg'; exitLabel = 'Ausstieg';
          lotLabel = 'Lot'; pnlShortLabel = 'P&L';
        }

        doc.setFontSize(16);
        doc.text(title, 14, 18);
        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setTextColor(120);
        doc.text(createdLabel + new Date().toLocaleDateString(lang === 'tr' ? 'tr-TR' : (lang === 'de' ? 'de-DE' : 'en-US')), 14, 24);
        doc.setTextColor(0);

        var pfDisplay = (perf.profitFactor === null) ? '∞' : String(perf.profitFactor);
        var rrDisplay = (perf.avgRR === null) ? '∞' : String(perf.avgRR);
        var bestInst = perf.bestInstrument ? (perf.bestInstrument.instrument + ' ' + perf.bestInstrument.symbol) : '—';

        var summaryLines = [
          [tradesLabel, String(perf.totalTradesWithOpen)],
          [winRateLabel, perf.winRate + '%'],
          [pnlLabel, perf.totalPnL.toFixed(2)],
          [pfLabel, pfDisplay],
          [rrLabel, rrDisplay],
          [ddLabel, perf.maxDrawdown.toFixed(2)],
          [winStreakLabel, String(perf.maxWinStreak)],
          [lossStreakLabel, String(perf.maxLossStreak)],
          [bestInstLabel, bestInst]
        ];

        var y = 34;
        doc.setFontSize(10);
        summaryLines.forEach(function(line) {
          doc.text(line[0] + ':', 14, y);
          doc.text(line[1], 80, y);
          y += 6.5;
        });

        if (doc.autoTable) {
          var body = perf.tradesDetail.map(function(t) {
            return [fmtDate(t.trade_date), t.symbol, t.instrument, t.direction, String(t.entry_price != null ? t.entry_price : '-'), String(t.exit_price != null ? t.exit_price : '-'), String(t.lot != null ? t.lot : '-'), t.pnl.toFixed(2)];
          });
          doc.autoTable({
            startY: y + 4,
            head: [[dateLabel, symbolLabel, instrumentLabel, directionLabel, entryLabel, exitLabel, lotLabel, pnlShortLabel]],
            body: body,
            styles: { fontSize: 8, cellPadding: 2 },
            headStyles: { fillColor: [139, 92, 246] },
            margin: { left: 14, right: 14 }
          });
        }

        doc.save((s ? s.name : 'strateji') + '_rapor.pdf');
        showToast('PDF indirildi');
      } catch(e) { showToast('PDF oluşturulamadı', 'error'); }
    }

    function exportAllStrategiesPDF() {
      try {
        var lang = getCurrentLanguage();
        var jsPDFCtor = window.jspdf && window.jspdf.jsPDF;
        if (!jsPDFCtor) { showToast('PDF kütüphanesi yüklenemedi', 'error'); return; }
        var doc = new jsPDFCtor();

        var title = 'Strategy Performance Summary';
        var createdLabel = 'Created: ';
        if (lang === 'tr') {
          title = 'Strateji Performans Özeti';
          createdLabel = 'Oluşturulma: ';
        } else if (lang === 'de') {
          title = 'Strategie-Leistungsübersicht';
          createdLabel = 'Erstellt: ';
        }

        doc.setFontSize(16);
        doc.text(title, 14, 18);
        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setTextColor(120);
        doc.text(createdLabel + new Date().toLocaleDateString(lang === 'tr' ? 'tr-TR' : (lang === 'de' ? 'de-DE' : 'en-US')), 14, 24);
        doc.setTextColor(0);

        var body = strategiesList.map(function(s) {
          var perf = getStrategyPerformance(s.id);
          var bestInst = perf.bestInstrument ? (perf.bestInstrument.instrument + ' ' + perf.bestInstrument.symbol) : '—';
          return [
            s.name,
            String(perf.totalTradesWithOpen),
            perf.winRate + '%',
            perf.totalPnL.toFixed(2),
            perf.profitFactor === null ? '∞' : String(perf.profitFactor),
            perf.maxDrawdown.toFixed(2),
            bestInst
          ];
        });

        if (doc.autoTable) {
          var headers = ['Strategy','Trades','Win Rate','Total P&L','Profit Factor','Max Drawdown','Best Instrument'];
          if (lang === 'tr') {
            headers = ['Strateji','İşlem','Win Rate','Toplam K/Z','Profit Factor','Maks. Drawdown','En İyi Enstrüman'];
          } else if (lang === 'de') {
            headers = ['Strategie','Trades','Win-Rate','Gesamt P&L','Profit Faktor','Max. Drawdown','Bestes Instrument'];
          }
          doc.autoTable({
            startY: 30,
            head: [headers],
            body: body,
            styles: { fontSize: 8, cellPadding: 2 },
            headStyles: { fillColor: [139, 92, 246] },
            margin: { left: 14, right: 14 }
          });
        }

        var filename = 'strateji_ozeti.pdf';
        if (lang === 'tr') filename = 'strateji_ozeti.pdf';
        else if (lang === 'de') filename = 'strategie_zusammenfassung.pdf';
        else filename = 'strategy_summary.pdf';
        doc.save(filename);
        showToast('PDF indirildi');
      } catch(e) { showToast('PDF oluşturulamadı', 'error'); }
    }

    function setupExportButtons() {
      var csvBtn = document.getElementById('export-all-csv');
      if (csvBtn) csvBtn.addEventListener('click', exportAllStrategiesCSV);
      var pdfBtn = document.getElementById('export-all-pdf');
      if (pdfBtn) pdfBtn.addEventListener('click', exportAllStrategiesPDF);
    }

    var addModal = document.getElementById('add-strategy-modal');
    var editModal = document.getElementById('edit-strategy-modal');

    var openAddBtn = document.getElementById('open-add-strategy-modal');
    if (openAddBtn) {
      openAddBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var nameEl = document.getElementById('new-strategy-name');
        var descEl = document.getElementById('new-strategy-desc');
        var colorEl = document.getElementById('new-strategy-color');
        if (nameEl) nameEl.value = '';
        if (descEl) descEl.value = '';
        if (colorEl) colorEl.value = '#8b5cf6';
        if (addModal) addModal.style.display = 'flex';
      });
    }

    var closeAddIds = ['close-add-modal', 'cancel-add-strategy'];
    closeAddIds.forEach(function(id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (addModal) addModal.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
    });

    var closeEditIds = ['close-edit-modal', 'cancel-edit-strategy'];
    closeEditIds.forEach(function(id) {
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (editModal) editModal.style.display = 'none';
        });
      }
    });

    if (addModal) {
      addModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === addModal) addModal.style.display = 'none';
      });
    }

    if (editModal) {
      editModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === editModal) editModal.style.display = 'none';
      });
    }

    var confirmAddBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-add-strategy');
    if (confirmAddBtn) {
      confirmAddBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
        var nameEl = document.getElementById('new-strategy-name');
        var descEl = document.getElementById('new-strategy-desc');
        var colorEl = document.getElementById('new-strategy-color');
        var name = nameEl ? nameEl.value.trim() : '';
        var desc = descEl ? descEl.value.trim() : '';
        var color = colorEl ? colorEl.value : '#8b5cf6';
        if (!name) {
          showToast(i18n.t('strategies.error_name_required'), 'error');
          return;
        }
        var result = await addStrategy(name, desc, color);
        if (result) {
          if (addModal) addModal.style.display = 'none';
          await loadAllData();
        }
      });
    }

    var confirmEditBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-edit-strategy');
    if (confirmEditBtn) {
      confirmEditBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
        var idEl = document.getElementById('edit-strategy-id');
        var nameEl = document.getElementById('edit-strategy-name');
        var descEl = document.getElementById('edit-strategy-desc');
        var colorEl = document.getElementById('edit-strategy-color');
        var id = idEl ? idEl.value : '';
        var name = nameEl ? nameEl.value.trim() : '';
        var desc = descEl ? descEl.value.trim() : '';
        var color = colorEl ? colorEl.value : '#8b5cf6';
        if (!name) {
          showToast(i18n.t('strategies.error_name_required'), 'error');
          return;
        }
        try {
          var { error } = await sb.from('strategies').update({ name: name, description: desc || null, color: color }).eq('id', id);
          if (error) {
            showToast(i18n.t('strategies.error_update') + error.message, 'error');
            return;
          }
          showToast(i18n.t('strategies.updated'));
          if (editModal) editModal.style.display = 'none';
          await loadAllData();
        } catch(e) {}
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MOBILE NAV - KALDIRILDI (navbar.js ile yönetilecek)
    // ============================================================
    // navToggle, navMenu, navBackdrop ile ilgili tüm kodlar kaldırıldı
    // Çünkü navbar artık /components/navbar.js ile yönetiliyor.
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

      <p>Wawe Journal, bireysel trader'lar için kişisel kullanım amacıyla geliştirilmiş bir trading journal platformudur. Hizmetlerimizi kullanarak aşağıdaki şartları kabul etmiş sayılırsınız.</p>

      <h2>2. Hesap Güvenliği</h2>
      <p>Hesap bilgilerinizin güvenliğinden siz sorumlusunuz. Şifrenizi kimseyle paylaşmayın. Hesabınızın yetkisiz kullanımı durumunda derhal bize bildirim yapmalısınız.</p>

      <p>Aşağıdaki aktiviteler kesinlikle yasaktır:</p>

      <p>WaweDev, hizmetleri önceden bildirimde bulunmaksızın güncelleme, değiştirme veya durdurma hakkını saklı tutar. Önemli değişiklikler e-posta ile bildirilecektir.</p>

<!DOCTYPE html>

  <script>
  (function() {
    if (document.body) {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'light') {
        document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
      } else {
        document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
      }
    } else {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
        if (savedTheme === 'light') {
          document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
        } else {
          document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
        }
      });
    }
  })();
  </script>





<script>
  (function() {
    // localStorage'dan kayıtlı dili oku
    var savedLang = localStorage.getItem('ww_language');

    // Kayıtlı dil varsa ve geçerliyse kullan, yoksa varsayılan 'en'
    if (savedLang && ['en', 'tr', 'de'].includes(savedLang)) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', savedLang);
      document.documentElement.lang = savedLang;
      console.log('🌐 [Preload] Dil geri yüklendi:', savedLang);
    } else {
      // Kayıtlı dil yoksa varsayılanı 'en' yap ve localStorage'a kaydet
      localStorage.setItem('ww_language', 'en');
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', 'en');
      document.documentElement.lang = 'en';
      console.log('🌐 [Preload] Varsayılan dil ayarlandı: en');
    }
  })();
</script>

      font-size: 11px;

    }
    .pagination-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .page-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      min-width: 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .page-btn:hover:not(:disabled):not(.active) {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.05);
    }
    .page-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));

    }

      opacity: 0.3;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }
    .page-btn.arrow {
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    }
    .page-btn.ellipsis {
      border: none;
      cursor: default;
      color: var(--muted);
      padding: 0.3rem 0.2rem;
      min-width: 20px;
    }
    .page-btn.ellipsis:hover {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
    }

      .dropdown-menu.show {
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    /* MODAL STILLERI - BASLANGICTA KAPALI */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex !important;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      visibility: hidden;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: visibility 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-overlay.active {
      visibility: visible;
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .modal-overlay .card {
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1001;
    }
    #edit-modal {
      visibility: hidden;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    #edit-modal.active {
      visibility: visible;
      opacity: 1;
    }
    #bulk-modal {
      display: none;
    }
    #bulk-modal.active {
      display: flex !important;
    }

    .btn-bulk-delete {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 0.45rem 1.2rem;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 40px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #fff;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      min-height: 32px;
    }
    .btn-bulk-delete:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.45);
    }
    .btn-bulk-delete:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
    .btn-bulk-delete svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; }
    .btn-bulk-delete:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none !important; }

    .confirm-modal {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      z-index: 1000;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      animation: modalFadeIn 0.3s ease;
    }
    .confirm-modal.active { display: flex; }
    @keyframes modalFadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }
    .confirm-modal-box {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 20px;
      max-width: 420px;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08);
    }
    .confirm-modal-header {
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .confirm-modal-header .icon-wrap {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .confirm-modal-header .icon-wrap svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; stroke: var(--red); stroke-width: 2; }
    .confirm-modal-header h3 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; }
    .confirm-modal-body p {
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body .warning-text {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--red);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .confirm-modal-body .warning-text svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; stroke: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .confirm-modal-footer {
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.25rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-cancel {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 0.45rem 1.4rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-cancel:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.05);
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 40px;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.45rem 1.6rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }
    .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .sel-bar {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
        border-radius: 12px;
      }
      .sel-bar .sel-actions {
        margin-left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: flex-end;
      }
      .confirm-modal-box {
        border-radius: 16px;
      }
      .confirm-modal-header { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; }
      .confirm-modal-body { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; }
      .confirm-modal-footer {
        padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem 1rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-cancel,
      .confirm-modal-footer .btn-modal-danger {
        flex: 1;
        text-align: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .pagination-controls .page-btn {
        font-size: 10px;
        padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
        min-width: 26px;
      }
      .pagination-controls .page-btn.arrow {
        font-size: 12px;
        padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
      }
      .pagination-info {
        font-size: 9px;
      }
    }

    /* SKELETON STILLERI */
    .skeleton-stat {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      min-height: 80px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .skeleton-stat::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .skeleton-stat::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line {
      height: 10px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      opacity: 0.3;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line:last-child {
      width: 60%;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .skeleton-table {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .skeleton-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .skeleton-row .skeleton-cell {
      flex: 1;
      height: 20px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      opacity: 0.15;
      min-height: 20px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .skeleton-row .skeleton-cell::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .skeleton-row .skeleton-cell::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes skeletonShimmer {
      0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
      100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

  <div id="bulk-modal" class="confirm-modal">

            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>

  <div id="edit-modal" class="modal-overlay">

      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;">
        <div class="field">
          <label data-i18n="trades.entry_price">Giriş Fiyatı</label>
          <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" id="edit-entry" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label data-i18n="trades.exit_price">Çıkış Fiyatı</label>
          <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" id="edit-exit" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;">
        <div class="field">
          <label data-i18n="trades.stop_loss">Stop Loss</label>
          <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" id="edit-sl" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label data-i18n="trades.take_profit">Take Profit</label>
          <input type="text" inputmode="decimal" id="edit-tp" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label data-i18n="trades.strategy">Strateji</label>
        <select id="edit-strategy">
          <option value="" data-i18n="addtrade.select_strategy">— Strateji Seç —</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label data-i18n="trades.date">Tarih</label>
        <input type="date" id="edit-date" />
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label data-i18n="trades.notes">Notlar</label>
        <textarea id="edit-notes" rows="2" style="resize:vertical;"></textarea>
      </div>

      <p class="error-msg" id="edit-err" style="display:none;"></p>

      <div style="display:flex;gap:.75rem;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:.5rem;">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="modal-cancel" data-i18n="common.cancel">İptal (ESC)</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" id="modal-save" data-i18n="common.save">Kaydet</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (typeof loadNavbar === 'function') {
        loadNavbar('navbar-container');
      }
    });
  </script>

  <script>
    // ⭐ PREMIUM DROPDOWN TOGGLE
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var dropdownBtn = document.getElementById('premium-dropdown-btn');
      var dropdownMenu = document.getElementById('premium-dropdown-menu');

      if (dropdownBtn && dropdownMenu) {
        dropdownBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          this.classList.toggle('active');
          dropdownMenu.classList.toggle('open');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function() {
          dropdownBtn.classList.remove('active');
          dropdownMenu.classList.remove('open');
        });

        dropdownMenu.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
        });
      }
    });

    // 🔔 BİLDİRİM ÇANI TOGGLE - DASHBOARD İLE AYNI
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var bellPanel = document.getElementById('bell-panel');
      var bellClose = document.getElementById('bell-panel-close');

      if (bellBtn && bellPanel) {
        bellBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          bellPanel.classList.toggle('open');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (!bellPanel.contains(e.target) && !bellBtn.contains(e.target)) {
            bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
          }
        });

        bellPanel.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
        });
      }

      if (bellClose && bellPanel) {
        bellClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
          bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
        });
      }

      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (markReadBtn) {
        markReadBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (typeof markOvertradeAsRead === 'function') markOvertradeAsRead();
        });
      }
    });

    // ⭐ PLAN BADGE GÜNCELLEME
    async function updatePlanBadge() {
      var badge = document.getElementById('plan-badge');
      var text = document.getElementById('plan-text');
      if (!badge || !text) return;

      try {
        var planData = await getUserPlan();
        var isPremium = planData.plan === 'premium';

        if (isPremium) {
          badge.classList.add('premium');
          text.textContent = 'Premium';
        } else {
          badge.classList.remove('premium');
          text.textContent = 'Ücretsiz';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      setTimeout(updatePlanBadge, 500);
    });

    i18n.onChange(function() {
      updatePlanBadge();
    });

    // 🔔 OVER TRADE UYARISI -> BİLDİRİM ÇANI - DASHBOARD İLE AYNI
    var OVERTRADE_READ_KEY = 'ww_overtrade_read_signature';
    var currentOvertradeSignature = '';

    function bellEmptyStateHtml() {
      var emptyText = (typeof i18n !== 'undefined' && i18n.t('dashboard.bell.empty') !== 'dashboard.bell.empty') ? i18n.t('dashboard.bell.empty') : 'Yeni bildirim yok';
      return '<div class="bell-panel-empty" id="bell-panel-empty"><span class="empty-icon">🔕</span><span>' + emptyText + '</span></div>';
    }

    function showBellEmptyState() {
      var body = document.getElementById('bell-panel-body');
      var dot = document.getElementById('bell-dot');
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (body) body.innerHTML = bellEmptyStateHtml();
      if (dot) dot.style.display = 'none';
      if (bellBtn) bellBtn.classList.remove('has-alert');
      if (markReadBtn) markReadBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }

    async function updateOvertradeBell() {
      var body = document.getElementById('bell-panel-body');
      var dot = document.getElementById('bell-dot');
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (!body) return;

      try {
        if (typeof checkAndRenderOvertrade === 'function') {
          await checkAndRenderOvertrade('bell-panel-body');
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      var rawContent = body.innerHTML || '';
      var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
      tempDiv.innerHTML = rawContent;
      var textContent = tempDiv.textContent || tempDiv.innerText || '';
      var cleanText = textContent.replace(/\s/g, '').trim();
      var hasContent = cleanText.length > 0;

      if (!hasContent) {
        currentOvertradeSignature = '';
        showBellEmptyState();
        return;
      }

      currentOvertradeSignature = textContent.replace(/\s/g, '');
      var readSignature = '';
      try { readSignature = localStorage.getItem(OVERTRADE_READ_KEY) || ''; } catch (e) {}

      if (readSignature && readSignature === currentOvertradeSignature) {
        showBellEmptyState();
        return;
      }

      if (dot) dot.style.display = 'block';
      if (bellBtn) bellBtn.classList.add('has-alert');
      if (markReadBtn) markReadBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    }

    function markOvertradeAsRead() {
      try {
        if (currentOvertradeSignature) {
          localStorage.setItem(OVERTRADE_READ_KEY, currentOvertradeSignature);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      showBellEmptyState();
      var bellPanel = document.getElementById('bell-panel');
      if (bellPanel) bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
      if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Bildirim okundu olarak işaretlendi');
    }
    window.markOvertradeAsRead = markOvertradeAsRead;

    var allTrades = [];
    var filteredTrades = [];
    var selectedTrades = new Set();
    var strategyNames = {};
    var strategiesList = [];
    var expandedNotes = new Set();

    // ============================================================
    // PAGINATION DEĞİŞKENLERİ
    // ============================================================
    var PAGE_SIZE = 20;
    var currentPage = 1;
    var totalPages = 1;
    var totalItems = 0;

    // ============================================================
    // SKELETON GÖSTER/GİZLE
    // ============================================================
    function showTableSkeleton() {
      var el1 = document.getElementById('stat-skeleton');
      var el2 = document.getElementById('stat-grid');
      var el3 = document.getElementById('table-skeleton');
      var el4 = document.getElementById('table-wrap');
      var el5 = document.getElementById('pagination-wrap');

      if (el1) el1.style.display = 'grid';
      if (el2) el2.style.display = 'none';
      if (el3) el3.style.display = 'block';
      if (el4) el4.style.display = 'none';
      if (el5) el5.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function hideTableSkeleton() {
      var el1 = document.getElementById('stat-skeleton');
      var el2 = document.getElementById('stat-grid');
      var el3 = document.getElementById('table-skeleton');
      var el4 = document.getElementById('table-wrap');
      var el5 = document.getElementById('pagination-wrap');

      if (el1) el1.style.display = 'none';
      if (el2) el2.style.display = 'grid';
      if (el3) el3.style.display = 'none';
      if (el4) el4.style.display = 'block';
      if (el5) el5.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // NAVBAR AVATAR
    // ============================================================
    async function updateNavbarAvatar() {
      var userAvatar = document.getElementById('user-avatar');
      if (!userAvatar) return;
      try {
        var { data: { user } } = await sb.auth.getUser();
        if (!user) return;
        var { data: profile } = await sb.from('user_profiles').select('avatar_url').eq('id', user.id).single();
        if (profile && profile.avatar_url) {
          userAvatar.innerHTML = '<img src="' + profile.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar">';
          userAvatar.style.background = 'transparent';
          userAvatar.style.border = '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
        } else {
          var initial = (user.user_metadata && user.user_metadata.username) ? user.user_metadata.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : user.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
          userAvatar.textContent = initial;
          userAvatar.style.background = 'var(--accent)';
          userAvatar.style.border = 'none';
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // YARDIMCI FONKSİYONLAR - INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS KONTROLLÜ
    // ============================================================
    function getTradePnL(t) {
      try {
        if (!t.exit_price) return null;
        var mult = t.multiplier || 100000;
        if (typeof INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS !== 'undefined' && INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[t.instrument]) {
          mult = t.multiplier || INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[t.instrument] || 100000;
        }
        return calcPnL(t.entry_price, t.exit_price, t.lot, t.direction, 'other', mult);
      } catch(e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function formatDateTime(dateStr) {
      if (!dateStr) return '—';
      try {
        var date = new Date(dateStr);
        var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
        return date.getDate() + ' ' + date.toLocaleString(lang, { month: 'short' }) + ' ' + date.getHours().toString().padStart(2,'0') + ':' + date.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
      } catch(e) {
        return '—';
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // STRATEJİ LİSTESİ
    // ============================================================
    async function loadStrategyNames() {
      var user = await requireAuth();
      if (!user) return;
      try {
        var { data, error } = await sb
          .from('strategies')
          .select('id, name')
          .eq('user_id', user.id)
          .eq('is_active', true)
          .order('name', { ascending: true });

        if (!error && data) {
          strategiesList = data;
          strategyNames = {};
          data.forEach(function(s) { strategyNames[s.id] = s.name; });
        }

        var strategySelect = document.getElementById('edit-strategy');
        if (strategySelect) {
          strategySelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">— Strateji Seç —</option>';
          strategiesList.forEach(function(s) {
            var option = document.createElement('option');
            option.value = s.id;
            option.textContent = s.name;
            strategySelect.appendChild(option);
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // STATS
    // ============================================================
    function renderStats(trades) {
      try {
        var closed = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.exit_price; });
        var pnls = closed.map(function(t) { return getTradePnL(t); });
        var total = pnls.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + (v || 0); }, 0);
        var wins = pnls.filter(function(v) { return v > 0; }).length;
        var wr = closed.length ? Math.round(wins / closed.length * 100) : 0;
        var rrValues = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.rr_ratio; }).map(function(t) { return parseFloat(t.rr_ratio); });
        var avgRR = rrValues.length ? (rrValues.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0) / rrValues.length).toFixed(1) : null;

        var totalEl = document.getElementById('stat-total');
        if (totalEl) {
          totalEl.textContent = closed.length ? formatCurrency(total) : '—';
          totalEl.className = 'stat-card-value' + (total > 0 ? ' positive' : total < 0 ? ' negative' : '');
        }
        var wrEl = document.getElementById('stat-wr');
        if (wrEl) wrEl.textContent = closed.length ? wr + '%' : '—';
        var countEl = document.getElementById('stat-count');
        if (countEl) countEl.textContent = trades.length;
        var rrEl = document.getElementById('stat-rr');
        if (rrEl) rrEl.textContent = avgRR ? '1:' + avgRR : '—';
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // NOTE TOGGLE
    // ============================================================
    function toggleNote(tradeId) {
      var noteRow = document.getElementById('note-row-' + tradeId);
      if (!noteRow) return;
      if (expandedNotes.has(tradeId)) {
        noteRow.style.display = 'none';
        expandedNotes.delete(tradeId);
      } else {
        noteRow.style.display = 'table-row';
        expandedNotes.add(tradeId);
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SEÇİM ÇUBUĞU
    // ============================================================
    function updateSelBar() {
      var bar = document.getElementById('sel-bar');
      var cnt = selectedTrades.size;
      if (cnt > 0) {
        if (bar) bar.classList.add('visible');
        var countEl = document.getElementById('sel-count-text');
        if (countEl) countEl.textContent = cnt;
        var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
        var labelText = 'işlem seçildi';
        if (lang === 'en') labelText = 'trades selected';
        else if (lang === 'de') labelText = 'Trades ausgewählt';
        var labelEl = document.getElementById('sel-label-text');
        if (labelEl) labelEl.textContent = labelText;
      } else {
        if (bar) bar.classList.remove('visible');
      }
    }

    function toggleSelect(id, checked) {
      if (checked) selectedTrades.add(id);
      else selectedTrades.delete(id);
      updateSelBar();
    }

    function toggleSelectAll(checkbox) {
      var allCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.trade-checkbox');
      allCheckboxes.forEach(function(cb) {
        var id = cb.getAttribute('data-id');
        if (id) {
          cb.checked = checkbox.checked;
          if (checkbox.checked) selectedTrades.add(id);
          else selectedTrades.delete(id);
        }
      });
      updateSelBar();
    }

    // ============================================================
    // PAGINATION RENDER (i18n UYUMLU)
    // ============================================================
    function renderPagination() {
      var controls = document.getElementById('pagination-controls');
      var start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1;
      var end = Math.min(currentPage * PAGE_SIZE, totalItems);

      var infoEl = document.getElementById('pagination-info');
      var showingText = i18n.t('trades.pagination.showing');
      var ofText = i18n.t('trades.pagination.of');
      var tradesText = i18n.t('trades.pagination.trades');

      if (infoEl) {
        if (totalItems > 0) {
          infoEl.innerHTML = showingText + ' <strong>' + start + '</strong> - <strong>' + end + '</strong> ' + ofText + ' <strong>' + totalItems + '</strong> ' + tradesText;
        } else {
          infoEl.innerHTML = showingText + ' <strong>0</strong> - <strong>0</strong> ' + ofText + ' <strong>0</strong> ' + tradesText;
        }
      }

      var html = '';
      var prevText = i18n.t('trades.pagination.prev');
      html += '<button class="page-btn arrow" id="page-prev" ' + (currentPage <= 1 ? 'disabled' : '') + '>' + prevText + '</button>';

      var maxVisible = 5;
      var startPage = Math.max(1, currentPage - Math.floor(maxVisible / 2));
      var endPage = Math.min(totalPages, startPage + maxVisible - 1);

      if (endPage - startPage < maxVisible - 1) {
        startPage = Math.max(1, endPage - maxVisible + 1);
      }

      if (startPage > 1) {
        html += '<button class="page-btn" data-page="1">1</button>';
        if (startPage > 2) html += '<span class="page-btn ellipsis">…</span>';
      }

      for (var p = startPage; p <= endPage; p++) {
        html += '<button class="page-btn ' + (p === currentPage ? 'active' : '') + '" data-page="' + p + '">' + p + '</button>';
      }

      if (endPage < totalPages) {
        if (endPage < totalPages - 1) html += '<span class="page-btn ellipsis">…</span>';
        html += '<button class="page-btn" data-page="' + totalPages + '">' + totalPages + '</button>';
      }

      var nextText = i18n.t('trades.pagination.next');
      html += '<button class="page-btn arrow" id="page-next" ' + (currentPage >= totalPages ? 'disabled' : '') + '>' + nextText + '</button>';

      if (controls) controls.innerHTML = html;

      controls.querySelectorAll('.page-btn[data-page]').forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var page = parseInt(this.dataset.page);
          if (page !== currentPage) {
            currentPage = page;
            applyFiltersAndSort();
          }
        });
      });

      var prevBtn = document.getElementById('page-prev');
      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (currentPage > 1) {
            currentPage--;
            applyFiltersAndSort();
          }
        });
      }

      var nextBtn = document.getElementById('page-next');
      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (currentPage < totalPages) {
            currentPage++;
            applyFiltersAndSort();
          }
        });
      }
    }


    // ============================================================
    // FİLTRELEME VE SIRALAMA
    // ============================================================
    function applyFiltersAndSort() {
      try {
        var sort = document.getElementById('sort-select').value;
        var dir = document.getElementById('dir-filter').value;
        var result = document.getElementById('result-filter').value;

        var trades = allTrades.slice();

        if (dir !== 'all') trades = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.direction === dir; });
        if (result === 'win') trades = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.exit_price && getTradePnL(t) > 0; });
        else if (result === 'loss') trades = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.exit_price && getTradePnL(t) < 0; });
        else if (result === 'open') trades = trades.filter(function(t) { return !t.exit_price; });

        switch (sort) {
          case 'date_desc': trades.sort(function(a,b) { return new Date(b.trade_date) - new Date(a.trade_date); }); break;
          case 'date_asc': trades.sort(function(a,b) { return new Date(a.trade_date) - new Date(b.trade_date); }); break;
          case 'pnl_desc': trades.sort(function(a,b) { return (getTradePnL(b)||0) - (getTradePnL(a)||0); }); break;
          case 'pnl_asc': trades.sort(function(a,b) { return (getTradePnL(a)||0) - (getTradePnL(b)||0); }); break;
          case 'symbol_asc': trades.sort(function(a,b) { return (a.symbol||'').localeCompare(b.symbol||''); }); break;
        }

        totalItems = trades.length;
        totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;

        if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
        if (currentPage < 1) currentPage = 1;

        var start = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
        var end = Math.min(start + PAGE_SIZE, totalItems);
        filteredTrades = trades.slice(start, end);

        renderTable(filteredTrades);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // TABLO RENDER - OPTİMİZE
    // ============================================================
    function renderTable(trades) {
      var wrap = document.getElementById('table-wrap');
      if (!wrap) return;

      var tradeCount = trades.length;

      selectedTrades.clear();
      expandedNotes.clear();
      updateSelBar();
      renderStats(trades);

      hideTableSkeleton();

      if (!trades.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding:2rem;" data-i18n="trades.no_trades">Henüz işlem yok. <a href="add-trade.html" style="color:var(--accent);" data-i18n="trades.add_first">İlk işlemi ekle →</a></p>';
        i18n.apply();
        renderPagination();
        return;
      }

      var rows = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < trades.length; i++) {
        var t = trades[i];
        var pnl = getTradePnL(t);
        var isWin = pnl !== null && pnl > 0;
        var isLoss = pnl !== null && pnl < 0;
        var isOpen = !t.exit_price;
        var indClass = isOpen ? 'open' : isWin ? 'win' : 'loss';
        var pnlStr = isOpen ? '<span class="pnl-open" data-i18n="trades.open">Açık</span>' : '<span style="font-family:\'Inter\',sans-serif;font-weight:600;" class="' + (isWin ? 'positive' : 'negative') + '">' + formatCurrency(pnl) + '</span>';
        var rrStr = t.rr_ratio ? '<span style="color:var(--accent2);font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">1:' + t.rr_ratio + '</span>' : '—';
        var strategyName = t.strategy_id ? (strategyNames[t.strategy_id] || i18n.t('trades.strategy')) : '—';
        var dateTimeStr = formatDateTime(t.trade_date);
        var hasNote = t.notes && t.notes.trim().length > 0;
        rows += '\n          <tr onclick="toggleNote(\'' + t.id + '\')">\n            <td style="width:36px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">\n              <input type="checkbox" class="trade-checkbox" data-id="' + t.id + '" onchange="toggleSelect(\'' + t.id + '\', this.checked)">\n            </td>\n            <td>\n              <div class="symbol-cell">\n                <span class="row-indicator ' + indClass + '"></span>\n                <span class="symbol-text">' + escapeHtml(t.symbol || '—') + '</span>\n              </div>\n            </td>\n            <td>' + (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY' ? '<span class="badge-long">LONG</span>' : '<span class="badge-short">SHORT</span>') + '</td>\n            <td style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + (t.lot ?? '—') + '</td>\n            <td style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + (t.entry_price ?? '—') + '</td>\n            <td style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + (t.exit_price ?? '—') + '</td>\n            <td style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + (t.stop_loss ?? '—') + '</td>\n            <td style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + (t.take_profit ?? '—') + '</td>\n            <td>' + pnlStr + '</td>\n            <td>' + rrStr + '</td>\n            <td>' + (strategyName !== '—' ? '<span class="strategy-badge" title="' + escapeHtml(strategyName) + '">' + (strategyName.length > 15 ? strategyName.slice(0,12)+'..' : strategyName) + '</span>' : '—') + '</td>\n            <td class="trade-date-time" style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + dateTimeStr + '</td>\n            <td onclick="event.stopPropagation()">\n              <div class="tt-actions">\n                <button class="btn-icon" onclick="openEdit(\'' + t.id + '\')" title="' + i18n.t('trades.edit') + '">✏️</button>\n                <button class="btn-icon del" onclick="deleteTrade(\'' + t.id + '\')" title="' + i18n.t('trades.delete') + '">🗑️</button>\n              </div>\n            </td>\n          </tr>\n          <tr id="note-row-' + t.id + '" style="display:none;" class="trade-note-row">\n            <td colspan="13">\n              <strong>📝 ' + i18n.t('trades.notes_label') + '</strong><br>\n              ' + (hasNote ? escapeHtml(t.notes) : '<span style="opacity:0.5;" data-i18n="trades.no_notes">Not eklenmemiş</span>') + '\n            </td>\n          </tr>\n        ';
      }
      wrap.innerHTML = '\n        <div style="overflow-x:auto;">\n          <table class="ww-table">\n            <thead>\n              <tr>\n                <th style="width:36px;"><input type="checkbox" class="trade-checkbox" id="select-all-checkbox" onchange="toggleSelectAll(this)"></th>\n                <th data-i18n="trades.th_symbol">Sembol</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_direction">Yön</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_lot">Lot</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_entry">Giriş</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_exit">Çıkış</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_sl">SL</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_tp">TP</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_pnl">K/Z</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_rr">R/R</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_strategy">Strateji</th><th data-i18n="trades.th_date">Tarih</th><th style="width:70px;"></th>\n              </tr>\n            </thead>\n            <tbody>' + rows + '</tbody>\n          </table>\n        </div>\n      ';

      i18n.apply();
      renderPagination();
    }

    // ============================================================
    // İŞLEM SİLME
    // ============================================================
    async function deleteTrade(id) {
      if (!confirm(i18n.t('trades.delete_confirm'))) return;
      try {
        var { error } = await sb.from('trades').delete().eq('id', id);
        if (error) {
          showToast(i18n.t('trades.delete_error') + error.message, 'error');
          return;
        }
        showToast(i18n.t('trades.deleted'));
        allTrades = allTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.id !== id; });
        totalItems = allTrades.length;
        totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
        if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;
        applyFiltersAndSort();
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    async function bulkDelete() {
      var count = selectedTrades.size;
      if (count === 0) {
        showToast('Silinecek işlem seçilmedi!', 'error');
        return;
      }
      var translated = i18n.t('trades.bulk_confirm_text', { count: count });
      var countEl = document.getElementById('bulk-count-text');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = translated;
      var modal = document.getElementById('bulk-modal');
      if (modal) modal.classList.add('active');
    }

    async function confirmBulkDelete() {
      var ids = Array.from(selectedTrades).filter(function(id) { return id && typeof id === 'string' && id.trim() !== ''; });

      if (ids.length === 0) {
        showToast('Silinecek geçerli işlem bulunamadı!', 'error');
        var modal = document.getElementById('bulk-modal');
        if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
        return;
      }

      try {
        var { error } = await sb.from('trades').delete().in('id', ids);

        if (error) {
          showToast(i18n.t('trades.delete_error') + error.message, 'error');
          var modal2 = document.getElementById('bulk-modal');
          if (modal2) modal2.classList.remove('active');
          return;
        }

        showToast(ids.length + ' ' + i18n.t('trades.deleted'));
        allTrades = allTrades.filter(function(t) { return !selectedTrades.has(t.id); });
        selectedTrades.clear();

        totalItems = allTrades.length;
        totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
        if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;

        applyFiltersAndSort();
        var modal3 = document.getElementById('bulk-modal');
        if (modal3) modal3.classList.remove('active');
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DÜZENLEME
    // ============================================================
    function openEdit(id) {
      var t = allTrades.find(function(x) { return x.id === id; });
      if (!t) return;
      var idEl = document.getElementById('edit-id');
      var instrumentEl = document.getElementById('edit-instrument');
      var symbolEl = document.getElementById('edit-symbol');
      var directionEl = document.getElementById('edit-direction');
      var lotEl = document.getElementById('edit-lot');
      var entryEl = document.getElementById('edit-entry');
      var exitEl = document.getElementById('edit-exit');
      var slEl = document.getElementById('edit-sl');
      var tpEl = document.getElementById('edit-tp');
      var dateEl = document.getElementById('edit-date');
      var notesEl = document.getElementById('edit-notes');
      var multiplierEl = document.getElementById('edit-multiplier');
      var strategyEl = document.getElementById('edit-strategy');
      var customWrap = document.getElementById('edit-custom-wrap');
      var errEl = document.getElementById('edit-err');

      if (idEl) idEl.value = t.id;
      if (instrumentEl) instrumentEl.value = t.instrument || 'forex';
      if (symbolEl) symbolEl.value = t.symbol || '';
      if (directionEl) directionEl.value = t.direction || 'LONG';
      if (lotEl) lotEl.value = t.lot ?? '';
      if (entryEl) entryEl.value = t.entry_price ?? '';
      if (exitEl) exitEl.value = t.exit_price ?? '';
      if (slEl) slEl.value = t.stop_loss ?? '';
      if (tpEl) tpEl.value = t.take_profit ?? '';
      if (dateEl) dateEl.value = t.trade_date || '';
      if (notesEl) notesEl.value = t.notes || '';
      if (multiplierEl) multiplierEl.value = t.multiplier ?? '';
      if (strategyEl) strategyEl.value = t.strategy_id || '';
      if (customWrap) customWrap.style.display = (t.instrument === 'other') ? 'flex' : 'none';
      if (errEl) errEl.style.display = 'none';

      var modal = document.getElementById('edit-modal');
      if (modal) modal.classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeModal() {
      var modal = document.getElementById('edit-modal');
      if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
    }

    function closeBulkModal() {
      var modal = document.getElementById('bulk-modal');
      if (modal) modal.classList.remove('active');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // EVENT LISTENERS
    // ============================================================
    var instrumentSelect = document.getElementById('edit-instrument');
    if (instrumentSelect) {
      instrumentSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        var customWrap = document.getElementById('edit-custom-wrap');
        if (customWrap) customWrap.style.display = this.value === 'other' ? 'flex' : 'none';
      });
    }

    applyDecimalFix(['edit-lot','edit-entry','edit-exit','edit-sl','edit-tp','edit-multiplier']);

    var cancelBtn = document.getElementById('modal-cancel');
    if (cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

    var bulkCancel = document.getElementById('bulk-cancel');
    if (bulkCancel) bulkCancel.addEventListener('click', closeBulkModal);

    var bulkDeleteBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-delete-btn');
    if (bulkDeleteBtn) bulkDeleteBtn.addEventListener('click', bulkDelete);

    var bulkConfirm = document.getElementById('bulk-confirm');
    if (bulkConfirm) bulkConfirm.addEventListener('click', confirmBulkDelete);

    var selClear = document.getElementById('sel-clear-btn');
    if (selClear) {
      selClear.addEventListener('click', function() {
        selectedTrades.clear();
        document.querySelectorAll('.trade-checkbox').forEach(function(cb) { cb.checked = false; });
        updateSelBar();
      });
    }

    var editModal = document.getElementById('edit-modal');
    if (editModal) {
      editModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === this) closeModal();
      });
    }

    var bulkModal = document.getElementById('bulk-modal');
    if (bulkModal) {
      bulkModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === this) closeBulkModal();
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeModal();
        closeBulkModal();
      }
    });

    var sortSelect = document.getElementById('sort-select');
    if (sortSelect) {
      sortSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
        currentPage = 1;
        applyFiltersAndSort();
      });
    }

    var dirFilter = document.getElementById('dir-filter');
    if (dirFilter) {
      dirFilter.addEventListener('change', function() {
        currentPage = 1;
        applyFiltersAndSort();
      });
    }

    var resultFilter = document.getElementById('result-filter');
    if (resultFilter) {
      resultFilter.addEventListener('change', function() {
        currentPage = 1;
        applyFiltersAndSort();
      });
    }

    var saveBtn = document.getElementById('modal-save');
    if (saveBtn) {
      saveBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
        var id = document.getElementById('edit-id').value;
        var instrument = document.getElementById('edit-instrument').value;
        var symbol = document.getElementById('edit-symbol').value.trim().toUpperCase();
        var direction = document.getElementById('edit-direction').value;
        var lot = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit-lot').value);
        var entry = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit-entry').value);
        var exit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit-exit').value) || null;
        var sl = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit-sl').value) || null;
        var tp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit-tp').value) || null;
        var tradeDate = document.getElementById('edit-date').value;
        var notes = document.getElementById('edit-notes').value.trim();
        var strategyId = document.getElementById('edit-strategy').value || null;
        var errEl = document.getElementById('edit-err');
        if (errEl) errEl.style.display = 'none';

        var mult = 100000;
        if (typeof INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS !== 'undefined' && INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[instrument]) {
          mult = INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[instrument];
        }
        if (instrument === 'other') {
          mult = parseFloat(document.getElementById('edit-multiplier').value);
          if (!mult) {
            if (errEl) {
              errEl.textContent = i18n.t('trades.custom_multiplier_required');
              errEl.style.display = 'block';
            }
            return;
          }
        }
        if (!symbol || !direction || !lot || !entry || !tradeDate) {
          if (errEl) {
            errEl.textContent = i18n.t('trades.required_fields');
            errEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
          return;
        }

        var pnl = exit ? calcPnL(entry, exit, lot, direction, 'other', mult) : null;
        var rr = (sl && tp) ? parseFloat(calcRR(entry, sl, tp, direction)) : null;

        try {
          var { error } = await sb.from('trades').update({
            instrument: instrument, symbol: symbol, direction: direction, lot: lot,
            entry_price: entry, exit_price: exit,
            stop_loss: sl, take_profit: tp, trade_date: tradeDate, notes: notes || null,
            pnl: pnl, rr_ratio: rr, multiplier: mult, strategy_id: strategyId
          }).eq('id', id);

          if (error) {
            if (errEl) {
              errEl.textContent = i18n.t('trades.update_error') + error.message;
              errEl.style.display = 'block';
            }
            return;
          }

          var idx = allTrades.findIndex(function(x) { return x.id === id; });
          if (idx > -1) {
            allTrades[idx] = {
              id: id, instrument: instrument, symbol: symbol, direction: direction, lot: lot,
              entry_price: entry, exit_price: exit, stop_loss: sl, take_profit: tp,
              trade_date: tradeDate, notes: notes, pnl: pnl, rr_ratio: rr,
              multiplier: mult, strategy_id: strategyId
            };
          }

          showToast(i18n.t('trades.updated'));
          closeModal();
          applyFiltersAndSort();
        } catch (e) {}
      });
    }

    // Dil değiştiğinde seçim çubuğunu güncelle
    i18n.onChange(function() {
      updateSelBar();
    });

    // ============================================================
    // ANA BAŞLATMA
    // ============================================================
    (async function() {
      try {
        showTableSkeleton();

        var user = await requireAuth();
        if (!user) return;
        if (typeof isAdmin === 'function' && isAdmin(user)) {
          var adminLink = document.getElementById('admin-link');
          if (adminLink) adminLink.style.display = 'inline';
          var adminLinkMobile = document.getElementById('admin-link-mobile');
          if (adminLinkMobile) adminLinkMobile.style.display = 'block';
        }

        await updateNavbarAvatar();
        await loadStrategyNames();

        await updatePlanBadge();

        // 🔔 Over trade uyarısını bildirim çanına yükle
        try {
          await updateOvertradeBell();
        } catch(e) {}

        var userAvatar = document.getElementById('user-avatar');
        var dropdownMenu = document.getElementById('dropdown-menu');
        if (userAvatar && dropdownMenu) {
          userAvatar.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            dropdownMenu.classList.toggle('show');
          });
          document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            if (!userAvatar.contains(e.target) && !dropdownMenu.contains(e.target)) {
              dropdownMenu.classList.remove('show');
            }
          });
        }

        var logoutDropdownBtn = document.getElementById('logout-dropdown-btn');
        if (logoutDropdownBtn) {
          logoutDropdownBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
            try { localStorage.removeItem('ww_last_active_push'); } catch(e) {}
            await sb.auth.signOut();
            window.location.href = 'index.html';
          });
        }

        var { data, error } = await sb.from('trades').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).order('trade_date', { ascending: false });
        if (error) {
          var wrap = document.getElementById('table-wrap');
          if (wrap) wrap.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--red);">Veriler yüklenemedi.</p>';
          hideTableSkeleton();
          return;
        }
        allTrades = data || [];
        totalItems = allTrades.length;
        totalPages = Math.ceil(totalItems / PAGE_SIZE) || 1;
        currentPage = 1;
        applyFiltersAndSort();
      } catch (e) {}
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // MOBILE NAV - KALDIRILDI (navbar.js ile yönetilecek)
    // ============================================================
    // navToggle, navMenu, navBackdrop ile ilgili tüm kodlar kaldırıldı
    // Çünkü navbar artık /components/navbar.js ile yönetiliyor.
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

<file path="public/settings/panels/appearance.html">
<div class="s-card">
  <div class="s-card-header">
    <div class="s-card-header-icon">
      <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/>
        <path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h2 data-i18n="settings.theme">Görünüm</h2>
      <p data-i18n="settings.theme_desc">Tema, dil, para birimi ve renk özelleştirme</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s-card-body">


    <div class="theme-toggle-card">
      <div class="theme-toggle-row">
        <div class="theme-toggle-info">
          <div class="theme-toggle-icon" id="theme-icon">🌙</div>
          <div class="theme-toggle-text">
            <h4 id="theme-label" data-i18n="settings.dark_theme">Koyu Tema</h4>
            <p id="theme-desc" data-i18n="settings.dark_theme_desc">Göz yormayan karanlık arayüz</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <label class="toggle-switch">
          <input type="checkbox" id="theme-toggle" onchange="toggleTheme()">
          <span class="toggle-slider"></span>
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="theme-toggle-card" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
      <div class="theme-toggle-row">
        <div class="theme-toggle-info">
          <div class="theme-toggle-icon" id="lang-icon">🌐</div>
          <div class="theme-toggle-text">
            <h4 id="lang-label" data-i18n="language.title">Dil Seçimi</h4>
            <p id="lang-desc" data-i18n="language.select">Uygulama dilini değiştirin</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="lang-selector-compact" id="settings-lang-selector">
          <button class="lang-compact-btn" data-lang="tr" title="Türkçe">🇹🇷 TR</button>
          <button class="lang-compact-btn" data-lang="en" title="English">🇬🇧 EN</button>
          <button class="lang-compact-btn" data-lang="de" title="Deutsch">🇩🇪 DE</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="theme-toggle-card" style="margin-top: 1rem;">
      <div class="theme-toggle-row">
        <div class="theme-toggle-info">
          <div class="theme-toggle-icon" id="currency-icon">💰</div>
          <div class="theme-toggle-text">
            <h4 id="currency-label" data-i18n="settings.currency">Para Birimi</h4>
            <p id="currency-desc" data-i18n="settings.currency_desc">Varsayılan para birimini seç</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="currency-selector-compact" id="settings-currency-selector">
          <button class="currency-btn" data-currency="$" title="USD">$ USD</button>
          <button class="currency-btn" data-currency="€" title="Euro">€ EUR</button>
          <button class="currency-btn" data-currency="₺" title="Türk Lirası">₺ TRY</button>
          <button class="currency-btn" data-currency="£" title="Sterlin">£ GBP</button>
          <button class="currency-btn" data-currency="₿" title="Bitcoin">₿ BTC</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="theme-customization-section" id="theme-customization-section">
      <div class="section-title">
        🎨 Tema Özelleştirme
        <span class="premium-badge">PREMIUM</span>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:1rem;">
        Arka plan, kart, kenarlık ve metin renklerini kişiselleştirin. Font boyutunu ayarlayın.
      </p>
      <div id="theme-customization-container">

      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="public/settings/panels/danger-area.html">
<div class="s-card danger-card">
  <div class="s-card-header">
    <div class="s-card-header-icon">
      <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
        <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 0 0 1.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 0 0 1.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 0 0-3.42 0z"/>
        <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/>
        <line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div>
      <h2 data-i18n="settings.danger_zone">Tehlikeli Bölge</h2>
      <p data-i18n="settings.danger_desc">Geri alınamaz işlemler</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="s-card-body">
    <div class="danger-action-row">
      <div>
        <div class="danger-action-desc" style="font-weight:500; color:var(--text); margin-bottom:.25rem;" data-i18n="settings.delete_all_trades">Tüm İşlem Verilerini Sil</div>
        <div class="danger-action-desc" data-i18n="settings.delete_all_trades_warning">Kaydettiğin tüm trade verileri kalıcı olarak silinir. Bu işlem geri alınamaz.</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-outline-danger" id="delete-data-btn" data-i18n="settings.delete_data">Verileri Sil</button>
    </div>
    <div style="height:1px; background:rgba(239,68,68,0.15); margin:.75rem 0;"></div>
    <div class="danger-action-row">
      <div>
        <div class="danger-action-desc" style="font-weight:500; color:var(--text); margin-bottom:.25rem;" data-i18n="settings.deactivate_account">Hesabımı Devre Dışı Bırak</div>
        <div class="danger-action-desc" data-i18n="settings.deactivate_account_warning">Hesabın devre dışı bırakılır ve giriş yapamazsın. Verilerin saklanır.</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-outline-danger" id="deactivate-account-btn" data-i18n="settings.deactivate">Hesabı Devre Dışı Bırak</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</file>
