        return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      }
      dateString = dateString.trim();
      var d = new Date(dateString);
      if (!isNaN(d.getTime()) && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateString)) {
        return d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      }

      var p = dateString.split('.');
      if (p.length === 3) {
        var dmy = new Date(p[2] + '-' + p[1] + '-' + p[0]);
        if (!isNaN(dmy.getTime())) return dmy.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      }
      p = dateString.split('/');
      if (p.length === 3) {
        var mdy = new Date(p[2] + '-' + p[0] + '-' + p[1]);
        if (!isNaN(mdy.getTime())) return mdy.toISOString().split('T')[0];
        var dmy2 = new Date(p[2] + '-' + p[1] + '-' + p[0]);
        if (!isNaN(dmy2.getTime())) return dmy2.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      }
      importLogs.push('❌ Satır ' + (rowNumber || '?') + ': Geçersiz tarih "' + dateString + '", bugün kullanıldı.');
      return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    }

    function renderImportLog() {
      var el = document.getElementById('import-log');
      if (el) {
        if (importLogs.length > 0) {
          el.style.display = 'block';
          el.innerHTML = importLogs.map(function(l) { return '<div>' + l + '</div>'; }).join('');
        } else {
          el.style.display = 'none';
          el.innerHTML = '';
        }
      }
    }

    async function importCSV(file) {
      var progressDiv = document.getElementById('import-progress');
      if (progressDiv) progressDiv.style.display = 'flex';
      importLogs = [];
      renderImportLog();

      try {
        var text = await file.text();
        var lines = text.split('\n').filter(function(l) { return l.trim(); });

        if (lines.length < 2) {
          showToast(i18n.t('addtrade.csv_no_data'), 'error');
          if (progressDiv) progressDiv.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        }

        var headers = lines[0].split(',').map(function(h) { return h.trim().toLowerCase(); });
        var imported = 0, failed = 0;

        for (var i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
          var values = lines[i].split(',');
          if (values.length < 5) {
            importLogs.push('⚠️ Satır ' + i + ': Yetersiz sütun (' + values.length + '), atlandı.');
            failed++; continue;
          }

          var row = {};
          for (var hIdx = 0; hIdx < headers.length; hIdx++) {
            row[headers[hIdx]] = values[hIdx] ? values[hIdx].trim() : '';
          }

          var symbol = (row.symbol || row.sembol || '').toUpperCase();
          var direction = (row.yon || row.direction || '').toUpperCase();
          var lot = parseFloat(row.lot || 0);
          var entry = parseFloat(row.entry || row.giris || row.entry_price || 0);
          var exit = parseFloat(row.exit || row.cikis || row.exit_price) || null;
          var rawDate = row.tarih || row.date || '';
          var tradeDate = validateAndFormatDate(rawDate, i);

          if (!symbol || !direction || !lot || !entry) {
            importLogs.push('❌ Satır ' + i + ': Zorunlu alan eksik, atlandı.');
            failed++; continue;
          }

          var finalDir = 'SHORT';
          if (direction === 'BUY' || direction === 'LONG') finalDir = 'LONG';
          else if (direction === 'SELL' || direction === 'SHORT') finalDir = 'SHORT';
          else importLogs.push('⚠️ Satır ' + i + ': Bilinmeyen yön "' + direction + '", SHORT olarak kaydedildi.');

          var trade = {
            user_id: currentUser.id, symbol: symbol, direction: finalDir,
            instrument: 'forex', lot: lot, entry_price: entry,
            exit_price: exit, trade_date: tradeDate,
            notes: 'CSV Import - ' + new Date().toLocaleString('tr-TR')
          };

          var { error } = await sb.from('trades').insert([trade]);
          if (error) {
            importLogs.push('❌ Satır ' + i + ': ' + error.message);
            failed++;
          } else {
            imported++;
          }
        }

        renderImportLog();
        if (progressDiv) progressDiv.style.display = 'none';
        if (csvFileInput) csvFileInput.value = '';

        var msg = imported + ' işlem içe aktarıldı' + (failed > 0 ? ', ' + failed + ' başarısız' : '') + '.';
        showToast(msg, failed > 0 ? 'error' : 'success');
        if (imported > 0) setTimeout(function() { window.location.href = 'trades.html'; }, 2000);
      } catch(e) {
        if (progressDiv) progressDiv.style.display = 'none';
        showToast('CSV okuma hatası: ' + e.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // BULK IMPORT (TOPLU EKLEME)
    // ============================================================
    var bulkOverlay = document.getElementById('bulk-import-overlay');
    var bulkTextarea = document.getElementById('bulk-textarea');
    var bulkProgress = document.getElementById('bulk-progress');
    var bulkFill = document.getElementById('bulk-fill');
    var bulkStatus = document.getElementById('bulk-status');

    var bulkImportBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-import-btn');
    if (bulkImportBtn) {
      bulkImportBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (bulkOverlay) bulkOverlay.classList.add('active');
        if (bulkTextarea) bulkTextarea.value = '';
        if (bulkProgress) bulkProgress.style.display = 'none';
      });
    }

    var bulkCancelBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-cancel-btn');
    if (bulkCancelBtn) {
      bulkCancelBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        if (bulkOverlay) bulkOverlay.classList.remove('active');
      });
    }

    if (bulkOverlay) {
      bulkOverlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target === bulkOverlay) bulkOverlay.classList.remove('active');
      });
    }

    var bulkConfirmBtn = document.getElementById('bulk-confirm-btn');
    if (bulkConfirmBtn) {
      bulkConfirmBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
        if (!bulkTextarea) return;
        var text = bulkTextarea.value.trim();
        if (!text) {
          showToast('Lütfen en az bir işlem girin!', 'error');
          return;
        }

        var lines = text.split('\n').filter(function(l) { return l.trim(); });
        if (lines.length === 0) {
          showToast('Lütfen en az bir işlem girin!', 'error');
          return;
        }

        var trades = [];
        var errors = [];
        var defaultDate = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

        for (var lineIdx = 0; lineIdx < lines.length; lineIdx++) {
          var parts = lines[lineIdx].split(',').map(function(p) { return p.trim(); });
          if (parts.length < 5) {
            errors.push('Satır ' + (lineIdx+1) + ': Yetersiz alan (' + parts.length + ' alan, en az 5 gerekli)');
            continue;
          }

          var symbol = parts[0].toUpperCase();
          var direction = parts[1].toUpperCase();
          var lot = parseFloat(parts[2]);
          var entry = parseFloat(parts[3]);
          var exit = parts[4] ? parseFloat(parts[4]) : null;
          var date = parts[5] ? validateAndFormatDate(parts[5], lineIdx+1) : defaultDate;
          var notes = parts[6] || 'Toplu ekleme - ' + new Date().toLocaleString('tr-TR');

          if (!symbol || !direction || isNaN(lot) || isNaN(entry)) {
            errors.push('Satır ' + (lineIdx+1) + ': Zorunlu alanlar eksik (sembol, yön, lot, giriş)');
            continue;
          }

          var finalDir = 'SHORT';
          if (direction === 'BUY' || direction === 'LONG') finalDir = 'LONG';

          trades.push({
            user_id: currentUser.id,
            symbol: symbol,
            direction: finalDir,
            instrument: 'forex',
            lot: lot,
            entry_price: entry,
            exit_price: exit,
            trade_date: date,
            notes: notes || null,
            multiplier: 100000
          });
        }

        if (errors.length > 0) {
          showToast(errors.length + ' hata var!', 'error');
          if (bulkProgress) bulkProgress.style.display = 'block';
          if (bulkFill) {
            bulkFill.style.width = '100%';
            bulkFill.style.background = 'var(--red)';
          }
          if (bulkStatus) bulkStatus.textContent = '❌ ' + errors.length + ' hata: ' + errors.join('; ');
          setTimeout(function() {
            if (bulkProgress) bulkProgress.style.display = 'none';
            if (bulkFill) bulkFill.style.width = '0%';
          }, 3000);
          return;
        }

        if (trades.length === 0) {
          showToast('Geçerli işlem bulunamadı!', 'error');
          return;
        }

        if (bulkProgress) bulkProgress.style.display = 'block';
        if (bulkFill) {
          bulkFill.style.width = '0%';
          bulkFill.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2))';
        }
        if (bulkStatus) bulkStatus.textContent = '0 / ' + trades.length + ' işlem ekleniyor...';

        var success = 0;
        var failed = 0;

        for (var tIdx = 0; tIdx < trades.length; tIdx++) {
          var trade = trades[tIdx];
          var { error } = await sb.from('trades').insert([trade]);
          if (error) {
            failed++;
            errors.push('Satır ' + (tIdx+1) + ': ' + error.message);
          } else {
            success++;
          }
          var progress = ((tIdx + 1) / trades.length) * 100;
          if (bulkFill) bulkFill.style.width = progress + '%';
          if (bulkStatus) bulkStatus.textContent = success + ' / ' + trades.length + ' işlem eklendi (' + failed + ' başarısız)';
        }

        if (errors.length > 0) {
          if (bulkFill) {
            bulkFill.style.background = 'var(--red)';
          }
          if (bulkStatus) bulkStatus.textContent = '⚠️ ' + success + ' işlem eklendi, ' + failed + ' hata!';
          setTimeout(function() {
            if (bulkProgress) bulkProgress.style.display = 'none';
            if (bulkFill) bulkFill.style.width = '0%';
          }, 3000);
          showToast(success + ' işlem eklendi, ' + failed + ' hata!', 'error');
        } else {
          if (bulkFill) {
            bulkFill.style.width = '100%';
            bulkFill.style.background = 'var(--green)';
          }
          if (bulkStatus) bulkStatus.textContent = '✅ ' + success + ' işlem başarıyla eklendi!';
          setTimeout(function() {
            if (bulkOverlay) bulkOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            if (bulkProgress) bulkProgress.style.display = 'none';
            if (bulkFill) bulkFill.style.width = '0%';
            window.location.href = 'trades.html';
          }, 1500);
          showToast(success + ' işlem başarıyla eklendi!', 'success');
        }
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SAVE TRADE
    // ============================================================
    var saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-btn');
    if (saveBtn) {
      saveBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
        var symbolEl = document.getElementById('symbol');
        var directionEl = document.getElementById('direction');
        var instrumentEl = document.getElementById('instrument');
        var lotEl = document.getElementById('lot');
        var entryEl = document.getElementById('entry');
        var exitEl = document.getElementById('exit');
        var slEl = document.getElementById('sl');
        var tpEl = document.getElementById('tp');
        var tradeDateEl = document.getElementById('trade-date');
        var notesEl = document.getElementById('notes');
        var strategyIdEl = document.getElementById('strategy-id-hidden');
        var errEl = document.getElementById('err');

        var symbol = symbolEl ? symbolEl.value.trim().toUpperCase() : '';
        var direction = directionEl ? directionEl.value : '';
        var instrument = instrumentEl ? instrumentEl.value : 'forex';
        var lot = lotEl ? parseFloat(lotEl.value) : 0;
        var entry = entryEl ? parseFloat(entryEl.value) : 0;
        var exit = exitEl ? parseFloat(exitEl.value) : null;
        var sl = slEl ? parseFloat(slEl.value) : null;
        var tp = tpEl ? parseFloat(tpEl.value) : null;
        var tradeDate = tradeDateEl ? tradeDateEl.value : '';
        var notes = notesEl ? notesEl.value.trim() : '';
        var strategyId = strategyIdEl ? strategyIdEl.value || null : null;
        var mult = getMultiplier();

        if (errEl) errEl.style.display = 'none';

        if (!symbol || !direction || !lot || !entry || !tradeDate) {
          if (errEl) {
            errEl.textContent = i18n.t('addtrade.required_fields');
            errEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
          return;
        }
        if (instrument === 'other' && !mult) {
          if (errEl) {
            errEl.textContent = i18n.t('addtrade.custom_multiplier_required');
            errEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
          return;
        }

        var btn = document.getElementById('save-btn');
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = true;
          btn.innerHTML = '<div class="spinner" style="width:18px;height:18px;margin:0 auto;"></div>';
        }

        var pnl = null;
        var rr = null;
        try {
          if (typeof calcPnL !== 'undefined' && exit) {
            pnl = calcPnL(entry, exit, lot, direction, 'other', mult);
          }
          if (typeof calcRR !== 'undefined' && sl && tp) {
            rr = calcRR(entry, sl, tp, direction);
          }
        } catch(e) {}

        var { error } = await sb.from('trades').insert([{
          user_id: currentUser.id, symbol: symbol, direction: direction, instrument: instrument, lot: lot,
          entry_price: entry, exit_price: exit, stop_loss: sl, take_profit: tp,
          trade_date: tradeDate, notes: notes || null, pnl: pnl,
          rr_ratio: rr ? parseFloat(rr) : null, multiplier: mult, strategy_id: strategyId
        }]);

        if (error) {
          if (errEl) {
            errEl.textContent = i18n.t('addtrade.save_error') + error.message;
            errEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
          if (btn) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 0 1-2 2z"/><polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/><polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/></svg> ' + i18n.t('common.save');
          }
          return;
        }

        showToast(i18n.t('addtrade.save_success'));
        setTimeout(function() { window.location.href = 'trades.html'; }, 1200);
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // INIT
    // ============================================================
    (async function() {
      try {
        currentUser = await requireAuth();
        if (!currentUser) return;

        var dateEl = document.getElementById('trade-date');
        if (dateEl) dateEl.value = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

        if (typeof isAdmin === 'function' && isAdmin(currentUser)) {
          var adminLink = document.getElementById('admin-link');
          if (adminLink) adminLink.style.display = 'inline';
          var adminLinkMobile = document.getElementById('admin-link-mobile');
          if (adminLinkMobile) adminLinkMobile.style.display = 'block';
        }

        await loadStrategyGrid();
      } catch(e) {}
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // DECIMAL FIX
    // ============================================================
    applyDecimalFix(['lot','entry','exit','sl','tp','custom-multiplier']);

  </script>
</body>
</html>
</file>

<file path="public/admin.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title data-i18n="nav.admin">Admin Panel – Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">


  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/components/navbar.css" />

  <script>
  (function() {
    if (document.body) {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'light') {
        document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
      } else {
        document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
      }
    } else {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
        if (savedTheme === 'light') {
          document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
        } else {
          document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
        }
      });
    }
  })();
  </script>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600;9..40,700&family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32,300;14..32,400;14..32,500;14..32,600;14..32,700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>

  <style>
    .admin-main {
      padding: 0.9rem 2rem;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ADMIN WRAP - AYARLAR SAYFASI GİBİ
       ============================================================ */
    .admin-wrap {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .admin-sidebar {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: sticky;
      top: 80px;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-header {
      padding: 1.25rem 1rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      text-align: center;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-header .sidebar-avatar {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 0.65rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-header .sidebar-avatar img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-header .sidebar-avatar .no-avatar {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      background: var(--surface2);
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-header .sidebar-username {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: .15rem;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-header .sidebar-email {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      word-break: break-all;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-nav {
      padding: .5rem;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-nav-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .65rem;
      padding: .6rem .85rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .2s;
      border: none;
      background: none;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-nav-item:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.07);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-nav-item.active {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.12);
      color: var(--accent2);
    }
    .admin-sidebar .sidebar-nav-divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
      margin: .4rem .85rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ADMIN PANELS
       ============================================================ */
    .admin-panels {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .panel-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 280px;
      border-radius: var(--radius) var(--radius) 0 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    .panel-glow.users-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.5), transparent 70%);
      animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .panel-glow.references-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(34,197,94,0.45), transparent 70%);
      animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .panel-glow.analytics-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.5), transparent 70%);
      animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .panel-glow.prices-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.6), transparent 70%);
      animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes glowPulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; }
      50% { opacity: 1; }
    }
    body.light-theme .panel-glow.users-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.25), transparent 70%);
    }
    body.light-theme .panel-glow.references-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(34,197,94,0.2), transparent 70%);
    }
    body.light-theme .panel-glow.analytics-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.25), transparent 70%);
    }
    body.light-theme .panel-glow.prices-glow {
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 30% at 50% 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.25), transparent 70%);
    }

    .admin-panel {
      display: none;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      background: transparent;
    }
    .admin-panel.active {
      display: block;
      animation: panelFadeIn 0.3s ease;
    }
    @keyframes panelFadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       S-CARD (Settings Card)
       ============================================================ */
    .s-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    }
    .s-card-header {
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .65rem;
    }
    .s-card-header-icon {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .s-card-header h2 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .s-card-header p {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: .1rem 0 0;
    }
    .s-card-body { padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; }

    /* ============================================================
       MOBILE TABS
       ============================================================ */
    .admin-tabs-mobile {
      display: none;
      gap: .4rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .admin-tab-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: .35rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: .45rem .85rem;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .admin-tab-btn.active {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1);
      border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      color: var(--accent2);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PAGE HEADER
       ============================================================ */
    .page-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .page-header h1 {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text) 0%, var(--accent2) 100%);
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .page-header .subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .admin-badge {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,92,246,0.2), rgba(167,139,250,0.1));
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      color: var(--accent2);
      padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 99px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       TABLO STİLLERİ
       ============================================================ */
    .ww-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .ww-table thead {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .ww-table th {
      padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    .ww-table td {
      padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      vertical-align: middle;
      line-height: 1.5;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .ww-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    .ww-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.04); }

    /* ============================================================
       STATS GRID
       ============================================================ */
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .stat-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .stat-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.25);
    }
    .stat-card .stat-label {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }
    .stat-card .stat-value {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .stat-card .stat-value.green { color: var(--green); }
    .stat-card .stat-value.red { color: var(--red); }
    .stat-card .stat-value.accent { color: var(--accent2); }
    .stat-card .stat-sub {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PLAN BADGE (Kullanıcı Listesi)
       ============================================================ */
    .plan-badge-user {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 0.15rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .plan-badge-user.free {
      background: rgba(107,107,128,0.1);
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .plan-badge-user.premium {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
      color: var(--accent2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.25);
    }
    .plan-badge-user .dot {
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .plan-badge-user.premium .dot {
      background: var(--accent2);
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(139,92,246,0.4);
      animation: dotPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .plan-badge-user.free .dot {
      background: var(--muted);
    }
    @keyframes dotPulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.7); }
    }

    .expiry-text {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .expiry-text.soon {
      color: #f59e0b;
    }
    .expiry-text.expired {
      color: var(--red);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PRICE CARDS
       ============================================================ */
    .price-card {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .price-card .price-title {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .price-card .price-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .price-input-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .price-input-group label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      min-width: 60px;
    }
    .price-input-group input[type="number"] {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      width: 100px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .price-input-group input[type="number"]:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .price-input-group .currency-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .payment-methods-grid {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .payment-method-chip {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .payment-method-chip .remove-method {
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .payment-method-chip .remove-method:hover {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .add-method-input {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .add-method-input input {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      width: 70px;
      outline: none;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .add-method-input input:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .add-method-input button {
      background: var(--accent);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .add-method-input button:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
    .price-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CHARTS
       ============================================================ */
    .charts-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }
    .charts-grid-full {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .charts-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .charts-grid-full { grid-column: 1; }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SEARCH
       ============================================================ */
    .search-wrap {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .search-wrap svg {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .search-input {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem 0.45rem 2.25rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      width: 200px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .search-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); }

    .id-chip {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .role-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.65rem;
      border-radius: 99px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    .role-admin { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15); color: var(--accent2); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.25); }
    .role-user { background: rgba(107,107,128,0.1); color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .status-online {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
      color: var(--green); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500;
    }
    .status-online::before {
      content: '';
      width: 6px; height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--green-glow);
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }
    .status-offline {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
      color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px;
    }
    .status-offline::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted); }
    @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

    .ref-social-icons { font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 3px; }

    .recent-premium-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .recent-premium-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.03);
    }
    .recent-premium-card .avatar-small {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    }
    .recent-premium-card .avatar-small img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .recent-premium-card .info {
      flex: 1;
    }
    .recent-premium-card .info .name {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .recent-premium-card .info .email {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    .recent-premium-card .info .plan-type {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--accent2);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1);
      padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
    }
    .recent-premium-card .amount {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       NAV - GÖMÜLÜ NAVBAR KALDIRILDI
       ============================================================ */
    /* Tüm nav stilleri kaldırıldı. */
    /* Artık navbar-container ve navbar.js kullanılacak. */

    .toast-container {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 1.5rem; right: 1.5rem;
      z-index: 9999;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .toast {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 13px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      animation: toastIn 0.3s ease;
      max-width: 320px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .toast.success { border-left: 3px solid var(--green); }
    .toast.success::before { content: '✓'; color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }
    .toast.error { border-left: 3px solid var(--red); }
    .toast.error::before { content: '!'; color: var(--red); font-weight: 700; }
    @keyframes toastIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(20px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 22px; height: 22px;
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      border-top-color: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin .8s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    /* ============================================================
       MOBIL RESPONSIVE (Güncellendi)
       ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 767px) {
      .admin-tabs-mobile { display: flex; }
      .admin-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .admin-sidebar { display: none; }
      .admin-main { padding: 0.9rem 1rem; }
      .page-header { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .charts-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .search-input { width: 100%; }
      .header-actions { width: 100%; }
      .header-actions .search-wrap { width: 100%; }
      .header-actions .search-input { width: 100%; }
      .price-input-group { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .price-input-group input[type="number"] { width: 100%; }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       MODAL
       ============================================================ */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 400;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .modal-box {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 560px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      animation: modalIn 0.25s ease;
    }
    @keyframes modalIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.96) translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }
    .modal-header {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 1.1rem 1.35rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .modal-header h2 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .modal-close {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--red); color: #fff; border-color: var(--red); }
    .modal-body { padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem; }
    .modal-footer {
      display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 1rem 1.35rem 1.25rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .field { margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .field label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    .field input, .field select, .field textarea {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .field select option { background: var(--surface2); }
    .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 70px; }
    .field-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.75rem; }
    @media (max-width: 480px) { .field-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .section-divider {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 1.1rem 0 0.6rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    }
    .section-divider::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border); }
    .avatar-upload { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
    .avatar-preview-sm {
      width: 64px; height: 64px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 2px solid var(--border2);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: var(--surface2);
    }
    .avatar-preview-sm img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .avatar-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .btn-sm { padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; font-size: 11px; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 28px; }
    .btn.btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2)); border: none; color: #fff; padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; }
    .btn.btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(139,92,246,0.3); }
    .btn.btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted); padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; }
    .btn.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
    .btn.btn-danger { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--red); color: var(--red); padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; }
    .btn.btn-danger:hover { background: var(--red); color: #fff; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>


  <div id="navbar-container"></div>




  <main class="admin-main" id="main-content">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:4rem;">
      <div class="spinner"></div>
    </div>
  </main>




  <div class="toast-container" id="toast-container"></div>




  <div id="ref-modal" class="modal-overlay">
    <div class="modal-box">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h2 id="ref-modal-title">Yeni Referans Ekle</h2>
        <button class="modal-close" id="close-ref-modal">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <input type="hidden" id="ref-id" />
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field">
            <label>İsim *</label>
            <input type="text" id="ref-name" placeholder="Ahmet Yılmaz" />
          </div>
          <div class="field">
            <label>Ünvan / Pozisyon</label>
            <input type="text" id="ref-title" placeholder="Forex Trader" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Açıklama</label>
          <textarea id="ref-desc" rows="3" placeholder="Bu kişi hakkında kısa bilgi..."></textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="section-divider">Profil Fotoğrafı</div>
        <div class="avatar-upload">
          <div class="avatar-preview-sm">
            <img id="ref-image-preview-img" src="https://placehold.co/64x64?text=Photo" />
          </div>
          <div class="avatar-actions">
            <input type="file" id="ref-image-file" accept="image/*" style="display:none;" />
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="upload-image-btn">
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/><polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"/></svg>
              Resim Seç
            </button>
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" id="remove-image-btn">
              <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6"/></svg>
              Kaldır
            </button>
            <input type="hidden" id="ref-image" value="" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row" style="margin-top:0.75rem;">
          <div class="field"><label>Sıralama</label><input type="number" id="ref-order" value="0" /></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Durum</label><select id="ref-active"><option value="true">✓ Aktif</option><option value="false">○ Pasif</option></select></div>
        </div>
        <div class="section-divider">Sosyal Medya</div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field"><label>Instagram</label><input type="text" id="ref-insta" placeholder="https://instagram.com/..." /></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Twitter / X</label><input type="text" id="ref-twitter" placeholder="https://twitter.com/..." /></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field"><label>YouTube</label><input type="text" id="ref-youtube" placeholder="https://youtube.com/..." /></div>
          <div class="field"><label>LinkedIn</label><input type="text" id="ref-linkedin" placeholder="https://linkedin.com/..." /></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="cancel-ref-btn">İptal</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" id="save-ref-btn">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
          Kaydet
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>




  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
  <script src="config.js"></script>
  <script src="i18n.js"></script>
  <script src="script.js"></script>


  <script src="/components/navbar.js"></script>
  <script>
    // 3. EKLENDI: Navbar yükleme fonksiyonu
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (typeof loadNavbar === 'function') {
        loadNavbar('navbar-container');
      }
    });
  </script>

  <script>
    // ⭐ PLAN BADGE GÜNCELLEME (Artık navbar.js ile geliyor, ama yine de çalıştıralım)
    async function updatePlanBadge() {
      var badge = document.querySelector('.plan-badge');
      var text = document.querySelector('.plan-text');
      if (!badge || !text) return;

      try {
        var planData = await getUserPlan();
        var isPremium = planData.plan === 'premium';

        if (isPremium) {
          badge.classList.add('premium');
          text.textContent = 'Premium';
        } else {
          badge.classList.remove('premium');
          text.textContent = 'Ücretsiz';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      setTimeout(updatePlanBadge, 500);
    });

    i18n.onChange(function() {
      updatePlanBadge();
    });

    var currentTab = 'users';
    var references = [];
    var usersList = [];
    var userChart = null;
    var tradeChart = null;
    var premiumChart = null;
    var searchTimeout = null;

    // ============================================================
    // TOAST
    // ============================================================
    function showToast(msg, type) {
      type = type || 'success';
      try {
        var tc = document.getElementById('toast-container');
        if (!tc) return;
        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'toast ' + type;
        el.textContent = msg;
        tc.appendChild(el);
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (el && el.parentNode) el.remove();
        }, 3500);
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DATE FORMAT
    // ============================================================
    function formatDate(iso) {
      if (!iso) return '—';
      try {
        var d = new Date(iso);
        return d.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
      } catch(e) {
        return '—';
      }
    }

    function formatDateFull(iso) {
      if (!iso) return '—';
      try {
        var d = new Date(iso);
        return d.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
      } catch(e) {
        return '—';
      }
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return str.replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(m) {
        var map = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' };
        return map[m] || m;
      });
    }

    function getInitials(name) {
      if (!name) return '?';
      return name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    }

    // ============================================================
    // AVATAR - navbar.js ile geldiği için bu fonksiyon artık kullanılmıyor.
    // ============================================================

    // ============================================================
    // LOAD FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================
    async function loadUsers() {
      try {
        var { data: profiles, error } = await sb
          .from('user_profiles').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false });
        if (error) throw error;
        usersList = (profiles || []).map(function(p) {
          return {
            id: p.id,
            email: p.email || '—',
            username: p.username || '—',
            user_metadata: { username: p.username || '—', role: p.role || 'user' },
            plan: p.plan || 'free',
            plan_expires_at: p.plan_expires_at || null,
            created_at: p.created_at,
            last_active: p.last_active,
            avatar_url: p.avatar_url || null
          };
        });
      } catch (e) {
        showToast('Kullanıcılar yüklenemedi!', 'error');
        usersList = [];
      }
    }

    async function loadReferences() {
      try {
        var { data, error } = await sb.from('references').select('*').order('display_order', { ascending: true });
        if (!error) references = data || [];
      } catch (e) {
        references = [];
      }
    }

    function filterUsers(term) {
      if (!term) return usersList;
      var t = term.toLowerCase();
      return usersList.filter(function(u) {
        return (u.email || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(t) !== -1 ||
          (u.id || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(t) !== -1 ||
          (u.username || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(t) !== -1;
      });
    }

    // ⭐ Premium kullanıcıları filtreleme özelliği
    function filterPremiumUsers(users) {
      return users.filter(function(u) {
        return u.plan === 'premium' && u.plan_expires_at && new Date(u.plan_expires_at) > new Date();
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // SWITCH PANEL
    // ============================================================
    function switchPanel(panelId, clickedEl) {
      var panels = document.querySelectorAll('.admin-panel');
      panels.forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });

      var targetPanel = document.getElementById(panelId);
      if (targetPanel) targetPanel.classList.add('active');

      var sidebarItems = document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-nav-item');
      sidebarItems.forEach(function(b) {
        b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.panel === panelId);
      });

      var tabItems = document.querySelectorAll('.admin-tab-btn');
      tabItems.forEach(function(b) {
        b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.panel === panelId);
      });

      var glow = document.getElementById('panel-glow');
      if (glow) {
        glow.className = 'panel-glow';
        if (panelId === 'panel-users') glow.classList.add('users-glow');
        else if (panelId === 'panel-references') glow.classList.add('references-glow');
        else if (panelId === 'panel-analytics') glow.classList.add('analytics-glow');
        else if (panelId === 'panel-prices') glow.classList.add('prices-glow');
      }

      if (panelId === 'panel-users') renderUsersTable();
      if (panelId === 'panel-references') renderReferencesTable();
      if (panelId === 'panel-analytics') loadAnalyticsData();
      if (panelId === 'panel-prices') renderPricesContent();
    }

    // ============================================================
    // RENDER ADMIN PANEL
    // ============================================================
    function renderAdminPanel() {
      var main = document.getElementById('main-content');
      if (!main) return;

      var mobileTabs = '\n        <div class="admin-tabs-mobile" id="mobile-tabs">\n          <button class="admin-tab-btn active" data-panel="panel-users" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-users\', this)">👥 Kullanıcılar</button>\n          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-panel="panel-references" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-references\', this)">📋 Referanslar</button>\n          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-panel="panel-analytics" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-analytics\', this)">📊 İstatistikler</button>\n          <button class="admin-tab-btn" data-panel="panel-prices" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-prices\', this)">💰 Fiyat Yönetimi</button>\n        </div>\n      ';

      var sidebar = '\n        <aside class="admin-sidebar">\n          <div class="sidebar-header">\n            <div class="sidebar-avatar" id="admin-sidebar-avatar">\n              <span class="no-avatar">A</span>\n            </div>\n            <div class="sidebar-username" id="admin-sidebar-username">Admin</div>\n            <div class="sidebar-email" id="admin-sidebar-email">admin@example.com</div>\n          </div>\n          <nav class="sidebar-nav">\n            <button class="sidebar-nav-item active" data-panel="panel-users" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-users\', this)">\n              👥 Kullanıcılar\n            </button>\n            <button class="sidebar-nav-item" data-panel="panel-references" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-references\', this)">\n              📋 Referanslar\n            </button>\n            <button class="sidebar-nav-item" data-panel="panel-analytics" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-analytics\', this)">\n              📊 İstatistikler\n            </button>\n            <div class="sidebar-nav-divider"></div>\n            <button class="sidebar-nav-item" data-panel="panel-prices" onclick="switchPanel(\'panel-prices\', this)">\n              💰 Fiyat Yönetimi\n            </button>\n          </nav>\n        </aside>\n      ';

      var panels = '\n        <div class="admin-panels">\n          <div class="panel-glow users-glow" id="panel-glow"></div>\n          \n          \n          <div class="admin-panel active" id="panel-users">\n            <div class="s-card">\n              <div class="s-card-header">\n                <div class="s-card-header-icon"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M17 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H5a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M23 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg></div>\n                <div><h2>Kullanıcı Listesi</h2><p>Platformdaki tüm kullanıcılar — <strong id="user-count" style="color:var(--text);">…</strong> kayıt</p></div>\n                <div style="margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:0.5rem;align-items:center;">\n                  <div class="search-wrap">\n                    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>\n                    <input type="text" id="user-search" class="search-input" placeholder="Ara..." style="width:160px;" />\n                  </div>\n                  <button id="refresh-users-btn" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="loadUsers(); renderUsersTable();">🔄</button>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n              <div class="s-card-body">\n                <div id="users-table-container"></div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          \n          <div class="admin-panel" id="panel-references">\n            <div class="s-card">\n              <div class="s-card-header">\n                <div class="s-card-header-icon"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><polygon points="12 2 15.09 8.26 22 9.27 17 14.14 18.18 21.02 12 17.77 5.82 21.02 7 14.14 2 9.27 8.91 8.26 12 2"/></svg></div>\n                <div><h2>Referans Yönetimi</h2><p>Anlaşma yapılan kişi ve kurumlar — <strong id="ref-count" style="color:var(--text);">' + references.length + '</strong> kayıt</p></div>\n                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" id="add-reference-btn" style="margin-left:auto;padding:0.35rem 0.9rem;font-size:11px;">+ Yeni</button>\n              </div>\n              <div class="s-card-body">\n                <div id="references-table-container"></div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          \n          <div class="admin-panel" id="panel-analytics">\n            <div class="s-card">\n              <div class="s-card-header">\n                <div class="s-card-header-icon"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"/><line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"/><line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"/></svg></div>\n                <div><h2>Platform İstatistikleri</h2><p>Son 7 günlük aktivite verileri ve premium satışları</p></div>\n              </div>\n              <div class="s-card-body">\n                <div class="stats-grid" id="analytics-stats">\n                  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">Toplam Kullanıcı</div><div class="stat-value" id="stat-total-users">—</div></div>\n                  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">Toplam Premium</div><div class="stat-value" id="stat-total-premium">—</div></div>\n                  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">Premium Gelir (Toplam)</div><div class="stat-value" id="stat-premium-revenue">—</div></div>\n                  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-label">Son 7 Gün Premium</div><div class="stat-value" id="stat-premium-7days">—</div></div>\n                </div>\n                <div class="charts-grid">\n                  <div class="chart-card"><h3>Günlük Yeni Kullanıcılar (Son 7 Gün)</h3><div class="chart-wrap"><canvas id="usersChart"></canvas></div></div>\n                  <div class="chart-card"><h3>Günlük Premium Satışları (Son 7 Gün) - $</h3><div class="chart-wrap"><canvas id="premiumChart"></canvas></div></div>\n                  <div class="chart-card charts-grid-full"><h3>📦 Son Premium Alan Kullanıcılar</h3><div id="recent-premium-list" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem;padding:0.5rem 0;"><div style="text-align:center;padding:1rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;">Yükleniyor...</div></div></div>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          \n          <div class="admin-panel" id="panel-prices">\n            <div class="s-card">\n              <div class="s-card-header">\n                <div class="s-card-header-icon"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M12 2v20M17 5H9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7H6"/></svg></div>\n                <div><h2>Fiyat Yönetimi</h2><p>Premium plan fiyatlarını, indirimleri ve ödeme seçeneklerini yönetin.</p></div>\n              </div>\n              <div class="s-card-body">\n                <div id="prices-container"></div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';

      main.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="page-header">\n          <div>\n            <h1>Admin Panel</h1>\n            <p class="subtitle">Platform yönetimi ve analiz araçları</p>\n          </div>\n          <span class="admin-badge">⚡ ADMİN</span>\n        </div>\n        ' + mobileTabs + '\n        <div class="admin-wrap">\n          ' + sidebar + '\n          ' + panels + '\n        </div>\n      ';

      // Event bindings
      var addRefBtn = document.getElementById('add-reference-btn');
      if (addRefBtn) {
        addRefBtn.addEventListener('click', function() { openReferenceModal(); });
      }

      var userSearch = document.getElementById('user-search');
      if (userSearch) {
        userSearch.addEventListener('input', function() {
          clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
          searchTimeout = setTimeout(renderUsersTable, 300);
        });
      }

      var refreshBtn = document.getElementById('refresh-users-btn');
      if (refreshBtn) {
        refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
          await loadUsers();
          renderUsersTable();
        });
      }

      // Admin sidebar avatar
      (async function() {
        try {
          var { data: { user } } = await sb.auth.getUser();
          if (user) {
            var username = (user.user_metadata && user.user_metadata.username) || (user.email ? user.email.split('@')[0] : 'Admin');
            var usernameEl = document.getElementById('admin-sidebar-username');
            var emailEl = document.getElementById('admin-sidebar-email');
            if (usernameEl) usernameEl.textContent = username;
            if (emailEl) emailEl.textContent = user.email || '—';
            var { data: profile } = await sb.from('user_profiles').select('avatar_url').eq('id', user.id).single();
            var avatarEl = document.getElementById('admin-sidebar-avatar');
            if (avatarEl) {
              if (profile && profile.avatar_url) {
                avatarEl.innerHTML = '<img src="' + profile.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar">';
              } else {
                avatarEl.innerHTML = '<span class="no-avatar">' + username.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + '</span>';
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Sessizce geç
        }
      })();

      // Load data
      renderUsersTable();
      renderReferencesTable();
      renderPricesContent();
      setTimeout(loadAnalyticsData, 500);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // USERS TABLE - Premium süresi gösterimi düzeltildi
    // ============================================================
    async function renderUsersTable() {
      var container = document.getElementById('users-table-container');
      if (!container) return;

      var term = '';
      var searchInput = document.getElementById('user-search');
      if (searchInput) term = searchInput.value || '';

      var filtered = filterUsers(term);
      var countEl = document.getElementById('user-count');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = filtered.length;

      try {
        var { data: trades } = await sb.from('trades').select('user_id');
        var tradeCounts = {};
        (trades || []).forEach(function(t) {
          tradeCounts[t.user_id] = (tradeCounts[t.user_id] || 0) + 1;
        });
      } catch(e) {
        var tradeCounts = {};
      }

      var now = new Date();
      var AW = 10 * 60 * 1000;

      var rows = filtered.map(function(u) {
        var online = u.last_active && (now - new Date(u.last_active)) < AW;
        var role = (u.user_metadata && u.user_metadata.role) || 'user';
        var tc = tradeCounts[u.id] || 0;
        var isPremium = u.plan === 'premium';
        var expiresAt = u.plan_expires_at ? new Date(u.plan_expires_at) : null;
        var isExpired = isPremium && expiresAt && new Date() > expiresAt;

        var expiryText = '—';
        var expiryClass = '';
        if (isPremium && expiresAt) {
          if (isExpired) {
            expiryText = '⏳ Süresi Doldu';
            expiryClass = 'expired';
          } else {
            var daysLeft = Math.ceil((expiresAt - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            expiryText = daysLeft + ' gün';
            if (daysLeft < 3) expiryClass = 'soon';
          }
        }

        var avatarHtml = u.avatar_url
          ? '<img src="' + u.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar" style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;">'
          : '<span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;">' + getInitials(u.username) + '</span>';

        return '<tr>\n          <td><span class="id-chip">' + (u.id || '').slice(0, 8) + '…</span></td>\n          <td>\n            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">\n              <div style="width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;">\n                ' + avatarHtml + '\n              </div>\n              <span style="font-weight:500;">' + escapeHtml(u.username || '—') + '</span>\n            </div>\n          </td>\n          <td style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;">' + escapeHtml(u.email || '—') + '</td>\n          <td>\n            <span class="plan-badge-user ' + (isPremium && !isExpired ? 'premium' : 'free') + '">\n              <span class="dot"></span>\n              ' + (isPremium && !isExpired ? 'Premium' : 'Free') + '\n            </span>\n          </td>\n          <td style="font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">\n            ' + (isPremium && !isExpired
              ? '<span class="expiry-text ' + expiryClass + '">' + expiryText + '</span>'
              : '<span class="expiry-text">' + expiryText + '</span>') + '\n          </td>\n          <td style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);">\n            ' + (isPremium && expiresAt && !isExpired ? formatDate(expiresAt) : '—') + '\n          </td>\n          <td style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);">' + formatDate(u.created_at) + '</td>\n          <td>' + (online ? '<span class="status-online">Aktif</span>' : '<span class="status-offline">Çevrimdışı</span>') + '</td>\n          <td><span class="role-badge role-' + role + '">' + (role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'User') + '</span></td>\n        </tr>';
      }).join('');

      container.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="table-wrap" style="background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;">\n          <div style="overflow-x:auto;">\n            <table class="ww-table">\n              <thead>\n                <tr><th>ID</th><th>Kullanıcı</th><th>E-posta</th><th>Plan</th><th>Kalan Süre</th><th>Bitiş Tarihi</th><th>Kayıt</th><th>Durum</th><th>Rol</th></tr>\n              </thead>\n              <tbody>\n                ' + (rows || '<tr><td colspan="9"><div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;">Kullanıcı bulunamadı.</div></td></tr>') + '\n              </tbody>\n            </table>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REFERENCES TABLE
    // ============================================================
    function renderReferencesTable() {
      var container = document.getElementById('references-table-container');
      if (!container) return;

      var countEl = document.getElementById('ref-count');
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = references.length;

      var rows = references.map(function(r) {
        return '<tr>\n          <td>\n            <div style="width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid var(--border2);background:var(--surface2);">\n              <img src="' + (r.image_url || 'https://placehold.co/40x40?text=?') + '" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">\n            </div>\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            <div style="font-weight:600;color:var(--text);">' + escapeHtml(r.name) + '</div>\n            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;">' + escapeHtml(r.title || '—') + '</div>\n          </td>\n          <td class="ref-social-icons">\n            ' + (r.instagram ? '<span title="Instagram">📷</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (r.twitter ? '<span title="Twitter">🐦</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (r.youtube ? '<span title="YouTube">▶️</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (r.linkedin ? '<span title="LinkedIn">🔗</span>' : '') + '\n            ' + (!r.instagram && !r.twitter && !r.youtube && !r.linkedin ? '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;">—</span>' : '') + '\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            ' + (r.is_active
              ? '<span style="background:rgba(34,197,94,0.1);color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;">Aktif</span>'
              : '<span style="background:rgba(107,107,128,0.1);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;">Pasif</span>') + '\n          </td>\n          <td>\n            <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;">\n              <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="editReference(\'' + r.id + '\')">\n                <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg>\n                Düzenle\n              </button>\n              <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="deleteReference(\'' + r.id + '\')">\n                <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6"/></svg>\n                Sil\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </td>\n        </tr>';
      }).join('');

      container.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="table-wrap" style="background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;">\n          <div style="overflow-x:auto;">\n            <table class="ww-table">\n              <thead><tr><th>Fotoğraf</th><th>Kişi / Kurum</th><th>Sosyal</th><th>Durum</th><th>İşlem</th></tr></thead>\n              <tbody>\n                ' + (rows || '<tr><td colspan="5"><div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem 1rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;">Henüz referans eklenmemiş.</div></td></tr>') + '\n              </tbody>\n            </table>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // PRICES CONTENT
    // ============================================================
    function renderPricesContent() {
      var container = document.getElementById('prices-container');
      if (!container) return;

      var monthly = 9;
      var yearly = 79;
      var methods = ['BTC', 'LTC'];
      var discount = 27;

      try {
        if (window.getMonthlyPrice) monthly = window.getMonthlyPrice();
        if (window.getYearlyPrice) yearly = window.getYearlyPrice();
        if (window.getPaymentMethods) methods = window.getPaymentMethods();
        if (window.getYearlyDiscount) discount = window.getYearlyDiscount();
      } catch(e) {}

      container.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">💰 Aylık Plan Fiyatı</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Premium aylık abonelik fiyatını belirleyin.</div>\n          <div class="price-input-group">\n            <label>Aylık Fiyat</label>\n            <input type="number" id="price-monthly-input" value="' + monthly + '" min="0.5" step="0.5" />\n            <span class="currency-label">USD</span>\n            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:0.5rem;">Mevcut: $' + monthly.toFixed(2) + '</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">📅 Yıllık Plan Fiyatı</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Premium yıllık abonelik fiyatını belirleyin.</div>\n          <div class="price-input-group">\n            <label>Yıllık Fiyat</label>\n            <input type="number" id="price-yearly-input" value="' + yearly + '" min="0.5" step="0.5" />\n            <span class="currency-label">USD</span>\n            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:0.5rem;">Mevcut: $' + yearly.toFixed(2) + '</span>\n          </div>\n          <div style="margin-top:0.5rem;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);">\n            💡 Mevcut indirim: <span id="discount-display">' + discount + '%</span>\n            ' + (discount > 0 ? '<span style="color:var(--green);margin-left:0.5rem;">✅ Aktif</span>' : '') + '\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">💳 Ödeme Seçenekleri</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Kullanıcıların ödeme yapabileceği kripto para birimlerini seçin.</div>\n          <div class="payment-methods-grid" id="payment-methods-container">\n            ' + methods.map(function(m) {
              return '<span class="payment-method-chip">\n                ' + m + '\n                <button class="remove-method" onclick="removePaymentMethod(\'' + m + '\')">✕</button>\n              </span>';
            }).join('') + '\n          </div>\n          <div class="add-method-input" style="margin-top:0.75rem;">\n            <input type="text" id="new-method-input" placeholder="ETH" maxlength="10" />\n            <button onclick="addPaymentMethod()">Ekle</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-card">\n          <div class="price-title">🎯 İndirim Oranı</div>\n          <div class="price-desc">Yıllık plan için indirim oranını belirleyin (yüzde).</div>\n          <div class="price-input-group">\n            <label>İndirim %</label>\n            <input type="number" id="discount-input" value="' + discount + '" min="0" max="90" step="1" />\n            <span class="currency-label">%</span>\n            <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:0.5rem;">Öneri: %27-40</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="price-actions">\n          <button class="btn btn-primary" id="save-prices-btn">💾 Fiyatları Kaydet</button>\n          <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="reset-prices-btn">↺ Varsayılana Dön</button>\n        </div>\n\n        <div style="margin-top:1rem;padding:1rem;background:rgba(139,92,246,0.04);border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid var(--border);">\n          <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;">\n            <strong>📌 Not:</strong> Fiyat değişiklikleri tüm kullanıcılar için geçerli olacaktır. \n            Yeni fiyatlar otomatik olarak ana sayfa, ayarlar sayfası ve NowPayment entegrasyonuna yansıyacaktır.\n          </p>\n        </div>\n      ';

      // ⭐ setYearlyDiscount kontrolü ile kaydetme
      var saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-prices-btn');
      if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var monthlyInput = document.getElementById('price-monthly-input');
          var yearlyInput = document.getElementById('price-yearly-input');
          var discountInput = document.getElementById('discount-input');

          var monthlyVal = parseFloat(monthlyInput ? monthlyInput.value : 0);
          var yearlyVal = parseFloat(yearlyInput ? yearlyInput.value : 0);
          var discountVal = parseFloat(discountInput ? discountInput.value : 0);

          if (!monthlyVal || monthlyVal < 0 || !yearlyVal || yearlyVal < 0 || discountVal < 0 || discountVal > 90) {
            showToast('Geçerli değerler giriniz!', 'error');
            return;
          }

          if (window.setMonthlyPrice) window.setMonthlyPrice(monthlyVal);
          if (window.setYearlyPrice) window.setYearlyPrice(yearlyVal);

          if (window.setYearlyDiscount) {
            window.setYearlyDiscount(discountVal);
          } else {
            try {
              localStorage.setItem('ww_yearly_discount', String(discountVal));
            } catch (e) {}
          }

          var methods = [];
          var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-chip');
          chips.forEach(function(chip) {
            var text = chip.textContent.trim().replace('✕', '').trim();
            if (text) methods.push(text);
          });
          if (methods.length > 0 && window.setPaymentMethods) window.setPaymentMethods(methods);

          showToast('✅ Fiyatlar başarıyla kaydedildi!', 'success');
          var discountDisplay = document.getElementById('discount-display');
          if (discountDisplay) discountDisplay.textContent = discountVal + '%';
          if (window.updateHomePrices) window.updateHomePrices();
        });
      }

      var resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset-prices-btn');
      if (resetBtn) {
        resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (confirm('Varsayılan fiyatlara dönmek istediğinizden emin misiniz?')) {
            if (window.resetPrices) window.resetPrices();
            showToast('↺ Varsayılan fiyatlara dönüldü.', 'success');
            renderPricesContent();
          }
        });
      }
    }
