    function addPaymentMethod() {
      var input = document.getElementById('new-method-input');
      if (!input) return;
      var method = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
      if (!method) {
        showToast('Lütfen bir kripto para birimi girin (örn: ETH)', 'error');
        return;
      }

      var methods = [];
      var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-chip');
      chips.forEach(function(chip) {
        var text = chip.textContent.trim().replace('✕', '').trim();
        if (text) methods.push(text);
      });

      if (methods.indexOf(method) !== -1) {
        showToast('Bu ödeme metodu zaten ekli!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      methods.push(method);
      if (window.setPaymentMethods) window.setPaymentMethods(methods);
      renderPricesContent();
      showToast('✅ ' + method + ' eklendi!', 'success');
    }

    function removePaymentMethod(method) {
      var methods = [];
      var chips = document.querySelectorAll('.payment-method-chip');
      chips.forEach(function(chip) {
        var text = chip.textContent.trim().replace('✕', '').trim();
        if (text && text !== method) methods.push(text);
      });

      if (methods.length === 0) {
        showToast('En az bir ödeme metodu olmalıdır!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      if (window.setPaymentMethods) window.setPaymentMethods(methods);
      renderPricesContent();
      showToast('🗑️ ' + method + ' kaldırıldı.', 'success');
    }

    // ============================================================
    // ANALYTICS DATA - Premium gelir hesaplaması düzeltildi
    // ============================================================
    async function loadAnalyticsData() {
      try {
        var today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
        var last7 = [];
        for (var i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
          var d = new Date();
          d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
          last7.push(d.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
        }

        var { data: profiles } = await sb.from('user_profiles').select('*');
        var { data: trades } = await sb.from('trades').select('id, created_at');

        var profileList = profiles || [];
        var tradeList = trades || [];

        // ⭐ Premium kullanıcılar - süresi dolmamış olanlar
        var premiumUsers = profileList.filter(function(p) {
          return p.plan === 'premium' && p.plan_expires_at && new Date(p.plan_expires_at) > new Date();
        });
        var totalPremium = premiumUsers.length;

        // ⭐ Toplam premium gelir - DOĞRU HESAPLAMA
        var totalRevenue = 0;
        var revenue7Days = 0;
        var revenueByDay = {};
        var recentPremiumUsers = [];

        profileList.forEach(function(p) {
          if (p.plan === 'premium' && p.plan_expires_at) {
            var expiresAt = new Date(p.plan_expires_at);
            var startDate = new Date(expiresAt);
            startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 30);

            var diffDays = Math.ceil((expiresAt - startDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            var isYearly = diffDays > 31;
            var price = isYearly ? 79 : 9;

            totalRevenue += price;

            var dayKey = startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            if (!revenueByDay[dayKey]) revenueByDay[dayKey] = 0;
            revenueByDay[dayKey] += price;

            var sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
            sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);
            if (startDate >= sevenDaysAgo) {
              revenue7Days += price;
              recentPremiumUsers.push({
                username: p.username || p.email || 'İsimsiz',
                email: p.email || '—',
                plan: isYearly ? 'Yıllık' : 'Aylık',
                amount: price,
                date: startDate,
                avatar_url: p.avatar_url || null
              });
            }
          }
        });

        var revenueData = last7.map(function(d) { return revenueByDay[d] || 0; });
        var uCounts = last7.map(function(d) {
          return profileList.filter(function(p) { return p.created_at && p.created_at.split('T')[0] === d; }).length;
        });
        var premium7Days = recentPremiumUsers.length;

        // ⭐ İstatistikleri güncelle
        var statsEls = {
          'stat-total-users': profileList.length,
          'stat-total-premium': totalPremium,
          'stat-premium-revenue': '$' + totalRevenue.toFixed(2),
          'stat-premium-7days': premium7Days
        };
        Object.keys(statsEls).forEach(function(id) {
          var el = document.getElementById(id);
          if (el) el.textContent = statsEls[id];
        });

        var recentContainer = document.getElementById('recent-premium-list');
        if (recentContainer) {
          if (recentPremiumUsers.length === 0) {
            recentContainer.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;">Henüz premium satışı yok.</div>';
          } else {
            recentContainer.innerHTML = recentPremiumUsers.sort(function(a, b) { return b.date - a.date; }).slice(0, 10).map(function(u) {
              var avatarHtml = u.avatar_url
                ? '<img src="' + u.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">'
                : '<span style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;">' + getInitials(u.username) + '</span>';

              return '\n              <div class="recent-premium-card">\n                <div class="avatar-small">' + avatarHtml + '</div>\n                <div class="info">\n                  <div class="name">' + escapeHtml(u.username) + '</div>\n                  <div class="email">' + escapeHtml(u.email) + '</div>\n                  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;margin-top:2px;">\n                    <span class="plan-type">' + u.plan + '</span>\n                    <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;">' + formatDateFull(u.date) + '</span>\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n                <div class="amount">+$' + u.amount.toFixed(2) + '</div>\n              </div>\n            ';
            }).join('');
          }
        }

        var labels = last7.map(function(d) { return d.slice(5).replace('-', '/'); });
        var chartDefaults = {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { display: false },
            tooltip: {
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(17,17,24,0.95)',
              borderColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.3)',
              borderWidth: 1,
              padding: 10,
              titleFont: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 },
              bodyFont: { family: 'DM Sans', size: 13 }
            }
          },
          scales: {
            x: { grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }, ticks: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 } } },
            y: { grid: { color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }, ticks: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 } }, beginAtZero: true }
          }
        };

        if (userChart) { try { userChart.destroy(); } catch(e) {} userChart = null; }
        if (premiumChart) { try { premiumChart.destroy(); } catch(e) {} premiumChart = null; }

        var usersCtx = document.getElementById('usersChart');
        if (usersCtx) {
          userChart = new Chart(usersCtx, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ label: 'Kullanıcı', data: uCounts, backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.2)', borderColor: '#34d399', borderWidth: 2, borderRadius: 6 }] },
            options: chartDefaults
          });
        }

        var premiumCtx = document.getElementById('premiumChart');
        if (premiumCtx) {
          premiumChart = new Chart(premiumCtx, {
            type: 'bar',
            data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ label: 'Premium Gelir ($)', data: revenueData, backgroundColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.25)', borderColor: '#7c6dfa', borderWidth: 2, borderRadius: 6 }] },
            options: {
              plugins: {
                legend: { display: true, labels: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 10 } } },
                tooltip: chartDefaults.plugins.tooltip
              },
              scales: {
                x: chartDefaults.scales.x,
                y: { grid: chartDefaults.scales.y.grid, ticks: { color: '#6b6b80', font: { family: 'DM Mono', size: 11 }, callback: function(value) { return '$' + value; } }, beginAtZero: true }
              },
              responsive: true,
              maintainAspectRatio: false
            }
          });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REFERENCE MODAL FUNCTIONS
    // ============================================================
    var currentImageFile = null;

    var uploadBtn = document.getElementById('upload-image-btn');
    if (uploadBtn) {
      uploadBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var fileInput = document.getElementById('ref-image-file');
        if (fileInput) fileInput.click();
      });
    }

    var fileInput = document.getElementById('ref-image-file');
    if (fileInput) {
      fileInput.addEventListener('change', function(e) {
        var f = e.target.files[0];
        if (!f) return;
        if (!f.type.startsWith('image/')) {
          showToast('Geçerli bir resim seçin!', 'error');
          return;
        }
        if (f.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
          showToast('Resim 2MB\'dan küçük olmalı!', 'error');
          return;
        }
        var r = new FileReader();
        r.onload = function(ev) {
          var preview = document.getElementById('ref-image-preview-img');
          if (preview) preview.src = ev.target.result;
        };
        r.readAsDataURL(f);
        currentImageFile = f;
      });
    }

    var removeImageBtn = document.getElementById('remove-image-btn');
    if (removeImageBtn) {
      removeImageBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var preview = document.getElementById('ref-image-preview-img');
        if (preview) preview.src = 'https://placehold.co/64x64?text=Photo';
        var refImage = document.getElementById('ref-image');
        if (refImage) refImage.value = '';
        currentImageFile = null;
      });
    }

    async function uploadImage(file) {
      if (!file) return null;
      try {
        var ext = file.name.split('.').pop();
        var path = 'references/' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(7) + '.' + ext;
        var { error } = await sb.storage.from('references-images').upload(path, file);
        if (error) return null;
        var publicUrl = sb.storage.from('references-images').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
        return publicUrl;
      } catch(e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function openReferenceModal(ref) {
      ref = ref || null;
      var m = document.getElementById('ref-modal');
      if (!m) return;

      var idEl = document.getElementById('ref-id');
      var nameEl = document.getElementById('ref-name');
      var titleEl = document.getElementById('ref-title');
      var descEl = document.getElementById('ref-desc');
      var orderEl = document.getElementById('ref-order');
      var activeEl = document.getElementById('ref-active');
      var instaEl = document.getElementById('ref-insta');
      var twitterEl = document.getElementById('ref-twitter');
      var youtubeEl = document.getElementById('ref-youtube');
      var linkedinEl = document.getElementById('ref-linkedin');
      var previewEl = document.getElementById('ref-image-preview-img');
      var imageEl = document.getElementById('ref-image');
      var titleModalEl = document.getElementById('ref-modal-title');

      if (idEl) idEl.value = ref && ref.id ? ref.id : '';
      if (nameEl) nameEl.value = ref && ref.name ? ref.name : '';
      if (titleEl) titleEl.value = ref && ref.title ? ref.title : '';
      if (descEl) descEl.value = ref && ref.description ? ref.description : '';
      if (orderEl) orderEl.value = ref && ref.display_order !== undefined ? ref.display_order : 0;
      if (activeEl) activeEl.value = ref && ref.is_active !== undefined ? ref.is_active : true;
      if (instaEl) instaEl.value = ref && ref.instagram ? ref.instagram : '';
      if (twitterEl) twitterEl.value = ref && ref.twitter ? ref.twitter : '';
      if (youtubeEl) youtubeEl.value = ref && ref.youtube ? ref.youtube : '';
      if (linkedinEl) linkedinEl.value = ref && ref.linkedin ? ref.linkedin : '';
      if (previewEl) previewEl.src = ref && ref.image_url ? ref.image_url : 'https://placehold.co/64x64?text=Photo';
      if (imageEl) imageEl.value = ref && ref.image_url ? ref.image_url : '';
      if (titleModalEl) titleModalEl.textContent = ref ? 'Referans Düzenle' : 'Yeni Referans Ekle';
      m.classList.add('open');
      currentImageFile = null;
    }

    function closeReferenceModal() {
      var m = document.getElementById('ref-modal');
      if (m) m.classList.remove('open');
      currentImageFile = null;
    }

    async function saveReference() {
      var idEl = document.getElementById('ref-id');
      var id = idEl ? idEl.value : '';
      var imageEl = document.getElementById('ref-image');
      var imageUrl = imageEl ? imageEl.value : '';

      if (currentImageFile) {
        var url = await uploadImage(currentImageFile);
        if (url) imageUrl = url;
      }

      var nameEl = document.getElementById('ref-name');
      var titleEl = document.getElementById('ref-title');
      var descEl = document.getElementById('ref-desc');
      var orderEl = document.getElementById('ref-order');
      var activeEl = document.getElementById('ref-active');
      var instaEl = document.getElementById('ref-insta');
      var twitterEl = document.getElementById('ref-twitter');
      var youtubeEl = document.getElementById('ref-youtube');
      var linkedinEl = document.getElementById('ref-linkedin');

      var payload = {
        name: nameEl ? nameEl.value.trim() : '',
        title: titleEl ? titleEl.value.trim() : '',
        description: descEl ? descEl.value.trim() : '',
        image_url: imageUrl,
        display_order: parseInt(orderEl ? orderEl.value : 0) || 0,
        is_active: activeEl ? activeEl.value === 'true' : true,
        instagram: instaEl ? instaEl.value.trim() : '',
        twitter: twitterEl ? twitterEl.value.trim() : '',
        youtube: youtubeEl ? youtubeEl.value.trim() : '',
        linkedin: linkedinEl ? linkedinEl.value.trim() : ''
      };

      if (!payload.name) {
        showToast('İsim alanı zorunludur!', 'error');
        return;
      }

      var result;
      if (id) {
        result = await sb.from('references').update(payload).eq('id', id);
      } else {
        result = await sb.from('references').insert([payload]);
      }

      if (result && result.error) {
        showToast('Kayıt hatası: ' + result.error.message, 'error');
        return;
      }

      showToast(id ? 'Referans güncellendi!' : 'Referans eklendi!');
      closeReferenceModal();
      await loadReferences();
      renderReferencesTable();
    }

    async function editReference(id) {
      var ref = references.find(function(r) { return r.id === id; });
      if (ref) openReferenceModal(ref);
    }

    async function deleteReference(id) {
      if (!confirm('Bu referansı silmek istediğinizden emin misiniz?')) return;
      var { error } = await sb.from('references').delete().eq('id', id);
      if (error) {
        showToast('Silme hatası: ' + error.message, 'error');
        return;
      }
      showToast('Referans silindi!');
      await loadReferences();
      renderReferencesTable();
    }

    var cancelRefBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-ref-btn');
    if (cancelRefBtn) cancelRefBtn.addEventListener('click', closeReferenceModal);

    var saveRefBtn = document.getElementById('save-ref-btn');
    if (saveRefBtn) saveRefBtn.addEventListener('click', saveReference);

    var closeRefModal = document.getElementById('close-ref-modal');
    if (closeRefModal) closeRefModal.addEventListener('click', closeReferenceModal);

    var refModal = document.getElementById('ref-modal');
    if (refModal) {
      refModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        if (e.target.id === 'ref-modal') closeReferenceModal();
      });
    }

    // Global functions
    window.switchPanel = switchPanel;
    window.addPaymentMethod = addPaymentMethod;
    window.removePaymentMethod = removePaymentMethod;
    window.editReference = editReference;
    window.deleteReference = deleteReference;
    window.openReferenceModal = openReferenceModal;
    window.renderUsersTable = renderUsersTable;
    window.loadUsers = loadUsers;
    window.renderPricesContent = renderPricesContent;
    window.loadAnalyticsData = loadAnalyticsData;
    window.renderReferencesTable = renderReferencesTable;

    // ⭐ INIT - Admin paneli yükle
    (async function() {
      try {
        var user = await requireAdmin();
        if (!user) return;

        await loadReferences();
        await loadUsers();
        renderAdminPanel();
      } catch (e) {
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
</file>

<file path="public/backtest.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Backtest — Wawe Journal</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
<style>
  /* ============================================================
     BACKTEST SAYFASI - EK STİLLER
     styles.css içindeki değişkenleri ve bileşenleri kullanır
     ============================================================ */

  .bt-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: end;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .bt-chart-card {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .bt-chart-card:hover {
    border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
  }
  #bt-chart { width: 100%; height: 380px; }

  .bt-controls-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .bt-controls-row .bt-divider {
    width: 1px;
    height: 22px;
    background: var(--border2);
  }
  .bt-speed {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .bt-speed input[type="range"] {
    width: 100px;
    accent-color: var(--accent);
  }

  .bt-trade-panel {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: end;
  }

  .btn-buy, .btn-sell {
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    min-height: 38px;
    color: #fff;
  }
  .btn-buy:hover:not(:disabled), .btn-sell:hover:not(:disabled) {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    opacity: 0.92;
  }
  .btn-buy:active:not(:disabled), .btn-sell:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .btn-buy {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green), #16a34a);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--green-glow);
  }
  .btn-sell {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red), #dc2626);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--red-glow);
  }
  .btn-buy:disabled, .btn-sell:disabled {
    opacity: 0.35;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .bt-field-inline {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .bt-field-inline label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  }
  .bt-field-inline input {
    background: var(--surface2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem;
    width: 72px;
    outline: none;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .bt-field-inline input:focus {
    border-color: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-glow);
  }

  .bt-log-section h3 {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    background: none;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--muted);
  }

  .bt-empty-state {
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 2rem 0;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  }

  .bt-status-banner {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--surface2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    display: none;
  }
  .bt-status-banner.show { display: block; }
  .bt-status-banner.error {
    color: var(--red);
    border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.25);
    background: rgba(239,68,68,0.06);
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .bt-trade-panel { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

  <nav class="nav">
    <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-logo">
      <span class="logo-icon">📈</span>
      Wawe<span>Journal</span>
    </a>
    <div class="nav-links">
      <a href="dashboard.html">Panel</a>
      <a href="trades.html">İşlemler</a>
      <a href="calendar.html">Takvim</a>
      <a href="strategies.html">Stratejiler</a>
      <a href="backtest.html" class="active">Backtest</a>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <div class="user-avatar">TR</div>
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main class="dashboard-main">

    <div class="page-header">
      <div>
        <h1>Backtest</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">Geçmiş veri üzerinde bar-by-bar strateji testi</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="btStatusBanner" class="bt-status-banner"></div>

    <div class="bt-toolbar">
      <div class="field" style="margin-bottom:0;">
        <label>Varlık türü</label>
        <select id="btAssetClass">
          <option value="crypto">Kripto</option>
          <option value="forex">Forex</option>
          <option value="stock">Hisse</option>
          <option value="index">Index</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field" style="margin-bottom:0;">
        <label>Sembol</label>
        <input type="text" id="btSymbol" value="BTCUSDT" style="width:140px;">
      </div>
      <div class="field" style="margin-bottom:0;">
        <label>Zaman dilimi</label>
        <select id="btInterval">
          <option value="15m">15 dakika</option>
          <option value="1h">1 saat</option>
          <option value="4h">4 saat</option>
          <option value="1d" selected>1 gün</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="btLoadBtn">Veriyi yükle</button>
    </div>

    <div class="bt-chart-card">
      <div class="chart-header">
        <h3>Fiyat grafiği</h3>
        <span class="chart-badge" id="btDataBadge">Veri yüklenmedi</span>
      </div>
      <div id="bt-chart"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="bt-controls-row">
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btPlayBtn">▶ Oynat</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btStepBtn">1 bar ilerle</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btResetBtn">Sıfırla</button>
      <div class="bt-divider"></div>
      <div class="bt-speed">
        Hız
        <input type="range" id="btSpeed" min="100" max="1200" step="100" value="400">
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stats-grid">
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">Pozisyon</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="btPosStatus" style="font-size:1.1rem;">Yok</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">Anlık PnL</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="btOpenPnl">–</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">Toplam PnL</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="btTotalPnl">%0.00</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">Win rate</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="btWinRate">–</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">İşlem sayısı</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="btTradeCount">0</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bt-trade-panel">
      <button class="btn-buy" id="btBuyBtn">↑ Al</button>
      <button class="btn-sell" id="btSellBtn">↓ Sat</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btCloseBtn">✕ Pozisyonu kapat</button>
      <div class="bt-field-inline">
        <label>TP %</label>
        <input type="number" id="btTpPct" value="2" min="0.1" step="0.1">
      </div>
      <div class="bt-field-inline">
        <label>SL %</label>
        <input type="number" id="btSlPct" value="1" min="0.1" step="0.1">
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bt-log-section">
      <h3>İşlem geçmişi</h3>
      <div class="card" style="padding:0; overflow-x:auto;">
        <table class="ww-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Yön</th><th>Giriş</th><th>Çıkış</th><th>Sebep</th><th>PnL</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="btTradeLogBody"></tbody>
        </table>
        <div id="btEmptyState" class="bt-empty-state">Henüz işlem yok. Grafik üzerinde ilerleyip Al / Sat ile pozisyon aç.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </main>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@4.1.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
  <script>
  /* ============================================================
     1) SUPABASE AYARLARI - WW_CONFIG üzerinden
     ============================================================ */
  // WW_CONFIG config.js'den gelir
  if (typeof WW_CONFIG === 'undefined') {
    console.warn('WW_CONFIG tanımlı değil, fallback kullanılıyor.');
    window.WW_CONFIG = {
      SUPABASE_URL: 'https://odasapyhtdopbnlfhwde.supabase.co',
      SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Im9kYXNhcHlodGRvcGJubGZod2RlIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3Nzg0NDk0NjgsImV4cCI6MjA5NDAyNTQ2OH0.AH7V9i61pFWj33sCy51khdYHZn34BNitXY9exJySmWg'
    };
  }

  let supabaseClient = null;
  try {
    supabaseClient = window.supabase.createClient(
      WW_CONFIG.SUPABASE_URL,
      WW_CONFIG.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Supabase başlatılamadı', e);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     2) VERİ ÇEKME
     - Kripto: Binance public API, key gerekmiyor.
     - Forex / Hisse / Index: Twelve Data, Supabase Edge Function
       üzerinden ('get-candles') — API key'i Edge Function'da.
     ============================================================ */
  const BINANCE_INTERVAL_MAP = { '15m': '15m', '1h': '1h', '4h': '4h', '1d': '1d' };

  async function fetchBinance(symbol, interval) {
    const iv = BINANCE_INTERVAL_MAP[interval] || '1d';
    const url = `https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=${symbol}&interval=${iv}&limit=300`;
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Binance isteği başarısız (' + res.status + ')');
    const raw = await res.json();
    return raw.map(function (k) {
      return {
        time: Math.floor(k[0] / 1000),
        open: parseFloat(k[1]),
        high: parseFloat(k[2]),
        low: parseFloat(k[3]),
        close: parseFloat(k[4])
      };
    });
  }

  async function fetchTwelveData(symbol, interval) {
    if (!supabaseClient) {
      throw new Error('Forex/hisse/index verisi için Supabase Edge Function bağlantısı gerekiyor.');
    }
    // ⭐ Edge Function üzerinden veri çek - API key server-side'da
    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.functions.invoke('get-candles', {
      body: { symbol: symbol, interval: interval }
    });
    if (error) throw error;
    if (!data || !data.values || data.values.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Veri bulunamadı: ' + symbol);
    }
    return data.values.reverse().map(function (v) {
      return {
        time: Math.floor(new Date(v.datetime).getTime() / 1000),
        open: parseFloat(v.open),
        high: parseFloat(v.high),
        low: parseFloat(v.low),
        close: parseFloat(v.close)
      };
    });
  }

  async function fetchCandles(assetClass, symbol, interval) {
    if (assetClass === 'crypto') return fetchBinance(symbol, interval);
    return fetchTwelveData(symbol, interval);
  }

  /* ============================================================
     3) GRAFİK
     ============================================================ */
  const btChartContainer = document.getElementById('bt-chart');
  const btChart = LightweightCharts.createChart(btChartContainer, {
    width: btChartContainer.clientWidth,
    height: 380,
    layout: { background: { color: 'transparent' }, textColor: '#8b8b9e' },
    grid: { vertLines: { color: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.06)' }, horzLines: { color: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.06)' } },
    rightPriceScale: { borderColor: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.12)' },
    timeScale: { borderColor: 'rgba(123,110,246,0.12)' },
    crosshair: { mode: 0 }
  });
  const btSeries = btChart.addCandlestickSeries({
    upColor: '#22c55e', downColor: '#ef4444',
    borderUpColor: '#22c55e', borderDownColor: '#ef4444',
    wickUpColor: '#22c55e', wickDownColor: '#ef4444'
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    btChart.applyOptions({ width: btChartContainer.clientWidth });
  });

  /* ============================================================
     4) REPLAY + POZİSYON MOTORU
     ============================================================ */
  let btFullData = [];
  let btVisibleCount = 0;
  let btPosition = null;
  let btTrades = [];
  let btPlayTimer = null;

  const el = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  const posStatusEl = el('btPosStatus');
  const openPnlEl = el('btOpenPnl');
  const totalPnlEl = el('btTotalPnl');
  const winRateEl = el('btWinRate');
  const tradeCountEl = el('btTradeCount');
  const tradeLogBody = el('btTradeLogBody');
  const emptyState = el('btEmptyState');
  const buyBtn = el('btBuyBtn');
  const sellBtn = el('btSellBtn');
  const closeBtn = el('btCloseBtn');
  const playBtn = el('btPlayBtn');
  const statusBanner = el('btStatusBanner');
  const dataBadge = el('btDataBadge');

  function showStatus(msg, isError) {
    statusBanner.textContent = msg;
    statusBanner.className = 'bt-status-banner show' + (isError ? ' error' : '');
  }
  function hideStatus() { statusBanner.className = 'bt-status-banner'; }

  function currentBar() { return btFullData[btVisibleCount - 1]; }

  function openPosition(side) {
    if (btPosition || btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length) return;
    const entry = currentBar().close;
    const tpPct = parseFloat(el('btTpPct').value) || 2;
    const slPct = parseFloat(el('btSlPct').value) || 1;
    let tp, sl;
    if (side === 'long') {
      tp = entry * (1 + tpPct / 100);
      sl = entry * (1 - slPct / 100);
    } else {
      tp = entry * (1 - tpPct / 100);
      sl = entry * (1 + slPct / 100);
    }
    btPosition = { side: side, entry: entry, tp: tp, sl: sl, entryIndex: btVisibleCount - 1 };
    render();
  }

  function pnlPct(exitPrice) {
    if (!btPosition) return 0;
    const raw = btPosition.side === 'long'
      ? (exitPrice - btPosition.entry) / btPosition.entry
      : (btPosition.entry - exitPrice) / btPosition.entry;
    return raw * 100;
  }

  async function closePosition(exitPrice, reason) {
    if (!btPosition) return;
    const pnl = pnlPct(exitPrice);
    const trade = {
      side: btPosition.side,
      entry: btPosition.entry,
      exit: exitPrice,
      entryTime: btFullData[btPosition.entryIndex].time,
      exitTime: currentBar().time,
      pnl: pnl,
      reason: reason
    };
    btTrades.push(trade);
    btPosition = null;
    render();
    await saveTradeToSupabase(trade);
  }

  async function saveTradeToSupabase(trade) {
    if (!supabaseClient) return;
    try {
      const { data: userData } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();
      const userId = userData && userData.user ? userData.user.id : null;
      if (!userId) return;
      await supabaseClient.from('backtest_trades').insert({
        user_id: userId,
        symbol: el('btSymbol').value,
        side: trade.side,
        entry_price: trade.entry,
        exit_price: trade.exit,
        entry_time: new Date(trade.entryTime * 1000).toISOString(),
        exit_time: new Date(trade.exitTime * 1000).toISOString(),
        pnl_pct: trade.pnl,
        exit_reason: trade.reason
      });
    } catch (e) { console.warn('Trade Supabase\'e kaydedilemedi', e); }
  }

  function checkAutoExit(bar) {
    if (!btPosition) return;
    if (btPosition.side === 'long') {
      if (bar.low <= btPosition.sl) { closePosition(btPosition.sl, 'SL'); return; }
      if (bar.high >= btPosition.tp) { closePosition(btPosition.tp, 'TP'); return; }
    } else {
      if (bar.high >= btPosition.sl) { closePosition(btPosition.sl, 'SL'); return; }
      if (bar.low <= btPosition.tp) { closePosition(btPosition.tp, 'TP'); return; }
    }
  }

  function step() {
    if (btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length) { pause(); return; }
    const bar = btFullData[btVisibleCount];
    btSeries.update(bar);
    btVisibleCount++;
    checkAutoExit(bar);
    render();
  }

  function play() {
    if (btPlayTimer || btFullData.length === 0) return;
    playBtn.textContent = '⏸ Duraklat';
    const speed = parseInt(el('btSpeed').value, 10);
    btPlayTimer = setInterval(step, speed);
  }
  function pause() {
    clearInterval(btPlayTimer);
    btPlayTimer = null;
    playBtn.textContent = '▶ Oynat';
  }

  function fmtPct(v) { return (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(2) + '%'; }

  function render() {
    if (btFullData.length === 0) {
      posStatusEl.textContent = 'Yok';
      buyBtn.disabled = true; sellBtn.disabled = true; closeBtn.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    const bar = currentBar();
    if (btPosition) {
      const live = pnlPct(bar.close);
      posStatusEl.textContent = (btPosition.side === 'long' ? 'Long' : 'Short') + ' @ ' + btPosition.entry.toFixed(2);
      openPnlEl.textContent = fmtPct(live);
      openPnlEl.className = 'stat-value ' + (live >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative');
      buyBtn.disabled = true; sellBtn.disabled = true; closeBtn.disabled = false;
    } else {
      posStatusEl.textContent = 'Yok';
      openPnlEl.textContent = '–';
      openPnlEl.className = 'stat-value';
      buyBtn.disabled = btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length;
      sellBtn.disabled = btVisibleCount >= btFullData.length;
      closeBtn.disabled = true;
    }

    const totalPnl = btTrades.reduce(function (sum, t) { return sum + t.pnl; }, 0);
    totalPnlEl.textContent = fmtPct(totalPnl);
    totalPnlEl.className = 'stat-value ' + (totalPnl > 0 ? 'positive' : (totalPnl < 0 ? 'negative' : ''));

    tradeCountEl.textContent = btTrades.length;

    if (btTrades.length > 0) {
      const wins = btTrades.filter(function (t) { return t.pnl > 0; }).length;
      winRateEl.textContent = Math.round((wins / btTrades.length) * 100) + '%';
    } else {
      winRateEl.textContent = '–';
    }

    if (btTrades.length === 0) {
      tradeLogBody.innerHTML = '';
      emptyState.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      emptyState.style.display = 'none';
      tradeLogBody.innerHTML = btTrades.slice().reverse().map(function (t) {
        const pnlClass = t.pnl >= 0 ? 'trade-pnl positive' : 'trade-pnl negative';
        const badgeClass = t.side === 'long' ? 'badge badge-long' : 'badge badge-short';
        const sideLabel = t.side === 'long' ? 'LONG' : 'SHORT';
        return '<tr>' +
          '<td><span class="' + badgeClass + '">' + sideLabel + '</span></td>' +
          '<td>' + t.entry.toFixed(2) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + t.exit.toFixed(2) + '</td>' +
          '<td>' + t.reason + '</td>' +
          '<td class="' + pnlClass + '">' + fmtPct(t.pnl) + '</td>' +
          '</tr>';
      }).join('');
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     5) EVENT BAĞLANTILARI
     ============================================================ */
  el('btLoadBtn').addEventListener('click', async function () {
    pause();
    hideStatus();
    const assetClass = el('btAssetClass').value;
    const symbol = el('btSymbol').value.trim();
    const interval = el('btInterval').value;
    if (!symbol) { showStatus('Bir sembol gir.', true); return; }

    this.disabled = true;
    this.textContent = 'Yükleniyor…';
    try {
      const data = await fetchCandles(assetClass, symbol, interval);
      if (!data || data.length < 30) throw new Error('Yeterli veri gelmedi.');
      btFullData = data;
      btVisibleCount = Math.min(60, btFullData.length - 1);
      btPosition = null;
      btTrades = [];
      btSeries.setData(btFullData.slice(0, btVisibleCount));
      render();
      dataBadge.textContent = symbol + ' · ' + btFullData.length + ' bar';
      showStatus(symbol + ' için ' + btFullData.length + ' bar yüklendi. Oynat veya adım adım ilerlet.');
    } catch (err) {
      showStatus(err.message || 'Veri çekilemedi.', true);
    } finally {
      this.disabled = false;
      this.textContent = 'Veriyi yükle';
    }
  });

  el('btStepBtn').addEventListener('click', step);
  el('btResetBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    pause();
    if (btFullData.length === 0) return;
    btVisibleCount = Math.min(60, btFullData.length - 1);
    btPosition = null;
    btTrades = [];
    btSeries.setData(btFullData.slice(0, btVisibleCount));
    render();
  });
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (btPlayTimer) pause(); else play(); });
  el('btSpeed').addEventListener('input', function () { if (btPlayTimer) { pause(); play(); } });
  buyBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { openPosition('long'); });
  sellBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { openPosition('short'); });
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { if (btPosition) closePosition(currentBar().close, 'Manuel'); });

  render();
  </script>

</body>
</html>
</file>

<file path="public/calendar.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title data-i18n="calendar.title">Takvim - Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600;9..40,700&family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32,300;14..32,400;14..32,500;14..32,600;14..32,700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/components/navbar.css" />

  <script>
    (function() {
      if (document.body) {
        var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
        if (savedTheme === 'light') {
          document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
        } else {
          document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
        }
      } else {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
          var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
          if (savedTheme === 'light') {
            document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
          } else {
            document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
          }
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>





<script>
  (function() {
    // localStorage'dan kayıtlı dili oku
    var savedLang = localStorage.getItem('ww_language');

    // Kayıtlı dil varsa ve geçerliyse kullan, yoksa varsayılan 'en'
    if (savedLang && ['en', 'tr', 'de'].includes(savedLang)) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', savedLang);
      document.documentElement.lang = savedLang;
      console.log('🌐 [Preload] Dil geri yüklendi:', savedLang);
    } else {
      // Kayıtlı dil yoksa varsayılanı 'en' yap ve localStorage'a kaydet
      localStorage.setItem('ww_language', 'en');
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', 'en');
      document.documentElement.lang = 'en';
      console.log('🌐 [Preload] Varsayılan dil ayarlandı: en');
    }
  })();
</script>



  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       CALENDAR SAYFASI ÖZEL STİLLER
       ============================================================ */

    .calendar-page-main {
      padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .calendar-page-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .calendar-page-header h1 {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text) 0%, var(--accent2) 100%);
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .calendar-page-header .subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .calendar-page-header .back-link {
      color: var(--accent);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      padding-top: 0.3rem;
    }
    .calendar-page-header .back-link:hover {
      color: var(--accent2);
      transform: translateX(-2px);
    }

    /* Ana Takvim Kartı */
    .calendar-main-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Takvim Header */
    .cal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .cal-header .cal-title {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .cal-header .cal-title .cal-icon-wrap {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,92,246,0.25), rgba(192,132,252,0.1));
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.25);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .cal-header .cal-title .cal-icon-wrap svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      stroke: var(--accent2);
    }

    /* Ay/Yıl başlığı tıklanabilir hızlı geçiş */
    .cal-title-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit;
      color: inherit;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .cal-title-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
    }
    .cal-title-btn .cal-title-caret {
      font-size: 10px;
      opacity: 0.5;
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .cal-title-btn.open .cal-title-caret {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .cal-jump-popover {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 0;
      margin-top: 6px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0.75rem;
      min-width: 220px;
      z-index: 50;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    }
    .cal-jump-popover.open {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-year-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-year-row button {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      border-radius: 6px;
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-year-row button:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-year-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-months-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-month-btn {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 5px 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-month-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
    }
    .cal-jump-popover .jump-month-btn.current {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      border-color: transparent;
    }

    .cal-nav-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cal-nav-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      border-radius: 40px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .cal-nav-btn:hover {
      color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.06);
    }
    .cal-nav-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .cal-nav-btn.today-btn {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem;
    }
    .cal-nav-btn.today-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
    }

    /* Gün Başlıkları */
    .cal-day-names {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
      gap: 5px;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .cal-day-names .dname {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 4px 0;
    }
    .cal-day-names .dname.weekend {
      color: var(--accent2);
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    /* Gün Gridi - Gerçek */
    .cal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
      gap: 5px;
      touch-action: pan-y;
    }
    .cal-grid.anim-left {
      animation: calSlideLeft 0.22s ease;
    }
    .cal-grid.anim-right {
      animation: calSlideRight 0.22s ease;
    }
    @keyframes calSlideLeft {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(14px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
    }
    @keyframes calSlideRight {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-14px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
    }

    /* Gün Gridi - Skeleton */
    .cal-grid-skeleton {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
      gap: 5px;
    }
    .cal-grid-skeleton .skeleton-day {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--border);
      opacity: 0.15;
      min-height: 60px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cal-grid-skeleton .skeleton-day::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .cal-grid-skeleton .skeleton-day::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .cal-day {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      min-height: 80px;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cal-day:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      transform: scale(1.02);
      z-index: 2;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
    }
    .cal-day:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
      outline-offset: 2px;
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .cal-day.weekend-cell {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface2) 92%, var(--accent2) 8%);
    }
    .cal-day .day-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      border-radius: 10px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .cal-day .day-bg.show {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .cal-day .day-bg.glow {
      filter: blur(2px);
    }

    .cal-day .day-number {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 500;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .cal-day .day-trade-count {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* PnL Bar */
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 10%;
      right: 10%;
      height: 2.5px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
      transform: scaleX(0.3);
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar.positive {
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green-glow);
    }
    .cal-day .day-pnl-bar.negative {
      background: var(--red);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--red-glow);
    }

    /* Bugün - basit ve sağlam border */
    .cal-day.today {
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.2), inset 0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.03);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
    }
    .cal-day.today .day-number {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* Renk skalası */
    .cal-day.color-0 .day-bg { background: transparent; }
    .cal-day.color-1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.08), rgba(34,197,94,0.02)); }
    .cal-day.color-2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.16), rgba(34,197,94,0.04)); }
    .cal-day.color-3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.28), rgba(34,197,94,0.06)); }
    .cal-day.color-4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.45), rgba(34,197,94,0.1)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.08), rgba(239,68,68,0.02)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.16), rgba(239,68,68,0.04)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.28), rgba(239,68,68,0.06)); }
    .cal-day.color-neg4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.45), rgba(239,68,68,0.1)); }

    /* Boş günler */
    .cal-day.empty {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: default;
      min-height: 60px;
    }
    .cal-day.empty:hover {
      transform: none;
      border-color: transparent;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .cal-day.empty .day-texture {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 8px 8px;
      opacity: 0.1;
      pointer-events: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    /* Renk skalası lejantı */
    .cal-legend {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .cal-legend .legend-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3px;
    }
    .cal-legend .legend-swatch {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .cal-legend .legend-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-left: 2px;
    }

    /* Özet Kartları - Gerçek */
    .calendar-summary-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    /* Özet Kartları - Skeleton */
    .calendar-summary-skeleton {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      min-height: 52px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line {
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 99px;
      opacity: 0.3;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line:last-child {
      width: 60%;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .summary-mini-card {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.trades {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.12);
      color: var(--accent2);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.pnl {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.1);
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.winrate {
      background: rgba(251,191,36,0.1);
      color: var(--yellow);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.best {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.08);
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-icon.worst {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08);
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      line-height: 1.2;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-label {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.1;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-subvalue {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    /* Popup */
    .calendar-day-popup {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      min-width: 280px;
      max-width: 380px;
      z-index: 500;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup.active {
      display: block;
      animation: popupIn 0.25s ease;
    }
    @keyframes popupIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.92); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-header h4 {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-close {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-close:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-body {
      max-height: 300px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 3px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border2);
      border-radius: 99px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter button {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter button:hover {
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-filter button.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      border-color: transparent;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 6px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-badge {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-badge.long {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
      color: var(--green);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-badge.short {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15);
      color: var(--red);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-symbol {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-pnl {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-pnl.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-trade .pt-pnl.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .calendar-day-popup .popup-empty {
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 1.5rem 0;
    }
    .calendar-popup-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 499;
    }
    .calendar-popup-overlay.active {
      display: block;
    }

    /* Açık tema uyumluluğu */
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.06), rgba(16,185,129,0.02)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.14), rgba(16,185,129,0.04)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.24), rgba(16,185,129,0.06)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.4), rgba(16,185,129,0.1)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg1 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.06), rgba(239,68,68,0.02)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg2 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.14), rgba(239,68,68,0.04)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg3 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.24), rgba(239,68,68,0.06)); }
    body.light-theme .cal-day.color-neg4 .day-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.4), rgba(239,68,68,0.1)); }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .calendar-page-main {
        padding: 1rem;
      }
      .cal-day {
        min-height: 60px;
        padding: 4px 6px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-number {
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-pnl {
        font-size: 8px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-trade-count {
        font-size: 7px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
      .cal-header .cal-title {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
      }
      .cal-header .cal-title .cal-icon-wrap {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
      }
      .cal-header .cal-title .cal-icon-wrap svg {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
      }
      .cal-nav-btn.today-btn {
        font-size: 9px;
        padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
      }
      .calendar-day-popup {
        min-width: 220px;
        max-width: 280px;
        padding: 1rem;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .cal-day {
        min-height: 48px;
        padding: 3px 4px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-number {
        font-size: 10px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-pnl {
        font-size: 7px;
      }
      .cal-day .day-trade-count {
        font-size: 6px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .summary-mini-card {
        padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
      }
      .summary-mini-card .s-icon {
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
      }
      .summary-mini-card .s-icon svg {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
      }
      .summary-mini-card .s-info .s-value {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
      }
      .cal-day.today {
        border-width: 1.5px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat {
        padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
        min-height: 42px;
      }
      .calendar-summary-skeleton .skeleton-stat .skeleton-line {
        height: 6px;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>




  <div id="navbar-container"></div>




  <main class="calendar-page-main">


    <div class="calendar-page-header">
      <div>
        <h1 data-i18n="calendar.title">Takvim</h1>

      </div>
      <a href="dashboard.html" class="back-link" data-i18n="calendar.back_to_dashboard">← Dashboard'a Dön</a>

    <div class="calendar-main-card">

      <div class="cal-header">
        <div class="cal-title" style="position:relative;">
          <span class="cal-icon-wrap">

              <line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/>

      <div class="cal-day-names" id="cal-day-names">

      <div class="cal-grid-skeleton" id="cal-grid-skeleton">
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div><div class="skeleton-day"></div>

      <div class="cal-legend" id="cal-legend" style="display:none;">

      <div class="calendar-summary-skeleton" id="calendar-summary-skeleton">

        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>

        <div class="summary-mini-card">

            </svg>

            <span class="s-label" data-i18n="calendar.worst_day">En Kötü Gün</span>

            <span class="s-subvalue" id="cal-summary-worst-date"></span>

    </div>

  </main>




  <div class="calendar-popup-overlay" id="calendar-popup-overlay"></div>
  <div class="calendar-day-popup" id="calendar-day-popup">
    <div class="popup-header">
      <h4 id="popup-date-title">15 Ocak 2026</h4>
      <button class="popup-close" id="popup-close">✕</button>

    <div class="popup-filter" id="popup-filter" style="display:none;">
      <button type="button" class="active" data-filter="all">Tümü</button>
      <button type="button" data-filter="long">Long</button>
      <button type="button" data-filter="short">Short</button>
