  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
  <script src="config.js"></script>
  <script src="i18n.js"></script>
  <script src="script.js"></script>
  <script src="/components/navbar.js"></script>
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (typeof loadNavbar === 'function') {
        loadNavbar('navbar-container');
      }
    });
  </script>
  <script>
    (function() {
      // ============================================================
      // ENSTRÜMAN ÇARPANLARI
      // ============================================================
      var INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS = {
        forex:  100000,
        gold:   100,
        index:  10,
        crypto: 1,
        other:  1
      };

      // ============================================================
      // PnL HESAPLAMA
      // ============================================================
      function calcTradePnL(t) {
        try {
          if (!t.entry_price || !t.exit_price || !t.lot) return 0;
          var mult = t.multiplier || INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[t.instrument] || 100000;
          var dir = (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY') ? 1 : -1;
          return dir * (parseFloat(t.exit_price) - parseFloat(t.entry_price)) * parseFloat(t.lot) * mult;
        } catch(e) {
          return 0;
        }
      }

      // ============================================================
      // FORMAT FONKSİYONLARI - DÜZELTİLDİ
      // ============================================================

      // Ana para birimi formatı - tüm sayfalarda tutarlı
      function formatCurrency(value) {
        try {
          var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
          var currency = (typeof getCurrencySymbol === 'function') ? getCurrencySymbol() : '$';
          var absNum = Math.abs(num);
          var formatted = absNum.toFixed(2);
          // Binlik ayıraç ekle (nokta ile)
          var parts = formatted.split('.');
          parts[0] = parts[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.');
          formatted = parts.join(',');
          return (num >= 0 ? '+' : '-') + currency + formatted;
        } catch(e) {
          return (value >= 0 ? '+' : '') + value.toFixed(2);
        }
      }

      // Kısa PnL formatı - gün kartlarında kullanılır
      function formatShortPnL(value) {
        try {
          var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
          var absVal = Math.abs(num);
          var formatted;
          if (absVal >= 1000000) {
            formatted = (absVal / 1000000).toFixed(2) + 'M';
          } else if (absVal >= 1000) {
            formatted = (absVal / 1000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
          } else if (absVal >= 100) {
            formatted = absVal.toFixed(0);
          } else if (absVal >= 1) {
            formatted = absVal.toFixed(1);
          } else {
            formatted = absVal.toFixed(2);
          }
          return (num > 0 ? '+' : (num < 0 ? '-' : '')) + formatted;
        } catch(e) {
          return '';
        }
      }

      // ============================================================
      // TEMA DEĞİŞİMİ
      // ============================================================
      var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
        mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
          if (mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
            if (typeof renderCalendar === 'function') renderCalendar();
          }
        });
      });
      observer.observe(document.body, { attributes: true });

      // ============================================================
      // SKELETON GÖSTER/GİZLE
      // ============================================================
      function showCalendarSkeleton() {
        var el1 = document.getElementById('cal-grid-skeleton');
        var el2 = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
        var el3 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary-skeleton');
        var el4 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary');
        var el5 = document.getElementById('cal-legend');

        if (el1) el1.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el2) el2.style.display = 'none';
        if (el3) el3.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el4) el4.style.display = 'none';
        if (el5) el5.style.display = 'none';
      }

      function hideCalendarSkeleton() {
        var el1 = document.getElementById('cal-grid-skeleton');
        var el2 = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
        var el3 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary-skeleton');
        var el4 = document.getElementById('calendar-summary');
        var el5 = document.getElementById('cal-legend');

        if (el1) el1.style.display = 'none';
        if (el2) el2.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el3) el3.style.display = 'none';
        if (el4) el4.style.display = 'grid';
        if (el5) el5.style.display = 'flex';
      }

      // ============================================================
      // TAKVİM FONKSİYONLARI
      // ============================================================

      var calendarTrades = [];
      var currentMonth = new Date().getMonth();
      var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      var jumpPopoverYear = currentYear;
      var lastNavDirection = null;

      function getMonthName(month, lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Ocak', 'Şubat', 'Mart', 'Nisan', 'Mayıs', 'Haziran', 'Temmuz', 'Ağustos', 'Eylül', 'Ekim', 'Kasım', 'Aralık'],
          en: ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'],
          de: ['Januar', 'Februar', 'März', 'April', 'Mai', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'August', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Dezember']
        };
        return (names[lang] || names.en)[month];
      }

      function getMonthNameShort(month, lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Oca', 'Şub', 'Mar', 'Nis', 'May', 'Haz', 'Tem', 'Ağu', 'Eyl', 'Eki', 'Kas', 'Ara'],
          en: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'],
          de: ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mär', 'Apr', 'Mai', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Dez']
        };
        return (names[lang] || names.en)[month];
      }

      function getDayNames(lang) {
        var names = {
          tr: ['Pzt', 'Sal', 'Çar', 'Per', 'Cum', 'Cmt', 'Paz'],
          en: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'],
          de: ['Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'So']
        };
        return names[lang] || names.en;
      }

      var calendarRenderTimeout = null;

      function renderCalendar() {
        try {
          hideCalendarSkeleton();

          var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
          var monthLabel = document.getElementById('calendar-month-label');
          var dayNamesContainer = document.getElementById('cal-day-names');
          var grid = document.getElementById('cal-grid');

          var monthName = getMonthName(currentMonth, lang);
          if (monthLabel) monthLabel.textContent = monthName + ' ' + currentYear;

          var firstDay = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, 1);

          var dayNames = getDayNames(lang);
          if (dayNamesContainer) {
            dayNamesContainer.innerHTML = dayNames.map(function(name, idx) {
              var weekendClass = (idx === 5 || idx === 6) ? ' weekend' : '';
              return '<div class="dname' + weekendClass + '">' + name + '</div>';
            }).join('');
          }

          var daysInMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
          var firstDayOfWeek = firstDay.getDay();
          var startOffset = firstDayOfWeek === 0 ? 6 : firstDayOfWeek - 1;

          var html = '';
          var totalTrades = 0;
          var totalPnl = 0;
          var wins = 0;
          var bestDay = { date: '', pnl: -Infinity };
          var worstDay = { date: '', pnl: Infinity };
          var anyTradedDay = false;
          var maxPnl = 0;

          for (var i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) {
            html += '<div class="cal-day empty"><div class="day-texture"></div></div>';
          }

          for (var d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
            var dateObj = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, d);
            var dateStr = dateObj.toISOString().split('T')[0];
            var isToday = dateStr === new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
            var dow = dateObj.getDay();
            var isWeekend = (dow === 0 || dow === 6);

            var dayTrades = calendarTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.trade_date === dateStr; });
            var hasTrade = dayTrades.length > 0;

            var dayPnl = 0;
            for (var j = 0; j < dayTrades.length; j++) {
              var t = dayTrades[j];
              if (t.exit_price) {
                var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
                dayPnl += pnl;
              }
            }

            totalTrades += dayTrades.length;
            totalPnl += dayPnl;
            if (dayPnl > 0) wins++;
            if (hasTrade) {
              anyTradedDay = true;
              if (dayPnl > bestDay.pnl) bestDay = { date: dateStr, pnl: dayPnl };
              if (dayPnl < worstDay.pnl) worstDay = { date: dateStr, pnl: dayPnl };
              if (Math.abs(dayPnl) > maxPnl) maxPnl = Math.abs(dayPnl);
            }

            var colorClass = '';
            if (hasTrade && dayPnl > 0) {
              var absPnl = Math.abs(dayPnl);
              if (absPnl > 1000) colorClass = 'color-4';
              else if (absPnl > 500) colorClass = 'color-3';
              else if (absPnl > 100) colorClass = 'color-2';
              else colorClass = 'color-1';
            } else if (hasTrade && dayPnl < 0) {
              var absPnl2 = Math.abs(dayPnl);
              if (absPnl2 > 1000) colorClass = 'color-neg4';
              else if (absPnl2 > 500) colorClass = 'color-neg3';
              else if (absPnl2 > 100) colorClass = 'color-neg2';
              else colorClass = 'color-neg1';
            }

            var todayClass = isToday ? 'today' : '';
            var weekendClass2 = isWeekend ? 'weekend-cell' : '';

            // Kısa PnL gösterimi - DÜZELTİLDİ
            var pnlDisplay = '';
            if (hasTrade && dayPnl !== 0) {
              pnlDisplay = formatShortPnL(dayPnl);
            }
            var pnlClass = dayPnl > 0 ? 'positive' : (dayPnl < 0 ? 'negative' : '');
            var barClass = dayPnl > 0 ? 'positive' : (dayPnl < 0 ? 'negative' : '');

            var tradeCountText = hasTrade ? (dayTrades.length + ' ' + i18n.t('trades.stats.trade_count')) : '';
            var ariaLabel = d + ' ' + monthName + (hasTrade ? ', ' + dayTrades.length + ' işlem, ' + pnlDisplay : ', işlem yok');

            html += '\n            <div class="cal-day ' + colorClass + ' ' + todayClass + ' ' + weekendClass2 + '" data-date="' + dateStr + '" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="' + ariaLabel + '" onclick="openDayPopup(\'' + dateStr + '\')" onkeydown="if(event.key===\'Enter\'||event.key===\' \'){event.preventDefault();openDayPopup(\'' + dateStr + '\');}">\n              <div class="day-bg ' + (colorClass ? 'show' : '') + '"></div>\n              <div class="day-bg glow ' + (colorClass ? 'show' : '') + '"></div>\n              <div class="day-number">' + d + '</div>\n              ' + (pnlDisplay ? '<div class="day-pnl ' + pnlClass + '">' + pnlDisplay + '</div>' : '') + '\n              ' + (tradeCountText ? '<div class="day-trade-count">' + tradeCountText + '</div>' : '') + '\n              <div class="day-pnl-bar ' + (hasTrade ? 'show' : '') + ' ' + barClass + '"></div>\n            </div>\n          ';
          }

          if (grid) {
            grid.innerHTML = html;
            grid.classList.remove('anim-left', 'anim-right');
            if (lastNavDirection === 'left' || lastNavDirection === 'right') {
              void grid.offsetWidth;
              grid.classList.add(lastNavDirection === 'left' ? 'anim-left' : 'anim-right');
            }
            lastNavDirection = null;
          }

          var winRate = totalTrades > 0 ? Math.round((wins / totalTrades) * 100) : 0;
          var tradesEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-trades');
          if (tradesEl) tradesEl.textContent = totalTrades;

          var pnlEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-pnl');
          if (pnlEl) {
            pnlEl.textContent = formatCurrency(totalPnl);
            pnlEl.className = 's-value' + (totalPnl >= 0 ? ' positive' : ' negative');
          }

          var winrateEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-winrate');
          if (winrateEl) winrateEl.textContent = winRate + '%';

          var bestEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-best');
          var bestDateEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-best-date');
          if (bestEl) bestEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatCurrency(bestDay.pnl) : '—';
          if (bestDateEl) bestDateEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatDayLabel(bestDay.date, lang) : '';

          var worstEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-worst');
          var worstDateEl = document.getElementById('cal-summary-worst-date');
          if (worstEl) worstEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatCurrency(worstDay.pnl) : '—';
          if (worstDateEl) worstDateEl.textContent = anyTradedDay ? formatDayLabel(worstDay.date, lang) : '';
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn('renderCalendar hatası:', e);
        }
      }

      function formatDayLabel(dateStr, lang) {
        try {
          var d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
          return d.getDate() + ' ' + getMonthNameShort(d.getMonth(), lang);
        } catch(e) {
          return '';
        }
      }

      var currentPopupFilter = 'all';
      var currentPopupDateTrades = [];

      function renderPopupTrades() {
        var body = document.getElementById('popup-body');
        if (!body) return;
        var filtered = currentPopupDateTrades.filter(function(t) {
          if (currentPopupFilter === 'all') return true;
          var isLong = (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY');
          return currentPopupFilter === 'long' ? isLong : !isLong;
        });
        if (filtered.length === 0) {
          body.innerHTML = '<div class="popup-empty">' + i18n.t('calendar.no_trades') + '</div>';
          return;
        }
        body.innerHTML = filtered.map(function(t) {
          var pnl = t.exit_price ? calcTradePnL(t) : null;
          var pnlText = pnl !== null ? formatCurrency(pnl) : i18n.t('trades.open');
          var pnlClass = pnl !== null ? (pnl >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative') : '';
          var isLong = t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY';
          var badgeClass = isLong ? 'long' : 'short';
          var badgeText = isLong ? 'L' : 'S';
          return '<div class="popup-trade">\n              <div class="pt-left">\n                <span class="pt-badge ' + badgeClass + '">' + badgeText + '</span>\n                <span class="pt-symbol">' + (t.symbol || '—') + '</span>\n              </div>\n              <span class="pt-pnl ' + pnlClass + '">' + pnlText + '</span>\n            </div>';
        }).join('');
      }

      function openDayPopup(dateStr) {
        try {
          var overlay = document.getElementById('calendar-popup-overlay');
          var popup = document.getElementById('calendar-day-popup');
          var title = document.getElementById('popup-date-title');
          var filterBar = document.getElementById('popup-filter');

          var date = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
          var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
          if (title) title.textContent = date.toLocaleDateString(lang, { day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });

          currentPopupDateTrades = calendarTrades.filter(function(t) { return t.trade_date === dateStr; });
          currentPopupFilter = 'all';

          if (filterBar) {
            filterBar.style.display = currentPopupDateTrades.length > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';
            var btns = filterBar.querySelectorAll('button');
            btns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-filter') === 'all'); });
          }

          renderPopupTrades();

          if (overlay) overlay.classList.add('active');
          if (popup) popup.classList.add('active');
        } catch(e) {}
      }
      window.openDayPopup = openDayPopup;

      function closeDayPopup() {
        var overlay = document.getElementById('calendar-popup-overlay');
        var popup = document.getElementById('calendar-day-popup');
        if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove('active');
        if (popup) popup.classList.remove('active');
      }

      var closeBtn = document.getElementById('popup-close');
      if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDayPopup);

      var popupOverlay = document.getElementById('calendar-popup-overlay');
      if (popupOverlay) popupOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeDayPopup);

      var popupFilterBar = document.getElementById('popup-filter');
      if (popupFilterBar) {
        popupFilterBar.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          var btn = e.target.closest('button[data-filter]');
          if (!btn) return;
          currentPopupFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
          var btns = popupFilterBar.querySelectorAll('button');
          btns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn); });
          renderPopupTrades();
        });
      }

      // ============================================================
      // AY GEÇİŞİ
      // ============================================================

      function goToMonth(month, year, direction) {
        currentMonth = month;
        currentYear = year;
        lastNavDirection = direction || null;
        showCalendarSkeleton();
        if (calendarRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(calendarRenderTimeout);
        calendarRenderTimeout = setTimeout(renderCalendar, 180);
      }

      var prevBtn = document.getElementById('cal-prev');
      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var m = currentMonth, y = currentYear;
          if (m === 0) { m = 11; y--; } else { m--; }
          goToMonth(m, y, 'right');
        });
      }

      var nextBtn = document.getElementById('cal-next');
      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var m = currentMonth, y = currentYear;
          if (m === 11) { m = 0; y++; } else { m++; }
          goToMonth(m, y, 'left');
        });
      }

      var todayBtn = document.getElementById('cal-today');
      if (todayBtn) {
        todayBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          var today = new Date();
          var dir = (today.getFullYear() > currentYear || (today.getFullYear() === currentYear && today.getMonth() > currentMonth)) ? 'left' : (today.getFullYear() < currentYear || (today.getFullYear() === currentYear && today.getMonth() < currentMonth)) ? 'right' : null;
          goToMonth(today.getMonth(), today.getFullYear(), dir);
        });
      }

      // Mobilde kaydırarak ay değiştirme
      (function() {
        var grid = document.getElementById('cal-grid');
        if (!grid) return;
        var touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0, touching = false;

        grid.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
          if (!e.touches || !e.touches.length) return;
          touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
          touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
          touching = true;
        }, { passive: true });

        grid.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
          if (!touching) return;
          touching = false;
          var touch = (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0]) || null;
          if (!touch) return;
          var dx = touch.clientX - touchStartX;
          var dy = touch.clientY - touchStartY;
          if (Math.abs(dx) < 50 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) return;
          if (dx < 0) {
            if (nextBtn) nextBtn.click();
          } else {
            if (prevBtn) prevBtn.click();
          }
        }, { passive: true });
      })();

      // Ay/Yıl hızlı seçici popover
      (function() {
        var titleBtn = document.getElementById('cal-title-btn');
        var popover = document.getElementById('cal-jump-popover');
        var yearLabel = document.getElementById('jump-year-label');
        var monthsGrid = document.getElementById('jump-months-grid');
        var yearPrev = document.getElementById('jump-year-prev');
        var yearNext = document.getElementById('jump-year-next');
        if (!titleBtn || !popover) return;

        function renderMonthsGrid() {
          if (!yearLabel || !monthsGrid) return;
          yearLabel.textContent = jumpPopoverYear;
          var lang = i18n.getCurrentLanguage();
          var html = '';
          for (var m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
            var isCurrent = (m === currentMonth && jumpPopoverYear === currentYear);
            html += '<button type="button" class="jump-month-btn' + (isCurrent ? ' current' : '') + '" data-month="' + m + '">' + getMonthNameShort(m, lang) + '</button>';
          }
          monthsGrid.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function openPopover() {
          jumpPopoverYear = currentYear;
          renderMonthsGrid();
          popover.classList.add('open');
          titleBtn.classList.add('open');
          titleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
        function closePopover() {
          popover.classList.remove('open');
          titleBtn.classList.remove('open');
          titleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }

        titleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (popover.classList.contains('open')) closePopover(); else openPopover();
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (!popover.contains(e.target) && e.target !== titleBtn) closePopover();
        });
        popover.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); });

        if (yearPrev) yearPrev.addEventListener('click', function() { jumpPopoverYear--; renderMonthsGrid(); });
        if (yearNext) yearNext.addEventListener('click', function() { jumpPopoverYear++; renderMonthsGrid(); });

        if (monthsGrid) {
          monthsGrid.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            var btn = e.target.closest('button[data-month]');
            if (!btn) return;
            var m = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-month'), 10);
            var y = jumpPopoverYear;
            var dir = (y > currentYear || (y === currentYear && m > currentMonth)) ? 'left' : (y < currentYear || (y === currentYear && m < currentMonth)) ? 'right' : null;
            goToMonth(m, y, dir);
            closePopover();
          });
        }
      })();

      function loadCalendarTrades(trades) {
        calendarTrades = trades || [];
        showCalendarSkeleton();
        if (calendarRenderTimeout) clearTimeout(calendarRenderTimeout);
        calendarRenderTimeout = setTimeout(renderCalendar, 200);
      }

      // ============================================================
      // AUTH
      // ============================================================

      (async function() {
        try {
          showCalendarSkeleton();

          var user = await requireAuth();
          if (!user) return;

          var { data: trades, error } = await sb
            .from('trades')
            .select('*')
            .eq('user_id', user.id)
            .order('trade_date', { ascending: true });

          if (error) {
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast(i18n.t('toast.load_error') + error.message, 'error');
            hideCalendarSkeleton();
            return;
          }

          loadCalendarTrades(trades || []);
        } catch (e) {}
      })();

      i18n.onChange(function() {
        renderCalendar();
      });

    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
</file>

<file path="public/contact.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />

</head>
<body style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh;">

        </svg>
      </div>
      Wawe<span>Journal</span>
    </a>
    </div>

  <main style="flex:1;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem;width:100%;">
    <div class="page-card">
      <h1>İletişim</h1>

      <div class="contact-grid">
        <div class="contact-info">
          <h2>Bize Ulaşın</h2>

          <div class="contact-item">
            <span class="contact-icon">📧</span>
            <div>
              <strong>E-posta</strong><br />
              <a href="mailto:destek@wawedev.com">destek@wawedev.com</a>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="contact-item">
            <span class="contact-icon">📍</span>
            <div>
              <strong>Adres</strong><br />
              Denizli, Türkiye
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="contact-item">
            <span class="contact-icon">🕒</span>
            <div>
              <strong>Çalışma Saatleri</strong><br />
              Hafta içi: 09:00 - 18:00<br />
              Hafta sonu: Kapalı
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="contact-social">
            <h3>Sosyal Medya</h3>
            <div class="social-links">
              <a href="https://www.instagram.com/wawejournal/" target="_blank" class="social-btn">📷 Instagram</a>
              <a href="https://youtube.com/@wawedev" target="_blank" class="social-btn">🎥 YouTube</a>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="contact-map">
          <h2>Konum</h2>
          <div class="map-placeholder">
            <svg width="100%" height="200" viewBox="0 0 400 200" style="background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;">
              <rect width="400" height="200" fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--border)" stroke-width="1"/>
              <circle cx="200" cy="100" r="8" fill="var(--accent)"/>
              <text x="200" y="130" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11">Denizli, Türkiye</text>
              <path d="M200,100 L200,80 M200,100 L220,100" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="2"/>
            </svg>
            <p class="map-note">📍 Denizli, Türkiye</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="support-note">
        <h3>Destek Talepleri</h3>
        <p>Teknik destek, hesap sorunları veya önerileriniz için bize e-posta gönderebilirsiniz. En kısa sürede dönüş yapacağız.</p>
        <p><strong>Ortalama yanıt süresi:</strong> 24 saat (hafta içi)</p>
      </div>

      <div class="back-link">
        <a href="index.html" class="btn btn-ghost">← Ana Sayfaya Dön</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <footer class="site-footer">
    <div class="footer-container">
      <div class="footer-col">
        <div class="footer-logo">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none">
            <polyline points="2,16 7,9 12,13 19,4" stroke="#7c6dfa" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          </svg>
          Wawe<span>Journal</span>
        </div>
        <p class="footer-desc">Profesyonel trader'lar için geliştirilmiş modern trading journal. İşlemlerini kaydet, analiz et ve gelişimini izle.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-col">
        <h4>Linkler</h4>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="index.html">Ana Sayfa</a></li>
          <li><a href="login.html">Giriş Yap</a></li>
          <li><a href="register.html">Kayıt Ol</a></li>
          <li><a href="dashboard.html">Dashboard</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-col">
        <h4>Kurumsal</h4>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="about.html">Biz Kimiz?</a></li>
          <li><a href="privacy.html">Gizlilik</a></li>
          <li><a href="terms.html">Kullanım Şartları</a></li>
          <li><a href="contact.html">İletişim</a></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-col">
        <h4>İletişim</h4>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="mailto:destek@wawedev.com">destek@wawedev.com</a></li>
          <li><span>Denizli, Türkiye</span></li>
          <li><span>WaweDev Yazılım</span></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="footer-bottom-bar">
      <div class="footer-social">
        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/wawejournal/" target="_blank" class="social-link">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><line x1="17" y1="7" x2="17.01" y2="7"/></svg>
          Instagram
        </a>
        <a href="https://youtube.com/@wawedev" target="_blank" class="social-link">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22.54 6.42a2.78 2.78 0 0 0-1.94-2C18.88 4 12 4 12 4s-6.88 0-8.6.46a2.78 2.78 0 0 0-1.94 2A29 29 0 0 0 1 11.75a29 29 0 0 0 .46 5.33A2.78 2.78 0 0 0 3.4 19c1.72.46 8.6.46 8.6.46s6.88 0 8.6-.46a2.78 2.78 0 0 0 1.94-2 29 29 0 0 0 .46-5.25 29 29 0 0 0-.46-5.33z"/><polygon points="9.75 15.02 15.5 11.75 9.75 8.48 9.75 15.02"/></svg>
          YouTube
        </a>
        <a href="mailto:destek@wawedev.com" class="social-link">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M4 4h16c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v12c0 1.1-.9 2-2 2H4c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V6c0-1.1.9-2 2-2z"/><polyline points="22,6 12,13 2,6"/></svg>
          E-posta

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>

<file path="public/dashboard.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title data-i18n="dashboard.title">Dashboard - Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600;9..40,700&family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32,300;14..32,400;14..32,500;14..32,600;14..32,700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/components/navbar.css" />

  <script>
    (function() {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'light') {
        document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
      } else {
        document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
      }
    })();
  </script>




  <script>
    (function() {
      var savedLang = localStorage.getItem('ww_language');
      if (savedLang && ['en', 'tr', 'de'].includes(savedLang)) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', savedLang);
        document.documentElement.lang = savedLang;
        console.log('🌐 [Preload] Dil geri yüklendi:', savedLang);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem('ww_language', 'en');
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', 'en');
        document.documentElement.lang = 'en';
        console.log('🌐 [Preload] Varsayılan dil ayarlandı: en');
      }
    })();
  </script>

  <style>
    .goal-edit-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      margin-left: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .goal-edit-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .kpi-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding-right: 1rem;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .goal-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .goal-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 500;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .goal-modal {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 380px;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .goal-modal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .goal-modal-header h3 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
    }
    .goal-modal-close {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .goal-modal-body {
      padding: 1.25rem;
    }
    .goal-modal-body label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .goal-input {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      outline: none;
    }
    .goal-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .goal-modal-footer {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .welcome-msg {
      color: var(--accent) !important;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      animation: welcomeGlow 1.5s ease-out;
    }
    @keyframes welcomeGlow {
      0% { text-shadow: 0 0 0px var(--accent); opacity: 0.5; }
      50% { text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent), 0 0 8px var(--accent2); opacity: 1; }
      100% { text-shadow: 0 0 0px var(--accent); opacity: 1; }
    }
    .date-filter-group {
      display: flex;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 2px;
    }
    .date-filter-option {
      padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 500;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 40px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .date-filter-option:hover {
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .date-filter-option.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
    }
    .add-trade-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      border: none;
      border-radius: 40px;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
    }
    .add-trade-btn:hover {
      transform: scale(1.05);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(139,92,246,0.5);
    }
    .add-trade-btn svg {
      stroke: white;
      stroke-width: 2.5;
    }
    .export-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .export-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trade-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 28px 80px 50px 100px 1fr 70px 80px 24px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      transition: background 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .trade-row:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.06);
    }
    .trade-strategy {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--accent);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .trade-note-indicator {
      font-size: 12px;
      opacity: 0.6;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .trade-note {
      display: none;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      margin-top: -0.3rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      background: var(--bg);
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .trade-note.show {
      display: block;
    }

    .mini-calendar-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .mini-calendar-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
    }
    .mini-cal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
    }
    .mini-cal-header .mini-cal-title {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .mini-cal-header .mini-cal-link {
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--accent);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3px;
    }
    .mini-cal-header .mini-cal-link:hover {
      color: var(--accent2);
      transform: translateX(2px);
    }
    .mini-cal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .mini-cal-day {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 4px 2px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      cursor: default;
      min-height: 36px;
    }
    .mini-cal-day .day-name {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 6px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .mini-cal-day .day-number {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .mini-cal-day .day-pnl-small {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 6px;
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-top: 1px;
    }
    .mini-cal-day .day-pnl-small.positive {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .mini-cal-day .day-pnl-small.negative {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.win {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.12);
      border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.win:hover {
      background: rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
      border-color: rgba(34,197,94,0.35);
      transform: scale(1.05);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(34,197,94,0.15);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.win .day-number {
      color: var(--green);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.loss {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12);
      border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.loss:hover {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
      border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.35);
      transform: scale(1.05);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(239,68,68,0.15);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.loss .day-number {
      color: var(--red);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.empty-day {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border-color: var(--border);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }
    .mini-cal-day.empty-day:hover {
      transform: none;
      box-shadow: none;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .mini-cal-day.today {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(139,92,246,0.2);
    }
    .mini-cal-day.today .day-number {
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    body.light-theme .mini-cal-day.win {
      background: rgba(16,185,129,0.08);
      border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.15);
    }
    body.light-theme .mini-cal-day.win:hover {
      background: rgba(16,185,129,0.16);
    }
    body.light-theme .mini-cal-day.loss {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.08);
      border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.15);
    }
    body.light-theme .mini-cal-day.loss:hover {
      background: rgba(239,68,68,0.16);
    }

    .dashboard-grid-2col {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .trade-row {
        grid-template-columns: 24px 65px 40px 80px 1fr 60px 70px 20px;
        gap: 0.3rem;
      }
      .trade-strategy { font-size: 8px; white-space: normal; }
      .trade-symbol { font-size: 0.75rem; }
      .trade-pnl { font-size: 0.7rem; }
      .dashboard-grid-2col {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 767px) {
      .trade-row {
        grid-template-columns: 20px 55px 35px 70px 1fr 50px 60px 18px;
      }
      .date-filter-group { width: 100%; justify-content: stretch; }
      .date-filter-option { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
      .dropdown-menu {
        position: absolute;
        top: 45px;
        right: 0;
        left: auto;
        width: auto;
        min-width: 160px;
        border-radius: 12px;
        transform: translateY(-10px);
      }
      .dropdown-menu.show {
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
      .mini-cal-day {
        min-height: 30px;
        padding: 3px 1px;
      }
      .mini-cal-day .day-number {
        font-size: 9px;
      }
      .mini-cal-day .day-name {
        font-size: 5px;
      }
    }

    /* ⭐ CHART ANİMASYON OPTİMİZASYONU - Göz yormasın diye */
    .chart-wrap canvas {
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }
    .chart-wrap canvas.chart-ready {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>


  <div id="navbar-container"></div>

  <main class="main dashboard-main">

    <div class="page-header">
      <div>
        <h1 data-i18n="dashboard.title">Dashboard</h1>
        <p class="welcome-msg" id="welcome-msg" data-i18n="dashboard.welcome">Yükleniyor…</p>
      </div>
      <div class="header-actions">
        <div class="date-filter-group" id="date-filter-group">
          <button class="date-filter-option active" data-range="all" data-i18n="dashboard.filter.all">Tümü</button>
          <button class="date-filter-option" data-range="week" data-i18n="dashboard.filter.week">Bu Hafta</button>
          <button class="date-filter-option" data-range="month" data-i18n="dashboard.filter.month">Bu Ay</button>
          <button class="date-filter-option" data-range="year" data-i18n="dashboard.filter.year">Bu Yıl</button>
        </div>
        <button class="export-btn" id="export-csv" data-i18n="dashboard.export_csv">⬇ CSV</button>
        <button class="export-btn" id="export-pdf" data-i18n="dashboard.export_pdf">⬇ PDF</button>
        <a href="/add-trade.html" class="add-trade-btn" aria-label="İşlem Ekle">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round">
            <line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"></line>
            <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"></line>
          </svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div id="stats-skeleton" class="skeleton-stats">
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
    </div>


    <div class="stats-grid" id="stats-grid" style="display:none;">
      <div class="stat-card" style="--accent-color: var(--accent);">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.total_trades">Toplam İşlem</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-total">—</div>
        <div class="stat-trend" id="trend-total"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card" style="--accent-color: var(--green);">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.total_pnl">Toplam K/Z</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-pnl">—</div>
        <div class="stat-trend" id="trend-pnl"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card" style="--accent-color: var(--accent);">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.win_rate">Win Rate</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-winrate">—</div>
        <div class="stat-trend" id="trend-wr"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card" style="--accent-color: var(--green);">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.winners">Kazanan</div>
        <div class="stat-value positive" id="stat-wins">—</div>
        <div class="stat-trend" id="trend-wins"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card" style="--accent-color: var(--red);">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="dashboard.stats.losers">Kaybeden</div>
        <div class="stat-value negative" id="stat-losses">—</div>
        <div class="stat-trend" id="trend-losses"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="kpi-bar" id="kpi-bar">
      <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label" data-i18n="dashboard.kpi.avg_win">Ort. Kazanç</span><span class="kpi-value positive" id="kpi-avg-win">—</span></div>
      <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label" data-i18n="dashboard.kpi.avg_loss">Ort. Kayıp</span><span class="kpi-value negative" id="kpi-avg-loss">—</span></div>
      <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label" data-i18n="dashboard.kpi.profit_factor">Profit Factor</span><span class="kpi-value" id="kpi-pf">—</span></div>
      <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label" data-i18n="dashboard.kpi.max_drawdown">Max Drawdown</span><span class="kpi-value negative" id="kpi-dd">—</span></div>
      <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label" data-i18n="dashboard.kpi.avg_rr">Ort. R:R</span><span class="kpi-value" id="kpi-rr">—</span></div>
      <div class="kpi-item">
        <span class="kpi-label" data-i18n="dashboard.kpi.monthly_goal">Aylık Hedef</span>
        <div class="goal-wrapper">
          <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" id="goal-progress"></div></div>
          <span class="kpi-value" id="goal-percent">0%</span>
          <button class="goal-edit-btn" id="edit-goal-btn" title="Hedefi Düzenle">✎</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="charts-top-grid" id="charts-top-skeleton">
      <div class="chart-card"><div class="skeleton-chart"><div class="skeleton-bar-group"><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div></div><div class="skeleton-label"></div></div></div>
      <div class="chart-card"><div class="skeleton-chart" style="justify-content:center;"><div class="skeleton-doughnut"></div></div></div>
    </div>


    <div class="charts-top-grid" id="charts-top-grid" style="display:none;">
      <div class="chart-card">
        <div class="chart-header">
          <h3 data-i18n="dashboard.chart.cumulative">Kümülatif K/Z Serisi</h3>
          <span class="chart-badge" id="cumulative-change">↑ +0%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-wrap chart-wrap--tall">
          <canvas id="chart-cumulative"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chart-card">
        <div class="chart-header">
          <h3 data-i18n="dashboard.chart.winloss">Win / Loss Dağılımı</h3>
        </div>
        <div class="chart-wrap chart-wrap--doughnut">
          <canvas id="chart-winloss"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="charts-bottom-grid" id="charts-bottom-skeleton">
      <div class="chart-card"><div class="skeleton-chart"><div class="skeleton-bar-group"><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div><div class="skeleton-bar"></div></div><div class="skeleton-label"></div></div></div>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      if (typeof loadNavbar === 'function') {
        loadNavbar('navbar-container');
        console.log('✅ Navbar yüklendi!');
      } else {
        console.warn('⚠️ loadNavbar fonksiyonu bulunamadı!');
