  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf-autotable/3.8.2/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js"></script>
  <script src="config.js"></script>
  <script src="i18n.js"></script>
  <script src="script.js"></script>

  <script>
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CHART DEFAULTS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    try {
      Chart.defaults.color = '#ffffff';
      Chart.defaults.font.family = "'DM Sans', sans-serif";
      Chart.defaults.font.size = 11;
    } catch(e) {}

    var GRID_LINE_COLOR = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    var WHITE = '#ffffff';

    function updateChartColors() {
      var isLight = document.body.classList.contains('light-theme');
      if (isLight) {
        Chart.defaults.color = '#1e293b';
        GRID_LINE_COLOR = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
        WHITE = '#1e293b';
      } else {
        Chart.defaults.color = '#e8e8f0';
        GRID_LINE_COLOR = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
        WHITE = '#ffffff';
      }
    }
    updateChartColors();

    var themeObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
      mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
        if (mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
          updateChartColors();
          if (typeof renderCharts === 'function' && allTrades && allTrades.length > 0) {
            renderCharts(allTrades);
          }
        }
      });
    });
    themeObserver.observe(document.body, { attributes: true });

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🔔 BİLDİRİM ÇANI TOGGLE - DASHBOARD İLE AYNI
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var bellPanel = document.getElementById('bell-panel');
      var bellClose = document.getElementById('bell-panel-close');

      if (bellBtn && bellPanel) {
        bellBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          bellPanel.classList.toggle('open');
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (!bellPanel.contains(e.target) && !bellBtn.contains(e.target)) {
            bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
          }
        });

        bellPanel.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
        });
      }

      if (bellClose && bellPanel) {
        bellClose.addEventListener('click', function() {
          bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
        });
      }

      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (markReadBtn) {
        markReadBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (typeof markOvertradeAsRead === 'function') markOvertradeAsRead();
        });
      }
    });

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 🔔 OVER TRADE UYARISI -> BİLDİRİM ÇANI - DASHBOARD İLE AYNI
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    var OVERTRADE_READ_KEY = 'ww_overtrade_read_signature';
    var currentOvertradeSignature = '';

    function bellEmptyStateHtml() {
      var emptyText = (typeof i18n !== 'undefined' && i18n.t('dashboard.bell.empty') !== 'dashboard.bell.empty') ? i18n.t('dashboard.bell.empty') : 'Yeni bildirim yok';
      return '<div class="bell-panel-empty" id="bell-panel-empty"><span class="empty-icon">🔕</span><span>' + emptyText + '</span></div>';
    }

    function showBellEmptyState() {
      var body = document.getElementById('bell-panel-body');
      var dot = document.getElementById('bell-dot');
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (body) body.innerHTML = bellEmptyStateHtml();
      if (dot) dot.style.display = 'none';
      if (bellBtn) bellBtn.classList.remove('has-alert');
      if (markReadBtn) markReadBtn.style.display = 'none';
    }

    async function updateOvertradeBell() {
      var body = document.getElementById('bell-panel-body');
      var dot = document.getElementById('bell-dot');
      var bellBtn = document.getElementById('overtrade-bell-btn');
      var markReadBtn = document.getElementById('bell-mark-read-btn');
      if (!body) return;

      try {
        if (typeof checkAndRenderOvertrade === 'function') {
          await checkAndRenderOvertrade('bell-panel-body');
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      var rawContent = body.innerHTML || '';
      var tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
      tempDiv.innerHTML = rawContent;
      var textContent = tempDiv.textContent || tempDiv.innerText || '';
      var cleanText = textContent.replace(/\s/g, '').trim();
      var hasContent = cleanText.length > 0;

      if (!hasContent) {
        currentOvertradeSignature = '';
        showBellEmptyState();
        return;
      }

      currentOvertradeSignature = textContent.replace(/\s/g, '');
      var readSignature = '';
      try { readSignature = localStorage.getItem(OVERTRADE_READ_KEY) || ''; } catch (e) {}

      if (readSignature && readSignature === currentOvertradeSignature) {
        showBellEmptyState();
        return;
      }

      if (dot) dot.style.display = 'block';
      if (bellBtn) bellBtn.classList.add('has-alert');
      if (markReadBtn) markReadBtn.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    }

    function markOvertradeAsRead() {
      try {
        if (currentOvertradeSignature) {
          localStorage.setItem(OVERTRADE_READ_KEY, currentOvertradeSignature);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      showBellEmptyState();
      var bellPanel = document.getElementById('bell-panel');
      if (bellPanel) bellPanel.classList.remove('open');
      if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Bildirim okundu olarak işaretlendi');
    }
    window.markOvertradeAsRead = markOvertradeAsRead;

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // GLOBAL VARIABLES
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    var currentUser = null;
    var allTrades = [];
    var allStrategies = [];
    var charts = {};
    var isPageVisible = true;
    var chartRafId = null;
    var LAYOUT_KEY = 'ww_premium_layout';

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // LAYOUT STORAGE & RESET
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function saveLayoutOrder() {
      try {
        var items = document.querySelectorAll('.grid-item');
        var order = [];
        items.forEach(function(el) { order.push(el.dataset.widget); });
        localStorage.setItem(LAYOUT_KEY, JSON.stringify(order));
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    function loadLayoutOrder() {
      try {
        var saved = localStorage.getItem(LAYOUT_KEY);
        if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
      } catch(e) {}
      return null;
    }

    function resetLayout() {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(LAYOUT_KEY);
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast('✅ Düzen sıfırlandı! Sayfa yenileniyor...', 'success');
        }
        setTimeout(function() { window.location.reload(); }, 800);
      } catch(e) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast('Düzen sıfırlanamadı.', 'error');
        }
      }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // DRAG & DROP
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function initDragDrop() {
      var grid = document.getElementById('dashboard-grid');
      if (!grid) return;
      if (typeof Sortable !== 'undefined') {
        new Sortable(grid, {
          animation: 300,
          handle: '.drag-handle',
          ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost',
          onEnd: function() { saveLayoutOrder(); }
        });
      }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // HELPER FUNCTIONS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function getMultiplier(t) {
      var mult = t.multiplier || 100000;
      if (t.instrument && typeof INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS !== 'undefined' && INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[t.instrument]) {
        mult = t.multiplier || INSTRUMENT_MULTIPLIERS[t.instrument] || 100000;
      }
      return mult;
    }

    function calcTradePnL(t) {
      try {
        if (!t.entry_price || !t.exit_price || !t.lot) return 0;
        var mult = getMultiplier(t);
        var dir = (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY') ? 1 : -1;
        return dir * (parseFloat(t.exit_price) - parseFloat(t.entry_price)) * parseFloat(t.lot) * mult;
      } catch(e) { return 0; }
    }

    function formatCurrency(value) {
      var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
      var currency = typeof getCurrencySymbol === 'function' ? getCurrencySymbol() : '$';
      var formatted = Math.abs(num).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      if (num < 0) return '-' + currency + formatted;
      return '+' + currency + formatted;
    }

    function formatCurrencyPlain(value) {
      var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
      var currency = typeof getCurrencySymbol === 'function' ? getCurrencySymbol() : '$';
      var formatted = Math.abs(num).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      return (num < 0 ? '-' : '') + currency + formatted;
    }

    function escapeHtmlLocal(s) {
      if (s === null || s === undefined) return '';
      return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
        return { '&':'&amp;', '<':'&lt;', '>':'&gt;', '"':'&quot;', "'":'&#39;' }[c];
      });
    }

    function smartDateLabel(dateStr) {
      if (!dateStr) return '';
      var d = new Date(dateStr);
      var day = d.getDate();
      var month = d.getMonth() + 1;
      var year = d.getFullYear();
      var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      if (year !== currentYear) return day + '/' + month + '/' + String(year).slice(2);
      return day + '/' + month;
    }

    function colorToRgbaLocal(hex, alpha) {
      try {
        var r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16), g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16), b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
        return 'rgba(' + r + ',' + g + ',' + b + ',' + alpha + ')';
      } catch(e) { return hex; }
    }

    function formatCurrencyPDF(value) {
      var num = parseFloat(value) || 0;
      var currency = typeof getCurrencySymbol === 'function' ? getCurrencySymbol() : '$';
      var formatted = Math.abs(num).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      if (num < 0) return '-' + currency + formatted;
      return '+' + currency + formatted;
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // NAVBAR AVATAR
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    async function updateNavbarAvatar() {
      var el = document.getElementById('user-avatar');
      if (!el) return;
      try {
        var { data: { user } } = await sb.auth.getUser();
        if (!user) return;
        var { data: profile } = await sb.from('user_profiles').select('avatar_url').eq('id', user.id).single();
        if (profile && profile.avatar_url) {
          el.innerHTML = '<img src="' + profile.avatar_url + '" alt="avatar">';
          el.style.background = 'transparent';
          el.style.border = '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
        } else {
          var initial = user.user_metadata && user.user_metadata.username ? user.user_metadata.username.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : user.email.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
          el.textContent = initial;
          el.style.background = 'var(--accent)';
          el.style.border = 'none';
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SKELETON
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function showSkeletons() {
      var ids = ['premium-stats-skeleton','dashboard-skeleton'];
      ids.forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = (id === 'dashboard-skeleton' ? 'grid' : 'grid');
      });
      var hideIds = ['premium-stats-grid','dashboard-grid'];
      hideIds.forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
      });
    }

    function hideSkeletons() {
      var ids = ['premium-stats-skeleton','dashboard-skeleton'];
      ids.forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
      });
      var showIds = ['premium-stats-grid','dashboard-grid'];
      showIds.forEach(function(id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'grid';
      });
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER PREMIUM STATS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderPremiumStats(trades) {
      try {
        var closed = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.exit_price; });
        var pnls = closed.map(function(t) { return calcTradePnL(t); });
        var totalPnL = pnls.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0);
        var wins = pnls.filter(function(v) { return v > 0; }).length;
        var total = closed.length;
        var wr = total ? (wins/total)*100 : 0;
        var totalWin = pnls.filter(function(v) { return v > 0; }).reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0);
        var totalLoss = Math.abs(pnls.filter(function(v) { return v < 0; }).reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0));
        var pf = totalLoss > 0 ? totalWin/totalLoss : 0;
        var avgPnL = total ? totalPnL/total : 0;
        var stdDev = total > 1 ? Math.sqrt(pnls.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + Math.pow(v-avgPnL, 2); }, 0)/total) : 0;
        var sharpe = stdDev > 0 ? avgPnL/stdDev : 0;

        var elTotal = document.getElementById('pstat-total');
        var elPnl = document.getElementById('pstat-pnl');
        var elWr = document.getElementById('pstat-wr');
        var elPf = document.getElementById('pstat-pf');
        var elSharpe = document.getElementById('pstat-sharpe');

        if (elTotal) elTotal.textContent = total;
        if (elPnl) { elPnl.textContent = formatCurrency(totalPnL); elPnl.className = 'pstat-value ' + (totalPnL >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'); }
        if (elWr) elWr.textContent = wr.toFixed(1) + '%';
        if (elPf) elPf.textContent = pf.toFixed(2);
        if (elSharpe) elSharpe.textContent = sharpe.toFixed(2);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER KPI BAR
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderKpiBar(trades) {
      try {
        var closed = trades.filter(function(t) { return t.exit_price; });
        var pnls = closed.map(function(t) { return calcTradePnL(t); });
        var wins = pnls.filter(function(v) { return v > 0; });
        var losses = pnls.filter(function(v) { return v < 0; });
        var avgWin = wins.length ? wins.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0) / wins.length : 0;
        var avgLoss = losses.length ? Math.abs(losses.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0) / losses.length) : 0;
        var totalWin = wins.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0);
        var totalLoss = Math.abs(losses.reduce(function(s, v) { return s + v; }, 0));
        var pf = totalLoss > 0 ? totalWin / totalLoss : 0;

        var cumulative = 0, maxCumulative = 0, maxDrawdown = 0;
        closed.forEach(function(t) {
          var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
          cumulative += pnl;
          maxCumulative = Math.max(maxCumulative, cumulative);
          maxDrawdown = Math.min(maxDrawdown, cumulative - maxCumulative);
        });

        var totalRR = 0, rrCount = 0;
        trades.forEach(function(t) { if (t.rr_ratio) { totalRR += parseFloat(t.rr_ratio); rrCount++; } });
        var avgRR = rrCount ? totalRR / rrCount : 0;

        var elAvgWin = document.getElementById('kpi-avg-win');
        var elAvgLoss = document.getElementById('kpi-avg-loss');
        var elPf = document.getElementById('kpi-pf');
        var elDd = document.getElementById('kpi-dd');
        var elRr = document.getElementById('kpi-rr');

        if (elAvgWin) elAvgWin.textContent = formatCurrency(avgWin);
        if (elAvgLoss) elAvgLoss.textContent = formatCurrency(avgLoss);
        if (elPf) elPf.textContent = pf.toFixed(2);
        if (elDd) elDd.textContent = formatCurrency(Math.abs(maxDrawdown));
        if (elRr) elRr.textContent = avgRR.toFixed(2);
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // BUILD WIDGETS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function buildWidgets() {
      return {
        'cumulative': {
          title: 'Kümülatif K/Z',
          badge: true,
          badgeId: 'cumulative-change',
          badgeDefault: '↑ +0%',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-cumulative"></canvas>',
          class: 'wide tall',
          height: '200px'
        },
        'winloss': {
          title: 'Win / Loss Dağılımı',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-winloss"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '140px',
          doughnut: true
        },
        'daily': {
          title: 'Günlük K/Z – Son 30 Gün',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-daily"></canvas>',
          class: 'wide',
          height: '160px'
        },
        'symbol': {
          title: 'Sembol Bazlı Performans',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-symbol"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '160px'
        },
        'direction': {
          title: 'Long / Short Dağılımı',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-direction"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '140px',
          doughnut: true
        },
        'hourly': {
          title: 'Saat Bazlı Performans',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-hourly"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '140px'
        },
        'dow': {
          title: 'Haftanın Günü',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-dow"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '140px'
        },
        'rr': {
          title: 'R:R Dağılımı',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-rr"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '140px'
        },
        'lot': {
          title: 'Lot Büyüklüğü',
          template: '<canvas id="chart-lot"></canvas>',
          class: '',
          height: '140px'
        },
        'streak': {
          title: 'Seri Analizi',
          template: '<div id="streak-widget-body"></div>',
          class: '',
          height: 'auto'
        },
        'bestworst': {
          title: 'En İyi / En Kötü',
          template: '<div id="bw-body"></div>',
          class: '',
          height: 'auto'
        },
        'strategies': {
          title: '⭐ En İyi Stratejiler',
          template: '<div id="strategy-section-body"></div>',
          class: 'full',
          height: 'auto'
        }
      };
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER WIDGETS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderWidgets() {
      var grid = document.getElementById('dashboard-grid');
      if (!grid) return;

      var widgets = buildWidgets();
      var savedOrder = loadLayoutOrder();
      var widgetKeys = Object.keys(widgets);

      var orderedKeys = widgetKeys;
      if (savedOrder && savedOrder.length) {
        orderedKeys = savedOrder.filter(function(k) { return widgetKeys.indexOf(k) !== -1; });
        var missing = widgetKeys.filter(function(k) { return orderedKeys.indexOf(k) === -1; });
        orderedKeys = orderedKeys.concat(missing);
      }

      var html = '';
      orderedKeys.forEach(function(key) {
        var w = widgets[key];
        var badgeHtml = '';
        if (w.badge) {
          badgeHtml = '<span class="chart-badge" id="' + w.badgeId + '">' + w.badgeDefault + '</span>';
        }
        var doughnutClass = w.doughnut ? ' chart-wrap--doughnut' : '';
        var heightStyle = w.height ? 'height:' + w.height + ';' : '';

        html += '\n        <div class="grid-item ' + (w.class || '') + '" data-widget="' + key + '">\n          <div class="drag-handle">⠿</div>\n          <div class="grid-header">\n            <h3>' + w.title + '</h3>\n            ' + badgeHtml + '\n          </div>\n          <div class="chart-wrap' + doughnutClass + '" style="' + heightStyle + '">\n            ' + w.template + '\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';
      });

      grid.innerHTML = html;
      setTimeout(initDragDrop, 100);
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER STREAK
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderStreakWidget(trades) {
      var wrap = document.getElementById('streak-widget-body');
      if (!wrap) return;
      var closed = trades.filter(function(t){ return t.exit_price; })
        .slice().sort(function(a,b){ return new Date(a.trade_date) - new Date(b.trade_date); });

      if (!closed.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="bw-empty">Yeterli veri yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      var results = closed.map(function(t){ return calcTradePnL(t) > 0; });

      var curStreak = 0, curType = null;
      for (var i = results.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (curType === null) { curType = results[i]; curStreak = 1; }
        else if (results[i] === curType) { curStreak++; }
        else break;
      }

      var maxWin = 0, maxLoss = 0, w = 0, l = 0;
      results.forEach(function(r) {
        if (r) { w++; l = 0; if (w > maxWin) maxWin = w; }
        else { l++; w = 0; if (l > maxLoss) maxLoss = l; }
      });

      var last20 = results.slice(-20);
      var dotsHtml = last20.map(function(r){ return '<div class="streak-dot ' + (r ? 'win' : 'loss') + '"></div>'; }).join('');

      wrap.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="streak-widget">\n          <div class="streak-top">\n            <div class="streak-current">\n              <div class="num ' + (curType ? 'pos' : 'neg') + '">' + curStreak + '</div>\n              <div class="lbl">' + (curType ? 'Kazanma Serisi' : 'Kaybetme Serisi') + '</div>\n            </div>\n            <div class="streak-mini-stats">\n              <div class="streak-mini"><div class="v pos">' + maxWin + '</div><div class="l">Max Kazanma</div></div>\n              <div class="streak-mini"><div class="v neg">' + maxLoss + '</div><div class="l">Max Kaybetme</div></div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n          <div class="streak-dots">' + dotsHtml + '</div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER BEST/WORST
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderBestWorstList(trades) {
      var wrap = document.getElementById('bw-body');
      if (!wrap) return;

      var closed = trades.filter(function(t){ return t.exit_price; }).map(function(t){
        return {
          symbol: t.symbol || '—',
          date: t.trade_date,
          pnl: calcTradePnL(t),
          side: t.direction || '—',
          lot: t.lot || 0
        };
      });

      if (!closed.length) {
        wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="bw-empty">Yeterli veri yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      var sorted = closed.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return b.pnl - a.pnl; });
      var best = sorted.slice(0, 5);
      var worst = sorted.slice(-5).reverse();

      function rowsHtml(list) {
        return list.map(function(t) {
          var sideBadge = t.side === 'LONG' || t.side === 'BUY' ? 'L' : 'S';
          var dateStr = smartDateLabel(t.date);
          return '<div class="bw-row"><span class="bw-sym">' + escapeHtmlLocal(t.symbol) + ' <span class="bw-date">' + sideBadge + ' ' + t.lot + ' · ' + dateStr + '</span></span><span class="bw-pnl ' + (t.pnl >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg') + '">' + formatCurrency(t.pnl) + '</span></div>';
        }).join('');
      }

      wrap.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="bw-widget">\n          <div class="bw-columns">\n            <div><div class="bw-col-title best">🏆 En İyi 5</div>' + rowsHtml(best) + '</div>\n            <div><div class="bw-col-title worst">💀 En Kötü 5</div>' + rowsHtml(worst) + '</div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER STRATEGIES - FIXED
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function getSimpleStrategyPerf(strategyId, trades) {
      var strategyTrades = trades.filter(function(t){ return t.strategy_id === strategyId; });
      var closed = strategyTrades.filter(function(t){ return t.exit_price; });
      var totalPnL = 0, wins = 0;
      closed.forEach(function(t) { var p = calcTradePnL(t); totalPnL += p; if (p > 0) wins++; });
      var winRate = closed.length ? Math.round((wins / closed.length) * 1000) / 10 : 0;
      return { totalTrades: strategyTrades.length, closedCount: closed.length, winRate: winRate, totalPnL: totalPnL };
    }

    async function loadStrategySection(trades) {
      var section = document.getElementById('strategy-section-body');
      if (!section) return;

      if (!currentUser || !currentUser.id) {
        section.innerHTML = '<div class="strategy-empty-note">⚠️ Stratejiler yüklenemiyor. Lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.</div>';
        return;
      }

      try {
        var { data: strategies, error } = await sb
          .from('strategies')
          .select('*')
          .eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
          .order('name', { ascending: true });

        if (error) {
          console.error('Strateji çekme hatası:', error);
          section.innerHTML = '<div class="strategy-empty-note">⚠️ Stratejiler yüklenirken hata oluştu.</div>';
          return;
        }

        allStrategies = strategies || [];

        if (!allStrategies.length) {
          section.innerHTML = '<div class="strategy-empty-note">📭 Henüz strateji eklenmemiş. <a href="strategies.html" style="color:var(--accent2);">Strateji oluştur →</a></div>';
          return;
        }

        var strategyData = allStrategies.map(function(s) {
          var perf = getSimpleStrategyPerf(s.id, trades);
          return { ...s, perf: perf };
        });

        strategyData.sort(function(a, b) { return b.perf.totalPnL - a.perf.totalPnL; });

        var maxPnL = Math.max(1, Math.max.apply(null, strategyData.map(function(s) { return Math.abs(s.perf.totalPnL); })));

        var cardsHtml = strategyData.map(function(s, index) {
          var perf = s.perf;
          var rank = index + 1;
          var rankClass = rank === 1 ? 'top' : (rank <= 2 ? 'mid' : 'bottom');
          var progressPct = maxPnL > 0 ? (Math.abs(perf.totalPnL) / maxPnL) * 100 : 0;
          var progressClass = perf.totalPnL >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg';

          var displayWinRate = perf.closedCount > 0 ? perf.winRate + '%' : '—';
          var displayPnL = perf.closedCount > 0 ? formatCurrency(perf.totalPnL) : '—';
          var pnlClass = perf.totalPnL >= 0 ? 'pos' : 'neg';

          return '<div class="strategy-premium-card">' +
            '<div class="sp-top">' +
              '<span class="sp-color-bar" style="background:' + s.color + '"></span>' +
              '<span class="sp-name" title="' + escapeHtmlLocal(s.name) + '">' + escapeHtmlLocal(s.name) + '</span>' +
              '<span class="sp-rank ' + rankClass + '">#' + rank + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="sp-stats">' +
              '<div class="sp-stat"><div class="sp-stat-lbl">İşlem</div><div class="sp-stat-val">' + perf.totalTrades + '</div></div>' +
              '<div class="sp-stat"><div class="sp-stat-lbl">Win Rate</div><div class="sp-stat-val">' + displayWinRate + '</div></div>' +
              '<div class="sp-stat"><div class="sp-stat-lbl">K/Z</div><div class="sp-stat-val ' + pnlClass + '">' + displayPnL + '</div></div>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="sp-progress"><div class="sp-fill ' + progressClass + '" style="width:' + progressPct + '%;"></div></div>' +
          '</div>';
        }).join('');

        section.innerHTML = '<div class="strategy-premium-grid">' + cardsHtml + '</div>';
      } catch(e) {
        console.error('loadStrategySection hatası:', e);
        section.innerHTML = '<div class="strategy-empty-note">⚠️ Strateji verileri yüklenirken hata oluştu. Lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.</div>';
      }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // EXPORT FUNCTIONS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function exportCSV() {
      try {
        if (!allTrades || !allTrades.length) {
          showToast('Dışa aktarılacak işlem yok.', 'error');
          return;
        }
        var headers = ['Sembol', 'Yön', 'Enstrüman', 'Lot', 'Giriş', 'Çıkış', 'SL', 'TP', 'K/Z', 'R:R', 'Tarih', 'Not'];
        var rows = allTrades.map(function(t) {
          var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
          return [t.symbol||'', t.direction||'', t.instrument||'', t.lot||'', t.entry_price||'', t.exit_price||'', t.stop_loss||'', t.take_profit||'', t.exit_price ? pnl.toFixed(2) : '', t.rr_ratio||'', t.trade_date||'', (t.notes||'').replace(/,/g,';').replace(/\n/g,' ')].join(',');
        });
        var csv = [headers.join(','), rows.join('\n')].join('\n');
        var blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = 'wawe-premium-' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + '.csv';
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        showToast('CSV indirildi!', 'success');
      } catch(e) {
        showToast('CSV oluşturulamadı', 'error');
      }
    }

    function exportPDF() {
      try {
        if (!allTrades || !allTrades.length) {
          showToast('Dışa aktarılacak işlem yok.', 'error');
          return;
        }
        if (typeof window.jspdf === 'undefined') {
          showToast('PDF kütüphanesi yüklenemedi.', 'error');
          return;
        }
        var { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
        var doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: 'landscape', unit: 'mm', format: 'a4' });
        var W = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
        var H = doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight();

        doc.setFillColor(10, 10, 15);
        doc.rect(0, 0, W, H, 'F');
        doc.setFillColor(139, 92, 246);
        doc.rect(0, 0, W, 3, 'F');
        doc.setTextColor(232, 232, 240);
        doc.setFontSize(14);
        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
        doc.text('WAWE JOURNAL - PREMIUM RAPOR', 12, 12);
        doc.setFontSize(8);
        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
        doc.setTextColor(107, 107, 128);
        doc.text('Premium Dashboard Export', 12, 18);
        doc.text(new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr-TR'), W - 12, 18, { align: 'right' });

        var closed = allTrades.filter(function(t){ return t.exit_price; });
        var pnls = closed.map(function(t){ return calcTradePnL(t); });
        var totalPnL = pnls.reduce(function(s, v){ return s + v; }, 0);
        var wins = pnls.filter(function(v){ return v > 0; }).length;
        var total = closed.length;
        var wr = total ? Math.round((wins/total)*100) : 0;

        var stats = [
          ['Toplam İşlem', total.toString()],
          ['Toplam K/Z', formatCurrencyPDF(totalPnL)],
          ['Win Rate', wr + '%'],
          ['Kazanan', wins.toString()],
          ['Kaybeden', (total - wins).toString()]
        ];

        var yPos = 28;
        var cellW = (W - 24) / 5;
        stats.forEach(function(s, idx) {
          var cx = 12 + idx * cellW;
          doc.setFillColor(17, 17, 24);
          doc.roundedRect(cx, yPos, cellW - 2, 14, 2, 2, 'F');
          doc.setFillColor(30, 30, 46);
          doc.roundedRect(cx, yPos, cellW - 2, 14, 2, 2, 'S');
          doc.setTextColor(107, 107, 128);
          doc.setFontSize(6);
          doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
          doc.text(s[0], cx + (cellW - 2) / 2, yPos + 5, { align: 'center' });
          doc.setTextColor(232, 232, 240);
          doc.setFontSize(9);
          doc.text(s[1], cx + (cellW - 2) / 2, yPos + 12, { align: 'center' });
        });

        yPos += 22;
        doc.setTextColor(139, 92, 246);
        doc.setFontSize(9);
        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
        doc.text('İşlem Detayları', 12, yPos);
        yPos += 5;

        var colDefs = [
          { label: 'Sembol', w: 25 },
          { label: 'Yön', w: 18 },
          { label: 'Lot', w: 16 },
          { label: 'Giriş', w: 26 },
          { label: 'Çıkış', w: 26 },
          { label: 'K/Z', w: 28 },
          { label: 'Tarih', w: 26 }
        ];
        var totalW = colDefs.reduce(function(s, c){ return s + c.w; }, 0);
        var startX = (W - totalW) / 2;

        doc.setFillColor(30, 30, 46);
        doc.rect(startX, yPos, totalW, 6, 'F');
        doc.setTextColor(107, 107, 128);
        doc.setFontSize(5.5);
        doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
        var hx = startX + 2;
        colDefs.forEach(function(col) {
          doc.text(col.label, hx, yPos + 4);
          hx += col.w;
        });
        yPos += 6;

        var rowH = 5;
        var maxRows = Math.floor((H - yPos - 15) / rowH);
        var displayTrades = allTrades.slice(-maxRows).reverse();

        displayTrades.forEach(function(t, idx) {
          var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
          var isEven = idx % 2 === 0;
          doc.setFillColor(isEven ? 17 : 10, isEven ? 17 : 10, isEven ? 24 : 15);
          doc.rect(startX, yPos, totalW, rowH, 'F');

          var cx2 = startX + 2;
          doc.setTextColor(232, 232, 240);
          doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
          doc.setFontSize(6);
          doc.text((t.symbol || '—').toUpperCase(), cx2, yPos + 3.5);
          cx2 += colDefs[0].w;
          doc.setTextColor(107, 107, 128);
          doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
          doc.text(t.direction || '—', cx2, yPos + 3.5);
          cx2 += colDefs[1].w;
          doc.text(String(t.lot || '—'), cx2, yPos + 3.5);
          cx2 += colDefs[2].w;
          doc.text(String(t.entry_price || '—'), cx2, yPos + 3.5);
          cx2 += colDefs[3].w;
          if (t.exit_price) {
            doc.text(String(t.exit_price), cx2, yPos + 3.5);
          } else {
            doc.setTextColor(139, 92, 246);
            doc.text('Açık', cx2, yPos + 3.5);
            doc.setTextColor(107, 107, 128);
          }
          cx2 += colDefs[4].w;
          if (t.exit_price) {
            doc.setTextColor(pnl >= 0 ? 34 : 239, pnl >= 0 ? 197 : 68, pnl >= 0 ? 94 : 68);
            doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
            doc.text(formatCurrencyPDF(pnl), cx2, yPos + 3.5);
            doc.setTextColor(107, 107, 128);
            doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
          } else {
            doc.text('—', cx2, yPos + 3.5);
          }
          cx2 += colDefs[5].w;
          var dateStr = t.trade_date ? new Date(t.trade_date).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR') : '—';
          doc.text(dateStr, cx2, yPos + 3.5);

          yPos += rowH;
        });

        doc.setDrawColor(30, 30, 46);
        doc.setLineWidth(0.3);
        doc.rect(startX, yPos - displayTrades.length * rowH - 6, totalW, displayTrades.length * rowH + 6, 'S');

        doc.save('wawe-premium-rapor-' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + '.pdf');
        showToast('PDF indirildi!', 'success');
      } catch(e) {
        console.error('PDF hatası:', e);
        showToast('PDF oluşturulamadı', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CHART FUNCTIONS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderCumulativeChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-cumulative');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-cumulative']) { try { charts['chart-cumulative'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-cumulative']; }

      var cum = 0, cumLabels = [], cumData = [], cumColors = [];
      trades.forEach(function(t) {
        var pnl = calcTradePnL(t);
        cum += pnl;
        cumLabels.push(smartDateLabel(t.trade_date));
        cumData.push(cum);
        cumColors.push(cum >= 0 ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444');
      });

      if (cumData.length === 0) {
        canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      var firstPnL = cumData[0] || 0;
      var lastPnL = cumData[cumData.length-1] || 0;
      var changePercent = firstPnL !== 0 ? ((lastPnL - firstPnL) / Math.abs(firstPnL) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
      var changeEl = document.getElementById('cumulative-change');
      if (changeEl) {
        changeEl.textContent = (lastPnL >= firstPnL ? '↑' : '↓') + ' ' + Math.abs(changePercent) + '%';
        changeEl.className = 'chart-badge ' + (lastPnL >= firstPnL ? '' : 'negative');
      }

      var totalPoints = cumLabels.length;
      var pointRadius = totalPoints > 50 ? 0 : (totalPoints > 20 ? 1.5 : 3);

      charts['chart-cumulative'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'line',
        data: { labels: cumLabels, datasets: [{ data: cumData, borderColor: '#8b5cf6', backgroundColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.08)', fill: true, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: pointRadius, pointHoverRadius: 4, pointBackgroundColor: cumColors, borderWidth: 2 }] },
        options: {
          responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: {
            title: function(items) { var idx = items[0].dataIndex; var t = trades[idx]; if (!t || !t.trade_date) return items[0].label; var d = new Date(t.trade_date); return d.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR', { day:'2-digit', month:'short', year:'numeric' }); },
            label: function(ctx) { return 'K/Z: ' + formatCurrency(ctx.raw); }
          } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 9 }, maxTicksLimit: 6 } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 9 }, callback: function(v) { return formatCurrency(v); } } } }
        }
      });
    }

    function renderWinLossChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-winloss');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-winloss']) { try { charts['chart-winloss'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-winloss']; }

      var wins = 0, losses = 0, open = 0;
      trades.forEach(function(t) { if (!t.exit_price) open++; else if (calcTradePnL(t) > 0) wins++; else losses++; });

      if (wins === 0 && losses === 0 && open === 0) {
        canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      charts['chart-winloss'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: { labels: ['Kazanan', 'Kaybeden', 'Açık'], datasets: [{ data: [wins, losses, open], backgroundColor: ['#22c55e', '#ef4444', '#64748b'], borderWidth: 0, cutout: '68%' }] },
        options: {
          responsive: true,
          maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: {
            legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 9 }, boxWidth: 10, padding: 6 } }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function renderDailyChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-daily');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-daily']) { try { charts['chart-daily'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-daily']; }

      var days = {};
      var now = new Date();
      for (var i = 29; i >= 0; i--) { var d = new Date(now); d.setDate(d.getDate() - i); days[d.toISOString().split('T')[0]] = 0; }
      trades.forEach(function(t) { if (t.exit_price && days[t.trade_date] !== undefined) days[t.trade_date] += calcTradePnL(t); });
      var labels = Object.keys(days).map(function(d) { var dt = new Date(d); return dt.getDate() + '/' + (dt.getMonth()+1); });
      var data = Object.values(days);
      if (data.every(function(v) { return v === 0; })) { canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>'; return; }

      charts['chart-daily'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: data.map(function(v) { return v >= 0 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.7)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.7)'; }), borderRadius: 3 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return formatCurrency(ctx.raw); } } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 8 }, maxTicksLimit: 6 } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 9 }, callback: function(v) { return formatCurrency(v); } } } } }
      });
    }

    function renderSymbolChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-symbol');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-symbol']) { try { charts['chart-symbol'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-symbol']; }

      var symbolMap = {};
      trades.forEach(function(t) { if (t.exit_price) symbolMap[t.symbol] = (symbolMap[t.symbol] || 0) + calcTradePnL(t); });
      var sortedSymbols = Object.entries(symbolMap).sort(function(a,b) { return Math.abs(b[1]) - Math.abs(a[1]); }).slice(0, 6);

      if (sortedSymbols.length === 0) {
        canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      charts['chart-symbol'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: sortedSymbols.map(function(s) { return s[0]; }), datasets: [{ data: sortedSymbols.map(function(s) { return s[1]; }), backgroundColor: sortedSymbols.map(function(s) { return s[1] >= 0 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.7)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.7)'; }), borderRadius: 3 }] },
        options: { indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
          plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return formatCurrency(ctx.raw); } } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, callback: function(v) { return formatCurrency(v); }, font: { size: 8 } } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 8 } } } } }
      });
    }

    function renderDirectionChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-direction');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-direction']) { try { charts['chart-direction'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-direction']; }

      var longs = 0, shorts = 0;
      trades.forEach(function(t) { if (t.direction === 'LONG' || t.direction === 'BUY') longs++; else shorts++; });

      if (longs === 0 && shorts === 0) {
        canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      charts['chart-direction'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: { labels: ['Long', 'Short'], datasets: [{ data: [longs, shorts], backgroundColor: ['#8b5cf6', '#f97316'], borderWidth: 0, cutout: '68%' }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom', labels: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 9 }, boxWidth: 10, padding: 6 } } } }
      });
    }

    function renderHourlyChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-hourly');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-hourly']) { try { charts['chart-hourly'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-hourly']; }

      var hours = {};
      for (var h = 0; h < 24; h++) hours[h] = { pnl: 0, count: 0 };
      var hasTimeData = false;
      trades.forEach(function(t) {
        if (!t.exit_price || !t.trade_date) return;
        var d = new Date(t.trade_date);
        var hr = d.getHours();
        if (t.trade_date.indexOf('T') !== -1 || t.trade_date.indexOf(':') !== -1) hasTimeData = true;
        hours[hr].pnl += calcTradePnL(t);
        hours[hr].count++;
      });

      var labels = [], data = [];
      for (var h2 = 0; h2 < 24; h2++) { labels.push(h2 + ':00'); data.push(hours[h2].pnl); }

      if (!hasTimeData) {
        canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;text-align:center;padding:0 0.5rem;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Saat bilgisi yok</div>';
        return;
      }

      charts['chart-hourly'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: data.map(function(v){ return v >= 0 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.7)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.7)'; }), borderRadius: 2 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return formatCurrency(ctx.raw); } } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 7 }, maxTicksLimit: 8 } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 8 }, callback: function(v){ return formatCurrency(v); } } } } }
      });
    }

    function renderDayOfWeekChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-dow');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-dow']) { try { charts['chart-dow'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-dow']; }

      var dayNames = ['Pzt','Sal','Çar','Per','Cum','Cmt','Paz'];
      var buckets = {};
      [1,2,3,4,5,6,0].forEach(function(o){ buckets[o] = 0; });

      var any = false;
      trades.forEach(function(t) {
        if (!t.exit_price || !t.trade_date) return;
        var d = new Date(t.trade_date);
        buckets[d.getDay()] += calcTradePnL(t);
        any = true;
      });

      if (!any) { canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>'; return; }

      var data = [1,2,3,4,5,6,0].map(function(o){ return buckets[o]; });

      charts['chart-dow'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: dayNames, datasets: [{ data: data, backgroundColor: data.map(function(v){ return v >= 0 ? 'rgba(139,92,246,0.7)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.7)'; }), borderRadius: 3 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return formatCurrency(ctx.raw); } } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 8 } } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 8 }, callback: function(v){ return formatCurrency(v); } } } } }
      });
    }

    function renderRRHistogram(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-rr');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-rr']) { try { charts['chart-rr'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-rr']; }

      var buckets = [
        { label: '<0.5', min: -Infinity, max: 0.5, count: 0 },
        { label: '0.5-1', min: 0.5, max: 1, count: 0 },
        { label: '1-1.5', min: 1, max: 1.5, count: 0 },
        { label: '1.5-2', min: 1.5, max: 2, count: 0 },
        { label: '2-3', min: 2, max: 3, count: 0 },
        { label: '3+', min: 3, max: Infinity, count: 0 }
      ];
      var any = false;
      trades.forEach(function(t) {
        if (!t.rr_ratio) return;
        var rr = parseFloat(t.rr_ratio);
        if (isNaN(rr)) return;
        any = true;
        for (var i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
          if (rr >= buckets[i].min && rr < buckets[i].max) { buckets[i].count++; break; }
        }
      });

      if (!any) { canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;text-align:center;padding:0 0.5rem;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">R:R verisi yok</div>'; return; }

      charts['chart-rr'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: buckets.map(function(b){return b.label;}), datasets: [{ data: buckets.map(function(b){return b.count;}), backgroundColor: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.7)', borderColor: '#8b5cf6', borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 3 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return ctx.raw + ' işlem'; } } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 7 } } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 7 }, precision: 0 } } } }
      });
    }

    function renderLotAnalysisChart(trades) {
      var canvas = document.getElementById('chart-lot');
      if (!canvas) return;
      if (charts['chart-lot']) { try { charts['chart-lot'].destroy(); } catch(e) {} delete charts['chart-lot']; }

      var buckets = {};
      var any = false;
      trades.forEach(function(t) {
        if (!t.exit_price || !t.lot) return;
        any = true;
        var lotRounded = Math.round(parseFloat(t.lot) * 10) / 10;
        var key = lotRounded.toFixed(1);
        if (!buckets[key]) buckets[key] = { total: 0, count: 0 };
        buckets[key].total += calcTradePnL(t);
        buckets[key].count++;
      });

      if (!any) { canvas.parentElement.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100%;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Yeterli veri yok</div>'; return; }

      var sortedKeys = Object.keys(buckets).sort(function(a,b){ return parseFloat(a)-parseFloat(b); }).slice(0, 8);
      var avgData = sortedKeys.map(function(k){ return buckets[k].total / buckets[k].count; });

      charts['chart-lot'] = new Chart(canvas, {
        type: 'bar',
        data: { labels: sortedKeys, datasets: [{ data: avgData, backgroundColor: avgData.map(function(v){ return v >= 0 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.7)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.7)'; }), borderRadius: 3 }] },
        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: { callbacks: { label: function(ctx) { return 'Ort. K/Z: ' + formatCurrency(ctx.raw); } } } },
          scales: { x: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 7 } } }, y: { grid: { color: GRID_LINE_COLOR }, ticks: { color: WHITE, font: { size: 7 }, callback: function(v){ return formatCurrency(v); } } } } }
      });
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // RENDER ALL CHARTS
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function renderCharts(trades) {
      if (!isPageVisible) return;
      if (!trades || !trades.length) return;

      renderCumulativeChart(trades);
      renderWinLossChart(trades);
      renderDailyChart(trades);
      renderSymbolChart(trades);
      renderDirectionChart(trades);
      renderHourlyChart(trades);
      renderDayOfWeekChart(trades);
      renderRRHistogram(trades);
      renderLotAnalysisChart(trades);
      renderStreakWidget(trades);
      renderBestWorstList(trades);
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // LOAD PREMIUM DATA
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    async function loadPremiumData() {
      showSkeletons();

      try {
        var user = await requireAuth();
        if (!user) return;
        currentUser = user;

        var planData = await getUserPlan();
        if (planData.plan !== 'premium') {
          var main = document.getElementById('main-content');
          main.innerHTML = '\n          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:60vh;text-align:center;gap:1.5rem;padding:2rem;">\n            <div style="font-size:4rem;">💎</div>\n            <h2 style="font-family:\'Syne\',sans-serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--text);">Premium\'a Özel</h2>\n            <p style="color:var(--muted);max-width:400px;font-size:14px;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Bu sayfa sadece Premium üyelere özeldir.</p>\n            <a href="settings.html#panel-plan" class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:0.7rem 2rem;text-decoration:none;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">Premium\'a Geç →</a>\n            <a href="dashboard.html" style="color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;font-family:\'DM Sans\',sans-serif;">← Standart Dashboard\'a Dön</a>\n          </div>\n        ';
          return;
        }

        // 🔔 Over trade uyarısını bildirim çanına yükle
        try {
          await updateOvertradeBell();
        } catch(e) {}

        if (isAdmin(user)) {
          var adminLink = document.getElementById('admin-link');
          var adminLinkMobile = document.getElementById('admin-link-mobile');
          if (adminLink) adminLink.style.display = 'inline';
          if (adminLinkMobile) adminLinkMobile.style.display = 'block';
        }

        await updateNavbarAvatar();

        var { data, error } = await sb.from('trades').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id).order('trade_date', { ascending: true });
        if (error) { showToast('Veriler yüklenemedi', 'error'); return; }

        allTrades = data || [];

        var main2 = document.getElementById('main-content');
        main2.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="page-header">\n          <div>\n            <div class="page-header-title-row"><h1>Premium Dashboard</h1><span class="premium-crown-badge">Premium</span></div>\n            <p class="subtitle">Gelişmiş analiz ve strateji takibi</p>\n          </div>\n          <div class="header-actions">\n            <button class="btn-export" id="export-csv-btn"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg> CSV</button>\n            <button class="btn-export" id="export-pdf-btn"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/></svg> PDF</button>\n            <button class="layout-reset-btn" id="layout-reset-btn"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10"/><path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 1 1-2.12-9.36L23 10"/></svg> Düzeni Sıfırla</button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="premium-stats-grid" id="premium-stats-grid">\n          <div class="pstat-card"><div class="pstat-label">Toplam İşlem</div><div class="pstat-value" id="pstat-total">—</div></div>\n          <div class="pstat-card"><div class="pstat-label">Toplam K/Z</div><div class="pstat-value" id="pstat-pnl">—</div></div>\n          <div class="pstat-card"><div class="pstat-label">Win Rate</div><div class="pstat-value" id="pstat-wr">—</div></div>\n          <div class="pstat-card"><div class="pstat-label">Profit Factor</div><div class="pstat-value" id="pstat-pf">—</div></div>\n          <div class="pstat-card"><div class="pstat-label">Sharpe Ratio</div><div class="pstat-value" id="pstat-sharpe">—</div></div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="kpi-bar">\n          <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label">Ort. Kazanç</span><span class="kpi-value positive" id="kpi-avg-win">—</span></div>\n          <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label">Ort. Kayıp</span><span class="kpi-value negative" id="kpi-avg-loss">—</span></div>\n          <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label">Profit Factor</span><span class="kpi-value" id="kpi-pf">—</span></div>\n          <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label">Max Drawdown</span><span class="kpi-value negative" id="kpi-dd">—</span></div>\n          <div class="kpi-item"><span class="kpi-label">Ort. R:R</span><span class="kpi-value" id="kpi-rr">—</span></div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div class="dashboard-grid" id="dashboard-grid"></div>\n      ';

        renderWidgets();
        renderPremiumStats(allTrades);
        renderKpiBar(allTrades);

        document.getElementById('export-csv-btn').addEventListener('click', exportCSV);
        document.getElementById('export-pdf-btn').addEventListener('click', exportPDF);
        document.getElementById('export-csv-fab').addEventListener('click', exportCSV);
        document.getElementById('export-pdf-fab').addEventListener('click', exportPDF);

        document.getElementById('layout-reset-btn').addEventListener('click', resetLayout);

        if (chartRafId) cancelAnimationFrame(chartRafId);
        chartRafId = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          renderCharts(allTrades);
        });

        loadStrategySection(allTrades);

        hideSkeletons();
        setTimeout(initDragDrop, 200);
      } catch(e) {
        console.error('Premium Dashboard hatası:', e);
        showToast('Premium Dashboard yüklenirken hata oluştu', 'error');
      }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SKELETON INJECT
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    function injectSkeletonMarkup() {
      var main = document.getElementById('main-content');
      main.innerHTML = '\n        <div class="premium-stats-skeleton" id="premium-stats-skeleton">\n          <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>\n          <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>\n          <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>\n          <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>\n          <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>\n        </div>\n        <div class="dashboard-skeleton" id="dashboard-skeleton">\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block wide"></div>\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block"></div>\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block wide"></div>\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block"></div>\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block"></div>\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block"></div>\n          <div class="generic-skeleton-block full"></div>\n        </div>\n      ';
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // DOM READY
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      var ua = document.getElementById('user-avatar');
      var dm = document.getElementById('dropdown-menu');
      if (ua && dm) {
        ua.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); dm.classList.toggle('show'); });
        document.addEventListener('click', function() { dm.classList.remove('show'); });
      }

      var logoutBtn = document.getElementById('logout-dropdown-btn');
      if (logoutBtn) {
        logoutBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
          localStorage.removeItem('ww_last_active_push');
          await sb.auth.signOut();
          window.location.href = 'index.html';
        });
      }

      var nt = document.getElementById('nav-toggle');
      var nm = document.getElementById('nav-menu');
      var nb = document.getElementById('nav-backdrop');

      function openMenu() { if (nt) nt.classList.add('open'); if (nm) nm.classList.add('open'); if (nb) nb.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
      function closeMenu() { if (nt) nt.classList.remove('open'); if (nm) nm.classList.remove('open'); if (nb) nb.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }

      if (nt) nt.addEventListener('click', function() { nm.classList.contains('open') ? closeMenu() : openMenu(); });
      if (nb) nb.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);

      var logoutMobile = document.getElementById('logout-btn-mobile');
      if (logoutMobile) {
        logoutMobile.addEventListener('click', function() { closeMenu(); var btn = document.getElementById('logout-dropdown-btn'); if (btn) btn.click(); });
      }
    });

    injectSkeletonMarkup();
    loadPremiumData();

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
      isPageVisible = !document.hidden;
      if (isPageVisible && allTrades && allTrades.length > 0) {
        if (chartRafId) cancelAnimationFrame(chartRafId);
        chartRafId = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
          renderCharts(allTrades);
        });
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
</file>

<file path="public/privacy.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Gizlilik Politikası – Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="pages.css" />
</head>
<body style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh;">

  <nav class="nav">
    <a href="index.html" class="nav-logo">
      <div class="logo-icon">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none">
          <polyline points="2,16 7,9 12,13 19,4" stroke="#7c6dfa" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      Wawe<span>Journal</span>
    </a>
    <div class="nav-links">
    </div>
  </nav>

  <main style="flex:1;max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem;width:100%;">
    <div class="page-card">
      <h1>Gizlilik Politikası</h1>
      <p class="last-updated">Son güncelleme: 15 Mayıs 2026</p>

      <h2>1. Toplanan Veriler</h2>
      <p>Wawe Journal olarak, yalnızca hizmetlerimizi sunmak için gerekli olan verileri toplarız:</p>
      <ul>
        <li>E-posta adresiniz (hesap oluşturma için)</li>
        <li>İşlem verileriniz (sembol, lot, fiyatlar, tarih, notlar)</li>
        <li>Son aktif olma zamanınız (kullanıcı durumu için)</li>
      </ul>

      <h2>2. Verilerin Kullanımı</h2>
      <p>Topladığımız veriler yalnızca aşağıdaki amaçlar için kullanılır:</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Hesabınızı yönetmek ve kimlik doğrulaması sağlamak</li>
        <li>İşlemlerinizi kaydetmek ve analiz etmek</li>
        <li>Dashboard ve grafiklerinizi oluşturmak</li>
        <li>Teknik destek sağlamak</li>
      </ul>

      <h2>3. Veri Güvenliği</h2>
      <p>Verileriniz Supabase altyapısında şifrelenmiş olarak saklanır. <strong>Row Level Security (RLS)</strong> politikaları sayesinde hiçbir kullanıcı başka bir kullanıcının verilerini göremez. Admin kullanıcılar dahi sadece anonimleştirilmiş istatistikleri görebilir.</p>

      <h2>4. Üçüncü Taraflar</h2>
      <p>Verileriniz asla üçüncü taraflarla paylaşılmaz. Sadece aşağıdaki hizmet sağlayıcılar kullanılır:</p>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Supabase</strong> – Veritabanı ve kimlik doğrulama</li>
        <li><strong>Cloudflare Pages</strong> – Web sitesi barındırma</li>
      </ul>

      <h2>5. Verilerinizi Silme</h2>
      <p>Hesabınızı silmek isterseniz, lütfen <a href="contact.html">iletişim sayfası</a> üzerinden bize ulaşın. Hesabınız ve tüm işlem verileriniz kalıcı olarak silinecektir.</p>

      <h2>6. Çerezler (Cookies)</h2>
      <p>Wawe Journal, oturum yönetimi için gerekli olan teknik çerezleri kullanır. Bu çerezler oturum açık kaldığınız sürece aktiftir ve tarayıcınızı kapattığınızda silinir.</p>

      <h2>7. İletişim</h2>
      <p>Gizlilik politikamızla ilgili sorularınız için: <a href="mailto:destek@wawedev.com">destek@wawedev.com</a></p>

      <div class="back-link">
        <a href="index.html" class="btn btn-ghost">← Ana Sayfaya Dön</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <footer class="site-footer">
    <div class="footer-container">
      <div class="footer-col">

<file path="public/register.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Sign Up – Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
</head>
<body>

  <nav class="nav">
    <a href="index.html" class="nav-logo">
      <div class="logo-icon">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none">
          <polyline points="2,16 7,9 12,13 19,4" stroke="#7c6dfa" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </a>
    <div class="nav-links">
    </div>
  </nav>

  <div class="auth-wrap">
    <div class="auth-box">
      <h1 class="auth-title">Create Account</h1>
      <p class="auth-sub">Already have an account? <a href="login.html" style="color:var(--accent);">Login</a></p>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Username *</label>
        <input type="text" id="username" placeholder="e.g., traderjohn" autocomplete="username" />
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Email</label>
        <input type="email" id="email" placeholder="trader@example.com" autocomplete="email" />
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Password</label>
        <input type="password" id="password" placeholder="At least 6 characters" autocomplete="new-password" />
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Confirm Password</label>
        <input type="password" id="password2" placeholder="Re-enter password" autocomplete="new-password" />
      </div>

      <p class="error-msg" id="err" style="display:none;"></p>

      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="register-btn" style="width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:.5rem;">
        Sign Up
      </button>

      <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:1rem;text-align:center;">
        By signing up, you agree to our <a href="terms.html" style="color:var(--accent);">Terms of Use</a>.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
  <script src="config.js"></script>
  <script src="script.js"></script>
  <script>
    function hasTurkishChars(str) {
      return /[ığüşöçİĞÜŞÖÇ]/.test(str);
    }

    document.getElementById('register-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
      let email    = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
      const pass2    = document.getElementById('password2').value;
      const errEl    = document.getElementById('err');
      errEl.style.display = 'none';

      email = email.toLowerCase();

      if (!username) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Username is required.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      if (username.length < 3) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Username must be at least 3 characters.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      if (!email || !password) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Email and password are required.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      if (hasTurkishChars(email)) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Email address cannot contain Turkish characters. Example: trader@example.com';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      if (password.length < 6) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Password must be at least 6 characters.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      if (password !== pass2) {
        errEl.textContent = 'Passwords do not match.';
        errEl.style.display = 'block'; return;
      }

      const btn = document.getElementById('register-btn');
      btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Signing up…';

      const { error } = await sb.auth.signUp({
        email,
        password,
        options: {
          data: { username: username }
        }
      });

      if (error) {
        errEl.textContent = error.message;
        errEl.style.display = 'block';
        btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Sign Up';
        return;
      }

      showToast('Registration successful! You can now log in.');
      setTimeout(() => window.location.href = 'login.html', 2200);
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('register-btn').click();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
</file>
