<file path="public/strategies.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title data-i18n="strategies.title">Stratejiler – Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">


  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/components/navbar.css" />

  <script>
  (function() {
    if (document.body) {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
      if (savedTheme === 'light') {
        document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
      } else {
        document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
      }
    } else {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ww_theme');
        if (savedTheme === 'light') {
          document.body.classList.add('light-theme');
        } else {
          document.body.classList.remove('light-theme');
        }
      });
    }
  })();
  </script>




  <script>
    (function() {
      var savedLang = localStorage.getItem('ww_language');
      if (savedLang && ['en', 'tr', 'de'].includes(savedLang)) {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', savedLang);
        document.documentElement.lang = savedLang;
        console.log('🌐 [Preload] Dil geri yüklendi:', savedLang);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem('ww_language', 'en');
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', 'en');
        document.documentElement.lang = 'en';
        console.log('🌐 [Preload] Varsayılan dil ayarlandı: en');
      }
    })();
  </script>

  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600;9..40,700&family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32,300;14..32,400;14..32,500;14..32,600;14..32,700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" />
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.0/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf-autotable/3.8.2/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js"></script>

  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       STRATEGIES SAYFASI - DASHBOARD TASARIMI
       ============================================================ */

    .strategies-main {
      padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* Page Header - Dashboard ile aynı */
    .page-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .page-header h1 {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text) 0%, var(--accent2) 100%);
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .page-header h1 em {
      font-style: normal;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .page-header .subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .page-header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* ⭐ Zaman aralığı filtresi */
    .time-filter-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      padding: 3px;
    }
    .time-filter-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .time-filter-btn:hover { color: var(--text); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
    .time-filter-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(139,92,246,0.35);
    }

    /* ⭐ Export butonları */
    .btn-export {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      padding: 0.58rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .btn-export:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent2);
      color: var(--accent2);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* Stats Grid - Dashboard ile aynı */
    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .stat-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .stat-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
    }
    .stat-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2), var(--accent3));
    }
    .stat-card .stat-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    .stat-card .stat-value {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .stat-card .stat-value.pos { color: var(--green); }
    .stat-card .stat-value.neg { color: var(--red); }

    /* Strategy Cards Grid */
    .strategies-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    /* Strategy Cards Grid - Skeleton */
    .strategies-grid-skeleton {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1rem;
      min-height: 200px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card .skeleton-line {
      height: 12px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      opacity: 0.3;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card .skeleton-line-sm {
      height: 8px;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      opacity: 0.2;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      width: 60%;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card .skeleton-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 5px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card .skeleton-stats .skeleton-stat-box {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 0.5rem;
      min-height: 40px;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card .skeleton-stats .skeleton-stat-box .skeleton-line {
      height: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .strategies-grid-skeleton .skeleton-strategy-card .skeleton-stats .skeleton-stat-box .skeleton-line:last-child {
      width: 70%;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .strategy-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
      animation: card-in 0.3s ease both;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .strategy-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent2);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(139,92,246,0.12);
    }
    @keyframes card-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .sc-top { padding: 1rem 1rem 0.7rem; flex: 1; }

    .sc-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .sc-name-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      min-width: 0;
    }
    .sc-color-bar {
      width: 3px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 99px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 1px;
    }
    .sc-name {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0 0 0.1rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .sc-desc {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      max-width: 130px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .sc-wr-dot {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      margin-top: 4px;
      background: var(--muted);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    }
    .sc-wr-dot.pos {
      background: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,0.5), 0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,0.12);
    }
    .sc-wr-dot.neg {
      background: var(--red);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(239,68,68,0.5), 0 0 0 3px rgba(239,68,68,0.12);
    }

    .sc-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 5px;
      margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
    }
    .sc-stat {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.55rem;
    }
    .sc-stat-lbl {
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.07em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    .sc-stat-val {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .sc-stat-val.pos { color: var(--green); }
    .sc-stat-val.neg { color: var(--red); }

    /* ⭐ En iyi enstrüman etiketi - sembol ile birlikte */
    .sc-instrument-tag {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .sc-instrument-tag .tag-name {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .sc-instrument-tag .tag-symbol {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--accent2);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      margin-left: 4px;
    }
    .sc-instrument-tag .tag-pnl {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 10px;
    }
    .sc-instrument-tag .tag-pnl.pos { color: var(--green); }
    .sc-instrument-tag .tag-pnl.neg { color: var(--red); }

    .sc-spark {
      height: 42px;
      margin: 0 -2px;
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }
    .sc-spark.clickable:hover {
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.06);
    }
    .sc-spark-hint {
      position: absolute;
      top: 2px;
      right: 2px;
      font-size: 8px;
      color: var(--muted);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.15s;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .sc-spark.clickable:hover .sc-spark-hint { opacity: 0.7; }

    .sc-footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .dir-pills { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
    .dp {
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 99px;
    }
    .dp-long { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.12); color: var(--green); }
    .dp-short { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.12); color: var(--red); }

    .sc-actions { display: flex; gap: 2px; }
    .sc-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .sc-btn:hover { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1); color: var(--accent2); }
    .sc-btn.danger:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); color: var(--red); }

    /* Add Card */
    .strategy-card-add {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px dashed var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      padding: 2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
      min-height: 200px;
    }
    .strategy-card-add:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.03);
      border-style: solid;
    }
    .add-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.2);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--accent2);
    }
    .add-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }

    /* Empty State */
    .empty-strategies {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 4rem 2rem;
      text-align: center;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
    }
    .empty-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: rgba(139,92,246,0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .empty-strategies h3 {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    }
    .empty-strategies p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      opacity: 0.6;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }

    /* Add Strategy Button - Dashboard btn stili */
    .btn-add-strategy {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      color: #fff;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
    }
    .btn-add-strategy:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.5);
    }

    /* Comparison Section - Dashboard chart ile aynı */
    .comparison-section {
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    .comparison-title {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    }
    .comparison-title em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--accent2);
    }
    .comparison-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .comparison-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .comparison-card-header {
      padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif !important;
      font-size: 11px !important;
      font-weight: 600 !important;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em !important;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .comparison-chart-inner {
      height: 200px;
      padding: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* Comparison Section - Skeleton */
    .comparison-skeleton {
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-title {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 200px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    body.light-theme .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton::after {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.07) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 70%, transparent 100%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeletonShimmer 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-header {
      padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--border);
      opacity: 0.3;
      border-radius: 0;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area {
      height: 164px;
      padding: 0.75rem;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      width: 80%;
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--border);
      border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
      min-height: 8px;
      opacity: 0.3;
    }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(1) { height: 30%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(2) { height: 55%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(3) { height: 80%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(4) { height: 45%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(5) { height: 70%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(6) { height: 25%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(7) { height: 90%; }
    .comparison-skeleton .comparison-card-skeleton .skeleton-chart-area .skeleton-bar-group .skeleton-bar:nth-child(8) { height: 50%; }

    /* Modal - Dashboard ile aynı */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      z-index: 400;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .modal-overlay.active { display: flex; }
    .modal-box {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 460px;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      animation: modal-in 0.2s ease;
    }
    @keyframes modal-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.96) translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }
    .modal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 1.1rem 1.35rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .modal-header h3 {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 0;
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
    }
    .modal-close {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
    .modal-body { padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem; }
    .modal-field { margin-bottom: 0.9rem; }
    .modal-field label {
      display: block;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
    .modal-field input[type="text"],
    .modal-field textarea {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      resize: vertical;
    }
    .modal-field input[type="text"]:focus,
    .modal-field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .modal-field input[type="color"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 44px;
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .modal-footer {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 0.9rem 1.35rem 1.25rem;
    }
    .btn-modal-cancel {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 0.55rem 1.15rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-modal-cancel:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .btn-modal-confirm {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 0.55rem 1.35rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(139,92,246,0.3);
    }
    .btn-modal-confirm:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(139,92,246,0.5);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ⭐ Büyük detay modalı (strateji detay & equity curve) */
    .modal-box.modal-box-lg {
      max-width: 880px;
    }
    .modal-box.modal-box-md {
      max-width: 620px;
    }
    .detail-metrics-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0.6rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .detail-metric-box {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem;
    }
    .detail-metric-lbl {
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    }
    .detail-metric-val {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .detail-metric-val.pos { color: var(--green); }
    .detail-metric-val.neg { color: var(--red); }
    .detail-section-title {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin: 1.1rem 0 0.6rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .detail-table-wrap {
      max-height: 260px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
    }
    table.detail-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    table.detail-table thead th {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      background: var(--surface2);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 9.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }
    table.detail-table tbody td {
      padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--text);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    table.detail-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    table.detail-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.04); }
    table.detail-table td.pos { color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; }
    table.detail-table td.neg { color: var(--red); font-weight: 600; }
    .detail-empty-note {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }
    .equity-chart-wrap {
      height: 360px;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem;
    }
    .detail-header-info {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
    }
    .detail-color-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RESPONSIVE - SADECE SAYFA İÇİ
       ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .strategies-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .strategies-grid-skeleton { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .comparison-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .comparison-skeleton .comparison-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .detail-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .strategies-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .strategies-grid-skeleton { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .page-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .btn-add-strategy { justify-content: center; }
      .page-header-actions { justify-content: stretch; }
      .time-filter-group { justify-content: space-between; }
      .detail-metrics-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .modal-box.modal-box-lg, .modal-box.modal-box-md { max-width: 96vw; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>


  <div id="navbar-container"></div>




  <main class="strategies-main">


    <div class="page-header">
      <div>
        <h1 data-i18n="strategies.title">Strateji <em data-i18n="strategies.title_em">Paneli</em></h1>
        <p class="subtitle" data-i18n="strategies.subtitle">Tüm trading stratejilerinin performansını takip et.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="page-header-actions">

        <div class="time-filter-group" id="time-filter-group">
          <button class="time-filter-btn active" data-range="all">Tümü</button>
          <button class="time-filter-btn" data-range="7d">7G</button>
          <button class="time-filter-btn" data-range="30d">30G</button>
          <button class="time-filter-btn" data-range="90d">90G</button>
          <button class="time-filter-btn" data-range="month">Bu Ay</button>
        </div>

        <button id="export-all-csv" class="btn-export" title="Tüm stratejileri CSV olarak indir">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>
          CSV
        </button>
        <button id="export-all-pdf" class="btn-export" title="Tüm stratejileri PDF olarak indir">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/></svg>
          PDF
        </button>
        <button id="open-add-strategy-modal" class="btn-add-strategy">
          <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 14 14" fill="none">
            <path d="M7 1v12M1 7h12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          </svg>
          <span data-i18n="strategies.add_button">Yeni Strateji Ekle</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="stats-grid" id="summary-stats-skeleton" style="display:grid;">
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
      <div class="skeleton-stat"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line" style="width:60%;"></div></div>
    </div>


    <div class="stats-grid" id="summary-stats-bar" style="display:none;">
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="strategies.summary.total_strategies">Toplam Strateji</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-total-strategies">—</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="strategies.summary.total_trades">Toplam İşlem</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-total-trades">—</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="strategies.summary.best_wr">En Yüksek WR</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-best-wr">—</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label" data-i18n="strategies.summary.total_pnl">Toplam K/Z</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="stat-total-pnl">—</div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="strategies-grid-skeleton" id="strategies-grid-skeleton">
      <div class="skeleton-strategy-card">
        <div class="skeleton-line"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-line-sm"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stats">
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skeleton-strategy-card">
        <div class="skeleton-line"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-line-sm"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stats">
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="skeleton-strategy-card">
        <div class="skeleton-line"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-line-sm"></div>
        <div class="skeleton-stats">
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
          <div class="skeleton-stat-box"><div class="skeleton-line"></div><div class="skeleton-line"></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div id="strategies-list-container" style="display:none;">

    </div>


    <div class="comparison-skeleton" id="comparison-skeleton">
      <div class="comparison-title">Strateji <em>Karşılaştırma</em></div>
      <div class="comparison-grid">
        <div class="comparison-card-skeleton">
          <div class="skeleton-header"></div>
          <div class="skeleton-chart-area">
            <div class="skeleton-bar-group">
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="comparison-card-skeleton">
          <div class="skeleton-header"></div>
          <div class="skeleton-chart-area">
            <div class="skeleton-bar-group">
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
              <div class="skeleton-bar"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div id="comparison-section" class="comparison-section" style="display:none;">
