    // ============================================================
    // MOBİL MENÜ
    // ============================================================
    var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    var mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('menu-overlay');

    function toggleMenu() {
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
      overlay.classList.toggle('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = mobileMenu.classList.contains('active') ? 'hidden' : '';
    }

    if (hamburger) hamburger.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);
    if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);

    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu a').forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);
    });

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ YILDIZ ANİMASYONU
    // ============================================================
    (function(){
      var canvas = document.getElementById('stars-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      var W, H, stars = [];
      var rafId = null;
      var isVisible = true;

      function resize(){
        W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      }

      function mkStar(){
        return {
          x: Math.random() * W,
          y: Math.random() * H,
          r: Math.random() * 1.2 + 0.3,
          vy: Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
          o: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.15,
          dt: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006,
          purple: Math.random() > 0.65,
        };
      }

      function init(){
        resize();
        stars = [];
        var count = window.innerWidth < 600 ? 90 : 160;
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          stars.push(mkStar());
        }
      }

      function draw(){
        if (!isVisible) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
          return;
        }

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        for (var i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
          var s = stars[i];
          s.o += s.dt;
          if (s.o <= 0.05 || s.o >= 0.7) { s.dt *= -1; }
          s.y -= s.vy;
          s.x += s.vx;
          if (s.y < -4) {
            var newStar = mkStar();
            s.x = newStar.x;
            s.y = H + 4;
            s.r = newStar.r;
            s.vy = newStar.vy;
            s.vx = newStar.vx;
            s.o = newStar.o;
            s.dt = newStar.dt;
            s.purple = newStar.purple;
          }
          if (s.x < -4 || s.x > W + 4) {
            var newStar2 = mkStar();
            s.x = Math.random() * W;
            s.y = H + 4;
            s.r = newStar2.r;
            s.vy = newStar2.vy;
            s.vx = newStar2.vx;
            s.o = newStar2.o;
            s.dt = newStar2.dt;
            s.purple = newStar2.purple;
          }

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = s.purple
            ? 'rgba(124,109,250,' + s.o + ')'
            : 'rgba(232,232,240,' + s.o + ')';
          ctx.fill();
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
        isVisible = !document.hidden;
        if (isVisible && !rafId) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        }
      });

      var resizeTimeout;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
          resize();
        }, 100);
      });

      init();
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ HERO CANDLESTICK CHART
    // ============================================================
    (function(){
      var canvas = document.getElementById('hero-chart-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      var candles = [
        { o:18, h:22, l:14, c:21 }, { o:21, h:26, l:19, c:25 }, { o:25, h:28, l:21, c:22 },
        { o:22, h:27, l:20, c:26 }, { o:26, h:31, l:24, c:30 }, { o:30, h:34, l:27, c:28 },
        { o:28, h:33, l:26, c:32 }, { o:32, h:38, l:30, c:37 }, { o:37, h:41, l:34, c:40 },
        { o:40, h:44, l:37, c:38 }, { o:38, h:43, l:36, c:42 }, { o:42, h:48, l:40, c:47 },
        { o:47, h:52, l:44, c:51 }, { o:51, h:55, l:48, c:49 }, { o:49, h:54, l:47, c:53 },
        { o:53, h:59, l:51, c:58 }, { o:58, h:63, l:55, c:57 }, { o:57, h:62, l:55, c:61 },
        { o:61, h:67, l:59, c:66 }, { o:66, h:71, l:63, c:70 }, { o:70, h:74, l:67, c:68 },
        { o:68, h:73, l:66, c:72 }, { o:72, h:78, l:70, c:77 }, { o:77, h:82, l:74, c:76 },
        { o:76, h:81, l:74, c:80 }, { o:80, h:86, l:78, c:85 }, { o:85, h:90, l:82, c:89 },
        { o:89, h:93, l:86, c:87 }, { o:87, h:92, l:85, c:91 }, { o:91, h:97, l:89, c:96 },
        { o:96, h:100, l:93, c:99 }
      ];

      var C_BULL = '#7c6dfa';
      var C_BEAR = '#e8e8f0';

      var W, H;
      var visibleCount = 0;
      var animating = true;
      var ANIM_INTERVAL = 80;
      var lastReveal = 0;
      var rafId = null;
      var pulsePhase = 0;
      var isVisible = true;

      function resize() {
        var wrap = canvas.parentElement;
        if (!wrap) return;
        W = canvas.width = wrap.clientWidth || 520;
        H = canvas.height = wrap.clientHeight || 380;
      }

      var padL = 14, padR = 18, padT = 28, padB = 36;

      function getChartDims() {
        return { chartW: W - padL - padR, chartH: H - padT - padB };
      }

      function candleX(i, total, chartW) {
        var slot = chartW / total;
        return padL + i * slot + slot * 0.1;
      }
      function candleWidth(total, chartW) {
        return (chartW / total) * 0.72;
      }
      function toY(val, chartH) {
        return padT + (1 - val / 100) * chartH;
      }

      function drawFrame(ts) {
        if (!isVisible) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
          return;
        }

        if (animating) {
          if (ts - lastReveal > ANIM_INTERVAL) {
            visibleCount = Math.min(visibleCount + 1, candles.length);
            lastReveal = ts;
            if (visibleCount >= candles.length) animating = false;
          }
        }

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        var dims = getChartDims();
        var chartW = dims.chartW;
        var chartH = dims.chartH;
        var total = candles.length;
        var cw = candleWidth(total, chartW);

        ctx.setLineDash([3, 7]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (var g = 1; g <= 4; g++) {
          var gy = padT + (g / 5) * chartH;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(padL, gy);
          ctx.lineTo(W - padR, gy);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        for (var i = 0; i < visibleCount; i++) {
          var c = candles[i];
          var bull = c.c >= c.o;
          var col = bull ? C_BULL : C_BEAR;
          var cx = candleX(i, total, chartW);
          var openY = toY(c.o, chartH);
          var closeY = toY(c.c, chartH);
          var highY = toY(c.h, chartH);
          var lowY = toY(c.l, chartH);
          var bodyTop = Math.min(openY, closeY);
          var bodyHeight = Math.max(Math.abs(closeY - openY), 1.5);
          var isLast = (i === visibleCount - 1);

          if (isLast) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = bull ? 'rgba(124,109,250,0.7)' : 'rgba(232,232,240,0.5)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
          }

          ctx.strokeStyle = col;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.globalAlpha = isLast ? 0.9 : 0.85;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(cx + cw / 2, highY);
          ctx.lineTo(cx + cw / 2, lowY);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.fillStyle = col;
          ctx.globalAlpha = isLast ? 1 : (bull ? 0.88 : 0.72);
          ctx.fillRect(cx, bodyTop, cw, bodyHeight);

          if (!bull) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = col;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
            ctx.strokeRect(cx, bodyTop, cw, bodyHeight);
          }

          if (isLast) ctx.restore();
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        if (visibleCount > 0) {
          pulsePhase += 0.06;
          var last = candles[visibleCount - 1];
          var bullLast = last.c >= last.o;
          var lcx = candleX(visibleCount - 1, total, chartW) + cw / 2;
          var tipY = toY(bullLast ? last.h : last.l, chartH);
          var pAlpha = 0.3 + 0.3 * Math.sin(pulsePhase);
          var pR = 5 + 3 * Math.abs(Math.sin(pulsePhase));

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(lcx, tipY, pR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = bullLast ? 'rgba(124,109,250,' + pAlpha + ')' : 'rgba(232,232,240,' + pAlpha + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(lcx, tipY, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = bullLast ? C_BULL : C_BEAR;
          ctx.shadowColor = bullLast ? 'rgba(124,109,250,0.9)' : 'rgba(232,232,240,0.6)';
          ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
      }

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
        isVisible = !document.hidden;
        if (isVisible && !rafId) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
        }
      });

      var resizeTimeout;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
          resize();
          visibleCount = 0;
          animating = true;
          lastReveal = 0;
          if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
        }, 150);
      });

      resize();
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // REVEAL ANIMASYONU
    // ============================================================
    var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(e) {
        if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible');
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.08 });
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el) { obs.observe(el); });

    // ============================================================
    // STATS YÜKLEME
    // ============================================================
    async function loadStats(){
      try {
        await loadPlatformStats();
      } catch(e){
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }
    loadStats();

    // ============================================================
    // TRADE PSİKOLOJİSİ SÖZLERİ
    // ============================================================
    function updateRandomQuote() {
      var quotesArray = i18n.t('quotes');
      var authorsArray = i18n.t('quote_authors');

      var quotes = typeof quotesArray === 'string' ? JSON.parse(quotesArray.replace(/'/g, '"')) : quotesArray;
      var authors = typeof authorsArray === 'string' ? JSON.parse(authorsArray.replace(/'/g, '"')) : authorsArray;

      var randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * quotes.length);
      var quoteEl = document.getElementById('quote-text');
      var authorEl = document.getElementById('quote-author');
      if (quoteEl) quoteEl.textContent = quotes[randomIndex];
      if (authorEl) authorEl.textContent = '— ' + authors[randomIndex];
    }

    updateRandomQuote();
    if (i18n.onChange) {
      i18n.onChange(function() { updateRandomQuote(); });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REFERANSLAR
    // ============================================================
    async function loadReferences(){
      var container = document.getElementById('references-grid');
      if(!container) return;
      try {
        var { data, error } = await sb
          .from('references')
          .select('*')
          .eq('is_active', true)
          .order('display_order', { ascending: true });

        if(error || !data || data.length === 0){
          container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1;padding:2rem;" data-i18n="references.empty">Henüz referans eklenmemiş.</p>';
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = data.map(function(ref) {
          return '\n          <div class="reference-card">\n            <div class="ref-image">\n              <img src="' + (ref.image_url || 'https://placehold.co/100x100?text=Profile') + '" alt="' + esc(ref.name) + '" onerror="this.src=\'https://placehold.co/100x100?text=Profile\'">\n            </div>\n            <div class="ref-info">\n              <h3>' + esc(ref.name) + '</h3>\n              <p class="ref-title">' + esc(ref.title||'') + '</p>\n              <p class="ref-desc">' + esc(ref.description||'') + '</p>\n              <div class="ref-social">\n                ' + (ref.instagram?'<a href="' + ref.instagram + '" target="_blank" class="ref-social-link"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><line x1="17" y1="7" x2="17.01" y2="7"/></svg></a>':'') + '\n                ' + (ref.twitter?'<a href="' + ref.twitter + '" + '" target="_blank" class="ref-social-link"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22.54 6.42a2.78 2.78 0 0 0-1.94-2C18.88 4 12 4         }).join('');
      } catch(e){
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1;padding:2rem;" data-i18n="references.error">Referanslar yüklenemedi.</p>';
      }
    }

    function esc(str){
      if(!str) return '';
      return str.replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) {
        var map = {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'};
        return map[m] || m;
      });
    }

    loadReferences();

    // ============================================================
    // 📋 ÖZELLİKLERİ TIKLAYINCA AÇ/KAPA
    // ============================================================
    function toggleFeatures(card) {
      var toggle = card.querySelector('.plan-features-toggle');
      var list = card.querySelector('.plan-features-list');
      var arrow = toggle.querySelector('.arrow');

      if (list.classList.contains('open')) {
        list.classList.remove('open');
        arrow.classList.remove('open');
        var firstSpan = toggle.querySelector('span:first-child');
        if (firstSpan) firstSpan.textContent = i18n.t('plans.show_features') || 'Özellikleri Göster';
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.plan-features-list.open').forEach(function(l) {
          if (l !== list) {
            l.classList.remove('open');
            var parentCard = l.closest('.plan-card-home');
            if (parentCard) {
              var parentToggle = parentCard.querySelector('.plan-features-toggle');
              var parentArrow = parentToggle.querySelector('.arrow');
              if (parentArrow) parentArrow.classList.remove('open');
              var parentSpan = parentToggle.querySelector('span:first-child');
              if (parentSpan) parentSpan.textContent = i18n.t('plans.show_features') || 'Özellikleri Göster';
            }
          }
        });

        list.classList.add('open');
        arrow.classList.add('open');
        var firstSpan2 = toggle.querySelector('span:first-child');
        if (firstSpan2) firstSpan2.textContent = i18n.t('plans.hide_features') || 'Özellikleri Gizle';
      }
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.plan-features-toggle').forEach(function(toggle) {
      toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var card = this.closest('.plan-card-home');
        if (card) toggleFeatures(card);
      });
    });

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ PLAN FİYATLARI
    // ============================================================
    var updatePriceTimeout = null;

    function updateHomePrices() {
      if (updatePriceTimeout) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(updatePriceTimeout);
      }

      updatePriceTimeout = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        try {
          var monthlyPrice = window.getMonthlyPrice ? window.getMonthlyPrice() : 9;
          var yearlyPrice = window.getYearlyPrice ? window.getYearlyPrice() : 79;
          var paymentMethods = window.getPaymentMethods ? window.getPaymentMethods() : ['BTC', 'LTC'];

          var monthlyEl = document.getElementById('monthly-price-value');
          if (monthlyEl) {
            monthlyEl.textContent = monthlyPrice.toFixed(2);
          }

          var yearlyEl = document.getElementById('yearly-price-value');
          if (yearlyEl) {
            yearlyEl.textContent = yearlyPrice.toFixed(2);
          }

          var saveEl = document.getElementById('yearly-save-text');
          if (saveEl) {
            var monthlyFull = monthlyPrice * 12;
            if (monthlyFull > 0) {
              var discount = Math.round(((monthlyFull - yearlyPrice) / monthlyFull) * 100);
              var lang = typeof i18n !== 'undefined' ? i18n.getCurrentLanguage() : 'en';
              var text = '';
              if (lang === 'tr') text = '🎯 %' + discount + ' tasarruf et!';
              else if (lang === 'de') text = '🎯 ' + discount + '% sparen!';
              else text = '🎯 Save ' + discount + '%!';
              saveEl.textContent = text;
            }
          }

          var paymentNote = document.getElementById('payment-methods-note');
          if (paymentNote && paymentMethods.length > 0) {
            var lang2 = typeof i18n !== 'undefined' ? i18n.getCurrentLanguage() : 'en';
            var prefix = '💳 ';
            if (lang2 === 'tr') prefix = '💳 Kredi kartı, kripto (';
            else if (lang2 === 'de') prefix = '💳 Kreditkarte, Krypto (';
            else prefix = '💳 Credit card, crypto (';
            paymentNote.innerHTML = '<span data-i18n="plans.payment_note">' + prefix + paymentMethods.join(' / ') + ') veya banka havalesi ile ödeme</span>';
            if (window.i18n) window.i18n.apply();
          }
        } catch (error) {}
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('storage', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'ww_monthly_price' || e.key === 'ww_yearly_price' || e.key === 'ww_prices' || e.key === 'ww_payment_methods') {
        updateHomePrices();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      try {
        var settings = getSystemSettings();
        if (settings.payMethod) {
          if (typeof selectedPayMethod !== 'undefined') {
            selectedPayMethod = settings.payMethod;
          }
          try { localStorage.setItem('ww_pay_method', settings.payMethod); } catch(e) {}
        }
      } catch(e) {}

      updateHomePrices();
    });

    if (typeof i18n !== 'undefined' && i18n.onChange) {
      i18n.onChange(function() {
        updateHomePrices();
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ PLAN BUTONLARI
    // ============================================================
    var upgradeMonthly = document.getElementById('upgrade-monthly-home');
    if (upgradeMonthly) {
      upgradeMonthly.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        (async function() {
          try {
            var { data: { session } } = await sb.auth.getSession();
            if (!session) {
              window.location.href = 'register.html?plan=monthly';
              return;
            }

            var price = typeof getMonthlyPrice === 'function' ? getMonthlyPrice() : 9;
            var payMethod = typeof selectedPayMethod !== 'undefined' ? selectedPayMethod : 'BTC';

            if (typeof upgradeToPremium === 'function') {
              await upgradeToPremium('monthly', price, 'USD', payMethod);
            } else {
              showToast('Sistem hazırlanıyor, lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.', 'error');
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Premium satın alma hatası:', err);
            showToast('Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.', 'error');
          }
        })();
      });
    }

    var upgradeYearly = document.getElementById('upgrade-yearly-home');
    if (upgradeYearly) {
      upgradeYearly.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        (async function() {
          try {
            var { data: { session } } = await sb.auth.getSession();
            if (!session) {
              window.location.href = 'register.html?plan=yearly';
              return;
            }

            var price = typeof getYearlyPrice === 'function' ? getYearlyPrice() : 79;
            var payMethod = typeof selectedPayMethod !== 'undefined' ? selectedPayMethod : 'BTC';

            if (typeof upgradeToPremium === 'function') {
              await upgradeToPremium('yearly', price, 'USD', payMethod);
            } else {
              showToast('Sistem hazırlanıyor, lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.', 'error');
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Premium satın alma hatası:', err);
            showToast('Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.', 'error');
          }
        })();
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DİL SEÇİCİ
    // ============================================================
    var langCurrent = document.getElementById('lang-current');
    var langDropdown = document.getElementById('lang-dropdown');
    var langOptions = document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');
    var langCurrentFlag = document.querySelector('.lang-current-flag');
    var langCurrentText = document.querySelector('.lang-current-text');

    function updateLanguageUI(lang) {
      var selectedOption = document.querySelector('.lang-option[data-lang="' + lang + '"]');
      if (selectedOption) {
        var flag = selectedOption.dataset.flag;
        var name = selectedOption.dataset.name;
        if (langCurrentFlag) langCurrentFlag.textContent = flag;
        if (langCurrentText) langCurrentText.textContent = name;

        langOptions.forEach(function(opt) {
          var optLang = opt.dataset.lang;
          var checkSpan = opt.querySelector('.lang-option-check');
          if (optLang === lang) {
            opt.classList.add('active');
            if (checkSpan) checkSpan.textContent = '✓';
          } else {
            opt.classList.remove('active');
            if (checkSpan) checkSpan.textContent = '';
          }
        });
      }
    }

    function toggleDropdown() {
      if (langDropdown) langDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
    }

    function closeDropdown() {
      if (langDropdown) langDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }

    if (langCurrent) {
      langCurrent.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        toggleDropdown();
      });
    }

    langOptions.forEach(function(option) {
      option.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var lang = option.dataset.lang;
        i18n.setLanguage(lang);
        updateLanguageUI(lang);
        closeDropdown();
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (langCurrent && langDropdown) {
        if (!langCurrent.contains(e.target) && !langDropdown.contains(e.target)) {
          closeDropdown();
        }
      }
    });

    updateLanguageUI(i18n.getCurrentLanguage());
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=5.0" />
  <title>Wawe Journal</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="resim.svg">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="index.css" />
  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    html, body {
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }
    img, svg, canvas {
      max-width: 100%;
    }

    .psych-section {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 1rem 1rem;
    }
    .psych-quote {
      font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }
    .psych-quote::before {
      content: '"';
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      opacity: 0.4;
      margin-right: 4px;
    }
    .psych-quote::after {
      content: '"';
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      opacity: 0.4;
      margin-left: 4px;
      vertical-align: top;
    }
    .psych-author {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    /* Dil Seçici */
    .lang-selector {
      position: relative;
      margin-left: 0.5rem;
    }
    .lang-current {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 40px;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }
    .lang-current:hover {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.1);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }
    .lang-current-flag {
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .lang-current-text {
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .lang-current-arrow {
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      transition: transform 0.2s;
    }
    .lang-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: 48px;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--surface2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      min-width: 130px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      z-index: 300;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .lang-dropdown.show {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    .lang-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .lang-option:hover {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.1);
    }
    .lang-option.active {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.15);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .lang-option-flag {
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .lang-option-name {
      flex: 1;
    }
    .lang-option-check {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* ⭐ PLAN KARŞILAŞTIRMA BÖLÜMÜ - SADE MOR + KÜÇÜK KUTU */
    .plans-section {
      padding: 4rem 2rem;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .plans-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }

    /* 🌟 CAM ARKA PLAN + SADECE MOR */
    .plan-card-home {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
                  border-color 0.35s ease,
                  box-shadow 0.35s ease,
                  background 0.35s ease;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      isolation: isolate;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .plan-card-home::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(124,109,250,0.05), transparent 70%);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: -1;
    }

    .plan-card-home:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      border-color: rgba(124,109,250,0.2);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,109,250,0.06) inset;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }
    .plan-card-home:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    /* ⭐ PREMIUM PLAN %2 BÜYÜT - SADECE MOR */
    .plan-card-home.premium {
      border-color: rgba(124,109,250,0.18);
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.04);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      transform: scale(1.02);
    }
    .plan-card-home.premium::before {
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(124,109,250,0.1), transparent 70%);
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .plan-card-home.premium:hover {
      transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-4px);
      border-color: rgba(124,109,250,0.35);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(124,109,250,0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,109,250,0.1) inset;
    }

    /* Premium üst çizgi - SADECE MOR */
    .plan-card-home.premium::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #7c6dfa, #9b8bfa, #7c6dfa, transparent);
      background-size: 300% 100%;
      animation: shimmerLine 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
    }
    @keyframes shimmerLine {
      0% { background-position: 0% 0%; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 0%; }
      100% { background-position: 0% 0%; }
    }

    /* 📌 ROZET - SAĞ ÜST KÖŞE MİNİMAL - SADECE MOR */
    .plan-card-home .plan-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      right: 10px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 7px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
      color: #9b8bfa;
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.1);
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-badge.popular {
      background: #7c6dfa;
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(124,109,250,0.25);
      animation: pulseBadge 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulseBadge {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(124,109,250,0.25); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(124,109,250,0.4); }
    }

    /* 🎨 SVG İKONLAR - SADECE MOR */
    .plan-card-home .plan-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      margin: 0 auto 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }
    .plan-card-home:hover .plan-icon {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.12);
      border-color: rgba(124,109,250,0.2);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }
    .plan-card-home.premium .plan-icon {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.15);
    }
    .plan-card-home.premium:hover .plan-icon {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.18);
      border-color: rgba(124,109,250,0.3);
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-icon svg {
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      stroke: #7c6dfa;
    }

    .plan-card-home .plan-name {
      font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
    }

    /* 💰 FİYATLAR BÜYÜK */
    .plan-card-home .plan-price {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
      margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .plan-card-home.premium .plan-price {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text), #9b8bfa);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-price span {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: var(--muted);
      -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--muted);
    }

    .plan-card-home .plan-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      min-height: 32px;
    }

    /* 📋 ÖZELLİKLER - KÜÇÜK KUTU, TIKLAYINCA AÇILIR */
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-wrapper {
      flex: 1;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-toggle {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 9px;
      color: #7c6dfa;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.8rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.3rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-toggle:hover {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.12);
      border-color: rgba(124,109,250,0.2);
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-toggle .arrow {
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-toggle .arrow.open {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      text-align: left;
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.3s ease, margin 0.3s ease;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list.open {
      max-height: 500px;
      opacity: 1;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.3rem 0;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list li:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list li .check {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.1);
      color: #7c6dfa;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 9px;
    }
    .plan-card-home.premium .plan-features-list li .check {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.15);
      color: #9b8bfa;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list li .cross {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
      color: var(--muted);
      opacity: 0.4;
      font-size: 9px;
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list li.is-disabled {
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .plan-card-home .plan-features-list li .premium-only {
      color: #9b8bfa;
      font-size: 7px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      margin-left: auto;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.06);
      padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
    }

    /* 🔘 BUTONLAR - SADECE MOR */
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: auto;
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.free {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.free:hover {
      border-color: #7c6dfa;
      color: #7c6dfa;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.06);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* 🎯 PREMIUM BUTON - SADECE MOR GRADIENT */
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c6dfa, #6b5bd6);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124,109,250,0.25);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6b5bd6, #7c6dfa);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(124,109,250,0.35);
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn.outline {
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,109,250,0.15);
      color: var(--text);
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    .plan-card-home .btn-plan.premium-btn.outline:hover {
      border-color: #7c6dfa;
      color: #7c6dfa;
      background: rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(124,109,250,0.08);
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: 0.5rem;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       📱 RESPONSIVE / MOBİL UYUM
       ============================================================ */

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .plans-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .plans-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
      }
      .plan-card-home.premium {
        transform: none;
      }
      .plan-card-home.premium:hover {
        transform: translateY(-4px);
      }
      .plans-section {
        padding: 3rem 1.25rem;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links .btn-login,
      .nav-links .btn-register {
        display: none;
      }
      .lang-current-text {
        display: none;
      }
      .lang-current {
        padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
      }
      .psych-quote {
        font-size: 1.15rem;
      }
      .psych-author {
        font-size: 0.75rem;
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 769px) {
      .lang-current-text {
        display: inline;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .plans-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .plan-card-home {
        padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 1.25rem;
      }
      .plan-card-home.premium {
        transform: none;
      }
      .plan-card-home.premium:hover {
        transform: translateY(-4px);
      }
      .plan-card-home .plan-price {
        font-size: 1.8rem;
      }
      .plans-section {
        padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
      }
      .section-desc {
        padding: 0 0.5rem;
      }
      .psych-section {
        padding: 1rem 0.75rem;
      }
      .psych-quote {
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1.45;
      }
      .lang-selector {
        margin-left: 0.25rem;
      }
      .lang-current {
        padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
      }
      .nav {
        padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      }
      #payment-methods-note {
        padding: 0 0.5rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 400px) {
      .plan-card-home .plan-price {
        font-size: 1.6rem;
      }
      .plan-card-home .plan-name {
        font-size: 1rem;
      }
      .psych-quote {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

        </svg>
      </div>

        <div class="lang-option" data-lang="de" data-flag="🇩🇪" data-name="Deutsch">

  <section class="hero">

        <span data-i18n="hero.badge">Bir günlükten çok daha fazlası.</span>
      </div>

      <h1>
        <span class="l1" data-i18n="hero.line1">DİSİPLİNLİ</span>

        <span class="l3" data-i18n="hero.line3">KAZAN. BÜYÜ.</span>
      </h1>

      <p class="hero-sub" data-i18n="hero.subtitle">
        Wawe Journal, her trade'ini kaydettiğin, analizlerini gördüğün ve disiplinini inşa ettiğin profesyonel trade günlüğün.
      </p>

      <div class="hero-actions">
        <a href="register.html" class="btn-primary" data-i18n="hero.start_free">Ücretsiz Başla →</a>
        <a href="login.html" class="btn-ghost" data-i18n="hero.login">Giriş Yap</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="hero-chart-wrap">
      <canvas id="hero-chart-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="hero-float-card hfc-top">

      </div>
      <div class="hero-float-card hfc-mid">

    <div class="hero-stats">

      <div class="hstat">

  <div class="glow-line"></div>

  <div class="section reveal">
    <div class="section-tag" data-i18n="features.tag">Özellikler</div>
    <h2 class="section-title" data-i18n-html="features.title">Kazanan <em>Trader'ların</em> Aracı</h2>
    <p class="section-desc" data-i18n="features.desc">Sadece kayıt tutmak değil — anlamak, geliştirmek ve üstün olmak için tasarlandı.</p>

    <div class="features-grid">
      <div class="feat-card">
        <div class="feat-num">01</div>
        <div class="feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 2v4M12 18v4M4.93 4.93l2.83 2.83M16.24 16.24l2.83 2.83M2 12h4M18 12h4M4.93 19.07l2.83-2.83M16.24 7.76l2.83-2.83"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3 data-i18n="feature.trade_log.title">İşlem Kaydı</h3>
        <p data-i18n="feature.trade_log.desc">Her trade'in tam hikayesini saniyeler içinde belgele.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feat-card">
        <div class="feat-num">02</div>
        <div class="feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <line x1="18" y1="20" x2="18" y2="10"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="4"/>
            <line x1="6" y1="20" x2="6" y2="14"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3 data-i18n="feature.dashboard.title">Anlık Dashboard</h3>
        <p data-i18n="feature.dashboard.desc">Win rate, ortalama R ve drawdown tek ekranda.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feat-card">
        <div class="feat-num">03</div>
        <div class="feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <polyline points="13 2 13 7 18 7"/>
            <path d="M3 8v13a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8"/>
            <path d="M3 8h18"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3 data-i18n="feature.fast.title">Hızlı ve Profesyonel</h3>
        <p data-i18n="feature.fast.desc">Sadece sen ve trade'lerin. Odaklan, kaydet, analiz et.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feat-card">
        <div class="feat-num">04</div>
        <div class="feat-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M21 16V8a2 2 0 0 0-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 0 0 3 8v8a2 2 0 0 0 1 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 0 0 2 0l7-4A2 2 0 0 0 21 16z"/>
            <polyline points="3.29 7 12 12 20.71 7"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="22" x2="12" y2="12"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h3 data-i18n="feature.strategy.title">Strateji Analizi</h3>
        <p data-i18n="feature.strategy.desc">Hangi stratejinin daha kârlı olduğunu grafik ile gör.</p>

  </div>


  <div class="glow-line"></div>

  <div class="section reveal plans-section">
    <div class="section-tag" data-i18n="plans.tag">💎 Fiyatlandırma</div>
    <h2 class="section-title" data-i18n-html="plans.title">Herkes İçin <em>Bir Plan</em></h2>
    <p class="section-desc" data-i18n="plans.desc">İster yeni başlıyor ol, ister profesyonel trader — sana uygun planı seç.</p>

    <div class="plans-grid" id="plans-grid">

      <div class="plan-card-home" onclick="toggleFeatures(this)">
        <div class="plan-badge" data-i18n="plans.free_badge">ÜCRETSİZ</div>
        <div class="plan-icon">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#7c6dfa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M12 2L2 7l10 5 10-5-10-5z"/>
            <path d="M2 17l10 5 10-5"/>
            <path d="M2 12l10 5 10-5"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="plan-name" data-i18n="plans.free_name">Başlangıç</div>
        <div class="plan-price">$0.00 <span data-i18n="plans.free_period">/ ay</span></div>
        <p class="plan-desc" data-i18n="plans.free_desc">Temel özelliklerle başla.</p>

        <div class="plan-features-wrapper">
          <div class="plan-features-toggle">
            <span data-i18n="plans.show_features">Özellikleri Göster</span>
            <span class="arrow">▼</span>
          </div>

  <script>
    // ============================================================
    // BAKIM MODU KONTROLÜ (tek bir yerde toplandı)
    // ============================================================
    (function() {
      var currentPath = window.location.pathname;
      if (currentPath.includes('admin.html') || currentPath.includes('login.html') || currentPath.includes('maintenance.html')) {
        return;
      }

      (async function() {
        try {
          var settings = getSystemSettings();
          if (settings.maintenance_mode) {
            var { data: { session } } = await sb.auth.getSession();
            if (session) {
              var role = session.user?.user_metadata?.role;
              if (role === 'admin') return;
            }
            window.location.href = 'maintenance.html';
          }
        } catch(e) {}
      })();
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // GİRİŞ YAPMIŞ KULLANICI KONTROLÜ (tek bir yerde)
    // ============================================================
    (function() {
      var redirectDone = false;

      (async function() {
        try {
          var { data: { session } } = await sb.auth.getSession();
          if (session && !redirectDone) {
            redirectDone = true;
            if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
              window.location.href = 'dashboard.html';
            } else {
              window.addEventListener('load', function() {
                window.location.href = 'dashboard.html';
              });
            }
          }
        } catch(e) {}
      })();
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // DISCORD LİNKİ
    // ============================================================
    var discordLink = document.getElementById('discord-link');
    if (discordLink) {
      discordLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        showToast('Discord sunucusu yakında! 🚀', 'success');
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // MOBİL MENÜ
    // ============================================================
    var hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    var mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
    var overlay = document.getElementById('menu-overlay');

    function toggleMenu() {
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
      overlay.classList.toggle('active');
      document.body.style.overflow = mobileMenu.classList.contains('active') ? 'hidden' : '';
    }

    if (hamburger) hamburger.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);
    if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);

    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu a').forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);
    });

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ YILDIZ ANİMASYONU
    // ============================================================
    (function(){
      var canvas = document.getElementById('stars-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      var W, H, stars = [];
      var rafId = null;
      var isVisible = true;

      function resize(){
        W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      }

      function mkStar(){
        return {
          x: Math.random() * W,
          y: Math.random() * H,
          r: Math.random() * 1.2 + 0.3,
          vy: Math.random() * 0.25 + 0.05,
          vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08,
          o: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.15,
          dt: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.006,
          purple: Math.random() > 0.65,
        };
      }

      function init(){
        resize();
        stars = [];
        var count = window.innerWidth < 600 ? 90 : 160;
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          stars.push(mkStar());
        }
      }

      function draw(){
        if (!isVisible) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
          return;
        }

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        for (var i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
          var s = stars[i];
          s.o += s.dt;
          if (s.o <= 0.05 || s.o >= 0.7) { s.dt *= -1; }
          s.y -= s.vy;
          s.x += s.vx;
          if (s.y < -4) {
            var newStar = mkStar();
            s.x = newStar.x;
            s.y = H + 4;
            s.r = newStar.r;
            s.vy = newStar.vy;
            s.vx = newStar.vx;
            s.o = newStar.o;
            s.dt = newStar.dt;
            s.purple = newStar.purple;
          }
          if (s.x < -4 || s.x > W + 4) {
            var newStar2 = mkStar();
            s.x = Math.random() * W;
            s.y = H + 4;
            s.r = newStar2.r;
            s.vy = newStar2.vy;
            s.vx = newStar2.vx;
            s.o = newStar2.o;
            s.dt = newStar2.dt;
            s.purple = newStar2.purple;
          }

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = s.purple
            ? 'rgba(124,109,250,' + s.o + ')'
            : 'rgba(232,232,240,' + s.o + ')';
          ctx.fill();
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
        isVisible = !document.hidden;
        if (isVisible && !rafId) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        }
      });

      var resizeTimeout;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
          resize();
        }, 100);
      });

      init();
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ HERO CANDLESTICK CHART
    // ============================================================
    (function(){
      var canvas = document.getElementById('hero-chart-canvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      var candles = [
        { o:18, h:22, l:14, c:21 }, { o:21, h:26, l:19, c:25 }, { o:25, h:28, l:21, c:22 },
        { o:22, h:27, l:20, c:26 }, { o:26, h:31, l:24, c:30 }, { o:30, h:34, l:27, c:28 },
        { o:28, h:33, l:26, c:32 }, { o:32, h:38, l:30, c:37 }, { o:37, h:41, l:34, c:40 },
        { o:40, h:44, l:37, c:38 }, { o:38, h:43, l:36, c:42 }, { o:42, h:48, l:40, c:47 },
        { o:47, h:52, l:44, c:51 }, { o:51, h:55, l:48, c:49 }, { o:49, h:54, l:47, c:53 },
        { o:53, h:59, l:51, c:58 }, { o:58, h:63, l:55, c:57 }, { o:57, h:62, l:55, c:61 },
        { o:61, h:67, l:59, c:66 }, { o:66, h:71, l:63, c:70 }, { o:70, h:74, l:67, c:68 },
        { o:68, h:73, l:66, c:72 }, { o:72, h:78, l:70, c:77 }, { o:77, h:82, l:74, c:76 },
        { o:76, h:81, l:74, c:80 }, { o:80, h:86, l:78, c:85 }, { o:85, h:90, l:82, c:89 },
        { o:89, h:93, l:86, c:87 }, { o:87, h:92, l:85, c:91 }, { o:91, h:97, l:89, c:96 },
        { o:96, h:100, l:93, c:99 }
      ];

      var C_BULL = '#7c6dfa';
      var C_BEAR = '#e8e8f0';

      var W, H;
      var visibleCount = 0;
      var animating = true;
      var ANIM_INTERVAL = 80;
      var lastReveal = 0;
      var rafId = null;
      var pulsePhase = 0;
      var isVisible = true;

      function resize() {
        var wrap = canvas.parentElement;
        if (!wrap) return;
        W = canvas.width = wrap.clientWidth || 520;
        H = canvas.height = wrap.clientHeight || 380;
      }

      var padL = 14, padR = 18, padT = 28, padB = 36;

      function getChartDims() {
        return { chartW: W - padL - padR, chartH: H - padT - padB };
      }

      function candleX(i, total, chartW) {
        var slot = chartW / total;
        return padL + i * slot + slot * 0.1;
      }
      function candleWidth(total, chartW) {
        return (chartW / total) * 0.72;
      }
      function toY(val, chartH) {
        return padT + (1 - val / 100) * chartH;
      }

      function drawFrame(ts) {
        if (!isVisible) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
          return;
        }

        if (animating) {
          if (ts - lastReveal > ANIM_INTERVAL) {
            visibleCount = Math.min(visibleCount + 1, candles.length);
            lastReveal = ts;
            if (visibleCount >= candles.length) animating = false;
          }
        }

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        var dims = getChartDims();
        var chartW = dims.chartW;
        var chartH = dims.chartH;
        var total = candles.length;
        var cw = candleWidth(total, chartW);

        ctx.setLineDash([3, 7]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (var g = 1; g <= 4; g++) {
          var gy = padT + (g / 5) * chartH;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(padL, gy);
          ctx.lineTo(W - padR, gy);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        for (var i = 0; i < visibleCount; i++) {
          var c = candles[i];
          var bull = c.c >= c.o;
          var col = bull ? C_BULL : C_BEAR;
          var cx = candleX(i, total, chartW);
          var openY = toY(c.o, chartH);
          var closeY = toY(c.c, chartH);
          var highY = toY(c.h, chartH);
          var lowY = toY(c.l, chartH);
          var bodyTop = Math.min(openY, closeY);
          var bodyHeight = Math.max(Math.abs(closeY - openY), 1.5);
          var isLast = (i === visibleCount - 1);

          if (isLast) {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.shadowColor = bull ? 'rgba(124,109,250,0.7)' : 'rgba(232,232,240,0.5)';
            ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
          }

          ctx.strokeStyle = col;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.globalAlpha = isLast ? 0.9 : 0.85;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(cx + cw / 2, highY);
          ctx.lineTo(cx + cw / 2, lowY);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.fillStyle = col;
          ctx.globalAlpha = isLast ? 1 : (bull ? 0.88 : 0.72);
          ctx.fillRect(cx, bodyTop, cw, bodyHeight);

          if (!bull) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = col;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
            ctx.strokeRect(cx, bodyTop, cw, bodyHeight);
          }

          if (isLast) ctx.restore();
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        if (visibleCount > 0) {
          pulsePhase += 0.06;
          var last = candles[visibleCount - 1];
          var bullLast = last.c >= last.o;
          var lcx = candleX(visibleCount - 1, total, chartW) + cw / 2;
          var tipY = toY(bullLast ? last.h : last.l, chartH);
          var pAlpha = 0.3 + 0.3 * Math.sin(pulsePhase);
          var pR = 5 + 3 * Math.abs(Math.sin(pulsePhase));

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(lcx, tipY, pR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = bullLast ? 'rgba(124,109,250,' + pAlpha + ')' : 'rgba(232,232,240,' + pAlpha + ')';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(lcx, tipY, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = bullLast ? C_BULL : C_BEAR;
          ctx.shadowColor = bullLast ? 'rgba(124,109,250,0.9)' : 'rgba(232,232,240,0.6)';
          ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
      }

      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
        isVisible = !document.hidden;
        if (isVisible && !rafId) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
        }
      });

      var resizeTimeout;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
        resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
          resize();
          visibleCount = 0;
          animating = true;
          lastReveal = 0;
          if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
        }, 150);
      });

      resize();
      rafId = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
    })();

    // ============================================================
    // REVEAL ANIMASYONU
    // ============================================================
    var obs = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(e) {
        if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible');
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.08 });
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el) { obs.observe(el); });

    // ============================================================
    // STATS YÜKLEME
    // ============================================================
    async function loadStats(){
      try {
        await loadPlatformStats();
      } catch(e){
        // Sessizce geç
      }
    }
    loadStats();

    // ============================================================
    // TRADE PSİKOLOJİSİ SÖZLERİ
    // ============================================================
    function updateRandomQuote() {
      var quotesArray = i18n.t('quotes');
      var authorsArray = i18n.t('quote_authors');

      var quotes = typeof quotesArray === 'string' ? JSON.parse(quotesArray.replace(/'/g, '"')) : quotesArray;
      var authors = typeof authorsArray === 'string' ? JSON.parse(authorsArray.replace(/'/g, '"')) : authorsArray;

      var randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * quotes.length);
      var quoteEl = document.getElementById('quote-text');
      var authorEl = document.getElementById('quote-author');
      if (quoteEl) quoteEl.textContent = quotes[randomIndex];
      if (authorEl) authorEl.textContent = '— ' + authors[randomIndex];
    }

    updateRandomQuote();
    if (i18n.onChange) {
      i18n.onChange(function() { updateRandomQuote(); });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // REFERANSLAR
    // ============================================================
    async function loadReferences(){
      var container = document.getElementById('references-grid');
      if(!container) return;
      try {
        var { data, error } = await sb
          .from('references')
          .select('*')
          .eq('is_active', true)
          .order('display_order', { ascending: true });

        if(error || !data || data.length === 0){
          container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1;padding:2rem;" data-i18n="references.empty">Henüz referans eklenmemiş.</p>';
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = data.map(function(ref) {
          return '\n          <div class="reference-card">\n            <div class="ref-image">\n              <img src="' + (ref.image_url || 'https://placehold.co/100x100?text=Profile') + '" alt="' + esc(ref.name) + '" onerror="this.src=\'https://placehold.co/100x100?text=Profile\'">\n            </div>\n            <div class="ref-info">\n              <h3>' + esc(ref.name) + '</h3>\n              <p class="ref-title">' + esc(ref.title||'') + '</p>\n              <p class="ref-desc">' + esc(ref.description||'') + '</p>\n              <div class="ref-social">\n                ' + (ref.instagram?'<a href="' + ref.instagram + '" target="_blank" class="ref-social-link"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><line x1="17" y1="7" x2="17.01" y2="7"/></svg></a>':'') + '\n                ' + (ref.twitter?'<a href="' + ref.twitter + '" target="_blank" class="ref-social-link"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M23 3a10.9 10.9 0 0 1-3.14 1.53 4.48 4.48 0 0 0-7.86 3v1A10.66 10.66 0 0 1 3 4s-4 9 5 13a11.64 11.64 0 0 1-7 2c9 5 20 0 20-11.5a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-.08-.83A7.72 7.72 0 0 0 23 3z"/></svg></a>':'') + '\n                ' + (ref.youtube?'<a href="' + ref.youtube + '" target="_blank" class="ref-social-link"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22.54 6.42a2.78 2.78 0 0 0-1.94-2C18.88 4 12 4 12 4s-6.88 0-8.6.46a2.78 2.78 0 0 0-1.94 2A29 29 0 0 0 1 11.75a29 29 0 0 0 .46 5.33A2.78 2.78 0 0 0 3.4 19c1.72.46 8.6.46 8.6.46s6.88 0 8.6-.46a2.78 2.78 0 0 0 1.94-2 29 29 0 0 0 .46-5.25 29 29 0 0 0-.46-5.33z"/><polygon points="9.75 15.02 15.5 11.75 9.75 8.48 9.75 15.02"/></svg></a>':'') + '\n                ' + (ref.linkedin?'<a href="' + ref.linkedin + '" target="_blank" class="ref-social-link"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M16 8a6 6 0 0 1 6 6v7h-4v-7a2 2 0 0 0-2-2 2 2 0 0 0-2 2v7h-4v-7a6 6 0 0 1 6-6z"/><rect x="2" y="9" width="4" height="12"/><circle cx="4" cy="4" r="2"/></svg></a>':'') + '\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        ';
        }).join('');
      } catch(e){
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--muted);text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1;padding:2rem;" data-i18n="references.error">Referanslar yüklenemedi.</p>';
      }
    }

    function esc(str){
      if(!str) return '';
      return str.replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(m) {
        var map = {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'};
        return map[m] || m;
      });
    }

    loadReferences();

    // ============================================================
    // 📋 ÖZELLİKLERİ TIKLAYINCA AÇ/KAPA
    // ============================================================
    function toggleFeatures(card) {
      var toggle = card.querySelector('.plan-features-toggle');
      var list = card.querySelector('.plan-features-list');
      var arrow = toggle.querySelector('.arrow');

      if (list.classList.contains('open')) {
        list.classList.remove('open');
        arrow.classList.remove('open');
        var firstSpan = toggle.querySelector('span:first-child');
        if (firstSpan) firstSpan.textContent = i18n.t('plans.show_features') || 'Özellikleri Göster';
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.plan-features-list.open').forEach(function(l) {
          if (l !== list) {
            l.classList.remove('open');
            var parentCard = l.closest('.plan-card-home');
            if (parentCard) {
              var parentToggle = parentCard.querySelector('.plan-features-toggle');
              var parentArrow = parentToggle.querySelector('.arrow');
              if (parentArrow) parentArrow.classList.remove('open');
              var parentSpan = parentToggle.querySelector('span:first-child');
              if (parentSpan) parentSpan.textContent = i18n.t('plans.show_features') || 'Özellikleri Göster';
            }
          }
        });

        list.classList.add('open');
        arrow.classList.add('open');
        var firstSpan2 = toggle.querySelector('span:first-child');
        if (firstSpan2) firstSpan2.textContent = i18n.t('plans.hide_features') || 'Özellikleri Gizle';
      }
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.plan-features-toggle').forEach(function(toggle) {
      toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var card = this.closest('.plan-card-home');
        if (card) toggleFeatures(card);
      });
    });

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ PLAN FİYATLARI
    // ============================================================
    var updatePriceTimeout = null;

    function updateHomePrices() {
      if (updatePriceTimeout) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(updatePriceTimeout);
      }

      updatePriceTimeout = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        try {
          var monthlyPrice = window.getMonthlyPrice ? window.getMonthlyPrice() : 9;
          var yearlyPrice = window.getYearlyPrice ? window.getYearlyPrice() : 79;
          var paymentMethods = window.getPaymentMethods ? window.getPaymentMethods() : ['BTC', 'LTC'];

          var monthlyEl = document.getElementById('monthly-price-value');
          if (monthlyEl) {
            monthlyEl.textContent = monthlyPrice.toFixed(2);
          }

          var yearlyEl = document.getElementById('yearly-price-value');
          if (yearlyEl) {
            yearlyEl.textContent = yearlyPrice.toFixed(2);
          }

          var saveEl = document.getElementById('yearly-save-text');
          if (saveEl) {
            var monthlyFull = monthlyPrice * 12;
            if (monthlyFull > 0) {
              var discount = Math.round(((monthlyFull - yearlyPrice) / monthlyFull) * 100);
              var lang = typeof i18n !== 'undefined' ? i18n.getCurrentLanguage() : 'en';
              var text = '';
              if (lang === 'tr') text = '🎯 %' + discount + ' tasarruf et!';
              else if (lang === 'de') text = '🎯 ' + discount + '% sparen!';
              else text = '🎯 Save ' + discount + '%!';
              saveEl.textContent = text;
            }
          }

          var paymentNote = document.getElementById('payment-methods-note');
          if (paymentNote && paymentMethods.length > 0) {
            var lang2 = typeof i18n !== 'undefined' ? i18n.getCurrentLanguage() : 'en';
            var prefix = '💳 ';
            if (lang2 === 'tr') prefix = '💳 Kredi kartı, kripto (';
            else if (lang2 === 'de') prefix = '💳 Kreditkarte, Krypto (';
            else prefix = '💳 Credit card, crypto (';
            paymentNote.innerHTML = '<span data-i18n="plans.payment_note">' + prefix + paymentMethods.join(' / ') + ') veya banka havalesi ile ödeme</span>';
            if (window.i18n) window.i18n.apply();
          }
        } catch (error) {}
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('storage', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'ww_monthly_price' || e.key === 'ww_yearly_price' || e.key === 'ww_prices' || e.key === 'ww_payment_methods') {
        updateHomePrices();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      try {
        var settings = getSystemSettings();
        if (settings.payMethod) {
          if (typeof selectedPayMethod !== 'undefined') {
            selectedPayMethod = settings.payMethod;
          }
          try { localStorage.setItem('ww_pay_method', settings.payMethod); } catch(e) {}
        }
      } catch(e) {}

      updateHomePrices();
    });

    if (typeof i18n !== 'undefined' && i18n.onChange) {
      i18n.onChange(function() {
        updateHomePrices();
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // ⭐ PLAN BUTONLARI
    // ============================================================
    var upgradeMonthly = document.getElementById('upgrade-monthly-home');
    if (upgradeMonthly) {
      upgradeMonthly.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        (async function() {
          try {
            var { data: { session } } = await sb.auth.getSession();
            if (!session) {
              window.location.href = 'register.html?plan=monthly';
              return;
            }

            var price = typeof getMonthlyPrice === 'function' ? getMonthlyPrice() : 9;
            var payMethod = typeof selectedPayMethod !== 'undefined' ? selectedPayMethod : 'BTC';

            if (typeof upgradeToPremium === 'function') {
              await upgradeToPremium('monthly', price, 'USD', payMethod);
            } else {
              showToast('Sistem hazırlanıyor, lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.', 'error');
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Premium satın alma hatası:', err);
            showToast('Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.', 'error');
          }
        })();
      });
    }

    var upgradeYearly = document.getElementById('upgrade-yearly-home');
    if (upgradeYearly) {
      upgradeYearly.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        (async function() {
          try {
            var { data: { session } } = await sb.auth.getSession();
            if (!session) {
              window.location.href = 'register.html?plan=yearly';
              return;
            }

            var price = typeof getYearlyPrice === 'function' ? getYearlyPrice() : 79;
            var payMethod = typeof selectedPayMethod !== 'undefined' ? selectedPayMethod : 'BTC';

            if (typeof upgradeToPremium === 'function') {
              await upgradeToPremium('yearly', price, 'USD', payMethod);
            } else {
              showToast('Sistem hazırlanıyor, lütfen sayfayı yenileyin.', 'error');
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Premium satın alma hatası:', err);
            showToast('Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.', 'error');
          }
        })();
      });
    }

    // ============================================================
    // DİL SEÇİCİ
    // ============================================================
    var langCurrent = document.getElementById('lang-current');
    var langDropdown = document.getElementById('lang-dropdown');
    var langOptions = document.querySelectorAll('.lang-option');
    var langCurrentFlag = document.querySelector('.lang-current-flag');
    var langCurrentText = document.querySelector('.lang-current-text');

    function updateLanguageUI(lang) {
      var selectedOption = document.querySelector('.lang-option[data-lang="' + lang + '"]');
      if (selectedOption) {
        var flag = selectedOption.dataset.flag;
        var name = selectedOption.dataset.name;
        if (langCurrentFlag) langCurrentFlag.textContent = flag;
        if (langCurrentText) langCurrentText.textContent = name;

        langOptions.forEach(function(opt) {
          var optLang = opt.dataset.lang;
          var checkSpan = opt.querySelector('.lang-option-check');
          if (optLang === lang) {
            opt.classList.add('active');
            if (checkSpan) checkSpan.textContent = '✓';
          } else {
            opt.classList.remove('active');
            if (checkSpan) checkSpan.textContent = '';
          }
        });
      }
    }

    function toggleDropdown() {
      if (langDropdown) langDropdown.classList.toggle('show');
    }

    function closeDropdown() {
      if (langDropdown) langDropdown.classList.remove('show');
    }

    if (langCurrent) {
      langCurrent.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        toggleDropdown();
      });
    }

    langOptions.forEach(function(option) {
      option.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var lang = option.dataset.lang;
        i18n.setLanguage(lang);
        updateLanguageUI(lang);
        closeDropdown();
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (langCurrent && langDropdown) {
        if (!langCurrent.contains(e.target) && !langDropdown.contains(e.target)) {
          closeDropdown();
        }
      }
    });

    updateLanguageUI(i18n.getCurrentLanguage());
  </script>
</body>
</html>
